Role Title: Bilingual Medical Doctor (Japanese)

Role Type: Contractor (Part-Time)
Location: Remote, Worldwide
Time Commitment: Minimum 15 hours per week

We are seeking bilingual Medical Doctors fluent in Japanese and English to support an AI training project focused on healthcare and clinical decision-making. You'll use your clinical expertise to evaluate medical cases, review AI-generated content, and improve the accuracy of healthcare AI systems. No prior AI experience is required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze and annotate clinical scenarios, patient cases, and healthcare data.
  • Review AI-generated medical content for clinical accuracy and relevance.
  • Apply knowledge of diagnostics, general medicine, physiology, and clinical protocols.
  • Explain complex clinical terminology and healthcare workflows for AI training.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and project teams.
  • Evaluate AI outputs and recommend improvements based on clinical experience.
  • Maintain data privacy, security, and ethical compliance.

Required Qualifications

  • Current or recent clinical practice experience with completed residency; final-year residents may also be considered.
  • Strong knowledge of diagnostic analysis, general medicine, physiology, and clinical protocols.
  • Japanese fluency at JLPT N1 level or equivalent (native or near-native).
  • English proficiency at C1 level or higher.
  • Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to clinical accuracy and ethical standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in internal medicine, family practice, emergency medicine, or a relevant subspecialty.
  • Familiarity with electronic health records, patient data, and medical documentation.
  • Ability to communicate complex clinical concepts clearly and accurately.

Selection Process

  1. AI Interview: Approximately 35 minutes to assess experience and role suitability.
  2. Short Questionnaire: A brief follow-up to confirm fit and gather relevant details.
  3. Client Review: Qualified candidates are submitted for final selection.
  4. Offer & Onboarding: Selected candidates begin onboarding, with initial tasks expected within 24–48 hours of receiving credentials.

raw.description:
Summary:

Designs, develops and manages activities for a specific product or group of products from product definition and planning through production, release, and VIAVI (NASDAQ: VIAV) is a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. VIAVI is also a leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications.

We are the people behind the products that help keep the world connected at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between. VIAVI employees are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company - to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.

Duties & Responsibilities:

VIAVI Solutions is seeking a strategic and highly technical Product Line Manager (PLM) to join our Automated Mobility Solutions (AMS) business unit, specifically owning the evolution of the NITRO Mobile product portfolio.


In this role, you will drive the product strategy, roadmap, and commercial success of our next-generation Mobile Core Service Assurance solutions. You will blend deep cellular network domain expertise (4G EPC, 5G NSA, and 5G Standalone Service-Based Architecture) with robust software product management practices. This position bridges engineering, data science, marketing, and sales to deliver cloud-native observability, automated root-cause analysis (RCA), and AI-driven insights (AIOps) to global Tier-1 Communication Service Providers (CSPs).


What you'll be doing:

Portfolio Strategy & Lifecycle Management

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned NITRO Mobile core service assurance modules, from inception and market requirements definitions (PRDs/MRDs) to development, launch, and eventual sunset.
  • Define the multi-year portfolio roadmap, balancing tactical customer commitments with long-term strategic evolution toward automated network operations and network slicing assurance.
  • Champion cloud-native observability paradigms, ensuring NITRO Mobile platforms gracefully handle high-throughput 5G user-plane (UPF) and control-plane telemetry.

Product Architecture & Technical Definition

  • Translate complex 3GPP standards and service-based interfaces into actionable software requirements for data collection, probe ingestion, and analytics dashboards.
  • Drive integration with modern orchestration and data layers, ensuring alignment with industry automation benchmarks such as TM Forum Open APIs.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data science teams to specify and validate machine learning-driven anomaly detection, predictive health indicators, and automated service triage models.

Business & Market Success

  • Manage product line profitability (P&L optimization), pricing strategies, and packaging frameworks as the portfolio shifts toward virtualized, cloud-native subscription and SaaS delivery models.
  • Conduct market analysis to evaluate the Total Addressable Market (TAM), competitive landscapes (including independent software vendors and network equipment providers), and emerging operator pain points.
  • Support high-value pre-sales activities, delivering technical portfolio briefings, leading proof-of-concept (PoC) scopes, and responding to complex RFI/RFP requirements for major global carriers.

Pre-Requisites / Skills / Experience Requirements:


What you'll bring to the role:


  • Cellular Core Architecture: Mastery of 4G Evolved Packet Core (EPC) and 5G Standalone (5G SA) architectures, including comprehensive familiarity with network functions like AMF, SMF, UPF, NSSF, and NWDAF.

  • Protocols & Telemetry: Deep understanding of mobile core protocol stacks (HTTP/2, GTPv2, Diameter, SIP/IMS) and real-time capture infrastructure (DPI, virtual taps, eBPF telemetry).

  • Cloud & Modern Infrastructure: Working familiarity with cloud-native deployment patterns (Kubernetes, AWS/Azure telco clouds), containerized applications, and distributed high-scale data architectures (Kafka, ClickHouse).

  • Standards Compliance: Familiarity with 3GPP performance management/trace specifications and TM Forum automation/service management frameworks.

Business & Market Requirements


  • Product Management Excellence: Minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience as a technical Product Manager, PLM, or Solution Architect in the telecom OSS/BSS, monitoring, or service assurance space.

  • Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated experience managing software product pricing, constructing software subscription models, and generating business cases for major technology shifts.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Proven capability to influence across boundaries, collaborating effectively with software developers, system architects, finance, product marketing, and executive leadership.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to synthesize highly complex, low-level technical infrastructure challenges into clear value propositions for executive-level (C-suite) operator decision-makers.


If you have what it takes to push boundaries and seize opportunities, apply to join our team today.

VIAVI Solutions is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer - minorities/females/veterans/persons with disabilities.

raw.description:
We are now looking for a Distinguished Signal & Power Integrity Engineer! NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can tackle, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work, to amplify human imagination and intelligence. This is a dynamic team working with state of the art, unique technology. If you are someone that loves a challenge, come join this diverse team and help move the needle!


What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the development and execution of corporate-level strategies for high-speed signaling technologies across advanced semiconductor packaging, sockets, and connectors.
  • Oversee technical direction and implementation for next-gen products ranging from ultra-mobile to high-performance AI and HPC platforms.
  • Architect and deliver state-of-the-art interconnect and packaging solutions for standards such as UCIe, HBM, DDR, PCIe, and industry-leading SerDes (224G/448G).
  • Enable advanced packaging technology solutions for co-packaged optics, stacked die, chiplet-based architectures and IVR solutions .
  • Development of modeling and characterization flows, flow automations, design for high volume manufacturing techniques.
  • Offer strategic counsel as a recognized subject matter expert to senior leadership on emerging technologies, technology investment, and research priorities in signaling, packaging, and system integration

What we need to see:

  • 15+ years leading innovations spanning high-speed signal integrity, computational electromagnetics, and semiconductor assembly technologies.
  • MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering or equivalent with 15+ years of industry experience.
  • Hands-on invention and deployment of advanced solutions e.g., EMIB, UCIe, CPO, high density connectors.
  • Deep experience with electrical, computer, and packaging engineering and deployment of such in products
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and mentor teams of highly skilled engineers, define methodologies, and deliver complex projects from research to high-volume manufacturing

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • An industry veteran with proven track record of bringing advanced SI concepts from research to product
  • A known pioneer in any industry standard high speed signaling technology
  • Deep knowledge of operation and manufacturing challenges of package substrate, PCB, cables and connectors
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 320,000 USD – 488,750 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 10, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Do you thrive on creating innovative solutions to solve problems?

Partner with the best

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Grad Intern – R&D Execution, Strategy & Operations (Summer 2027)

What You Will Do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. We have multiple openings for graduate level students to further their educational goals. This internship will be approximately 12 weeks and includes both project-based and experiential learning. The intern will be an integral member of the R&D Execution, Strategy & Operations (R&D EOS) organization, which is focused on driving innovation beyond the molecule and applying digital (and other) strategies to simplify processes. The 4 functional areas within R&D EOS are:

  • Strategy: Powering-up industry-leading R&D through strategy, functional transformation, and performance excellence
  • Portfolio & Program Management: Turning product strategy into execution to bring medicines to patients faster 
  • R&D Business Operations: Innovating excellence and navigating efficiency to manage R&D operational activities, including budget planning and contracting, suppliers, laboratories, workforce strategy and environmental, social & governance (ESG)
  • R&D Knowledge & Learning: Transforming and advancing digitization and contemporized learning as well as cultivating talent & culture for a people-centric and inclusive workforce

As a member of Amgen's R&D EOS organization, your work will be highly collaborative across multiple functions and levels within Amgen, including, Research & Development, Chief Medical Office, Chief Technology Office, Quality & Compliance, and others. You will be uniquely responsible for one or more key projects that will advance R&D EOS’ mission, including the following:

  • Supporting a project within one of our functional areas
  • Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams on projects and/or programs that strive to improve R&D’s competitiveness through speed, agility and excellence in execution
  • Leveraging your analytical, leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to work in teams, identify problems, conduct research, develop recommendations through qualitative and quantitative analysis, and deliver final projects
  • Presenting your deliverables/findings through various forums including an intern-wide poster session and a final readout to executive management
  • Engaging in learning activities, networking with colleagues across the company, and enjoying full access to Amgen’s Employee Resource Groups

This description serves as a general outline for the responsibilities of a graduate intern in R&D EOS. The specific tasks and requirements may vary depending on the nature of the project.

Program Eligibility Requirements

  • Must be available to work a full-time schedule
  • Expected continued enrollment in an accredited college or university following the internship program / co-op
  • Student must be located in the United States for the duration of the internship program

What We Expect of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The collaborative individual we seek is hard-working with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

Amgen requires that all individuals applying for a grad internship or a co-op assignment at Amgen must meet the following criteria:

  • 18 years or older
  • Graduated with a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
  • Currently enrolled in an MBA program for an MBA internship OR a Master’s program for a Master’s internship OR a PharmD program for a PharmD internship OR Ph.D. for a PhD internship from an accredited college or university and completion of the first year of MBA OR Master’s OR Pharm D OR Ph.D. program before the internship starts

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Degree concentration(s) in Business, Finance, Management Sciences, Life Sciences, Engineering, Communications, Psychology, Human Resources, or a similar field
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical and organized, with the ability to synthesize information from different sources and manage tasks and deadlines
  • Enthusiastic, proactive, and a willingness to learn
  • Adaptability in navigating and effectively responding to ambiguity and evolving circumstances and priorities
  • Basic understanding of project management concepts is a plus

What You Can Expect of Us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The base pay range for this opportunity in the U.S. is $35.34 - $41.20 per hour.

  • Build a network of colleagues that will endure and grow throughout your time with us and beyond.
  • Bring your authentic self to the table and become the professional you’re inspired to be through accepting a culture that values the diversity of thought and experience and will flex to your strengths and possibilities.
  • Participate in executive and social networking events, as well as community volunteer projects.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

Application deadline

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.

Sponsorship

Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. for the duration of this program. Sponsorship for future FTE roles is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

raw.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Executive Director, Global Commercial Development – Pancreatic Cancer, this role will lead global commercial strategy and lifecycle development for the pancreatic cancer portfolio. This job description is across numerous positions, including daraxonrasib and zoldonrasib and future pipeline candidates, supporting opportunities in first-line metastatic, locally advanced, perioperative, and adjuvant disease, as well as future indications. This leader will translate evolving clinical evidence, patient and biomarker insights, and competitive dynamics into integrated global commercial strategies, portfolio investment recommendations, and stage-appropriate launch readiness. The role requires strong cross-functional leadership and close alignment with existing asset and indication teams.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

  • Own integrated pancreatic portfolio strategy: Lead global commercial development across therapeutic and pancreatic cancer settings; connect indication strategies to overall portfolio value.

  • Guide indication and lifecycle prioritization: Evaluate clinical and commercial opportunities, unmet need, competitive differentiation, treatment sequencing, and investment trade-offs; present clear recommendations for development and governance decisions.

  • Build treatment-setting strategies: Develop differentiated commercial hypotheses for first-line treatment, locally advanced disease, surgical/perioperative pathways, and adjuvant therapy, recognizing distinct patient journeys, customers, and evidence requirements.

  • Integrate asset and combination positioning: Partner with relevant product teams to shape complementary daraxonrasib and zoldonrasib strategies, including biomarker-defined populations, potential combination approaches, and implications of future portfolio evolution.

  • Lead patient and market forecasting: Develop global epidemiology, treatment-flow and patient-segmentation models, revenue scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and commercial value assessments across the continuum of pancreatic cancer care.

  • Shape clinical development through a commercial lens: Collaborate with Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, HEOR, and Market Access on target populations, meaningful endpoints, duration of therapy, standards of care, and evidence needed for future adoption.

  • Advance biomarker and patient-identification strategy: Work with Precision Medicine and Diagnostics on RAS/KRAS testing, KRAS G12D-defined populations, laboratory and referral workflows, accessibility, and the commercial implications of molecularly guided care.

  • Connect the multidisciplinary ecosystem: Build a unified commercial understanding of oncologists, pancreatic surgeons, gastroenterologists, radiologists, pathologists, multidisciplinary tumor boards, academic centers, and community settings, in partnership with Medical Affairs and existing engagement teams.

  • Align with cross-portfolio leaders: Coordinate with established first-line/metastatic teams, regional affiliates, and global brand teams to share insights and ensure best in class launches.

  • Prepare for future launches and expansions: Develop stage-gated global commercialization frameworks, value propositions, brand positioning, affiliate readiness, access and customer-pathway assumptions, and launch scenarios for the U.S. and global markets.

  • Track market evolution and performance: Monitor scientific milestones, competing programs, diagnostic adoption, treatment patterns, and commercial assumptions; adjust strategic plans and forecasts as evidence and investment decisions evolve.

  • Lead execution and influence: Guide cross-functional working teams, agencies, market research and analytics partners; communicate succinctly with senior leaders and governance forums and apply innovative digital and data-driven approaches.

  • Up to 40% of travel required.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree with at least 15 years, or advanced degree with at least 8 years, of progressive commercial experience in a biotechnology and/or pharmaceutical company, including strategic marketing and ideally sales.

  • Proven success developing global oncology commercial strategies across products, indications, or stages of disease and influencing complex cross-functional product teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop patient and revenue forecasts, interpret market and clinical insights, and evaluate strategic trade-offs that inform portfolio investment decisions.

  • Strong leadership, ability to build high-performing teams and partnerships, and ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills and the ability to deliver high-quality strategic work under evolving timelines.

  • Strong clinical and scientific acumen; ability to translate emerging clinical evidence, trial design, and oncology treatment pathways into commercial implications.

  • Excellent executive communication, presentation, and external stakeholder engagement skills.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and commitment to improving outcomes for people with cancer.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in pancreatic or other gastrointestinal cancers, including first-line metastatic and earlier-stage treatment settings.

  • Experience with precision oncology, KRAS/RAS-targeted medicines, molecular testing, or biomarker-defined patient populations.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

As we prepare for future launches in obesity and related conditions, we are building one of the most significant commercialization efforts in the company's history.


HCP Marketing Manager– US Obesity and Related Conditions

What You Will Do

The US Healthcare Professional (HCP) Marketing Mgr. will bring brand strategy to life by developing and executing high-impact promotional materials, campaigns, and customer engagement initiatives across the U.S. obesity and related conditions portfolio. Working closely with marketing leadership and cross-functional partners, this role will translate customer insights and brand priorities into coordinated, multichannel initiatives that support field engagement, campaign activation, and launch readiness.


The individual will collaborate with HCP Marketing, Sales, Medical, Regulatory, Legal, Training, Omnichannel, Insights & Analytics, Global Marketing, and agency partners to deliver effective promotional resources, support key commercial meetings, and coordinate launch-related activities. Success in this role requires strong collaboration, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while optimizing marketing initiatives based on performance insights and feedback.


Key Responsibilities

Develop and Execute HCP Marketing Programs

  • Contribute to the development and execution of HCP promotional materials and customer engagement programs across the HCP journey.
  • Coordinate with Global Marketing, Patient Marketing, Omnichannel, and agency partners to support an integrated and consistent customer experience.
  • Develop and maintain field resources, sales tools, presentations, and other materials that support effective HCP interactions.
  • Support disease state education and unmet needs initiatives, including congress and other priority campaign activations.
  • Partner with Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and agency partners to advance materials through review while maintaining strategic intent and quality.

Support Commercial Meetings and Field Engagement

  • Develop or coordinate meeting objectives, presentations, promotional materials, and supporting resources in partnership with Sales Leadership and Training.
  • Coordinate assigned deliverables across stakeholders and help ensure content is accurate, approved, and available on schedule.
  • Contribute to new hire training, field communications, and commercial readiness initiatives.

Manage Marketing Execution

  • Manage project plans and day-to-day workstreams for marketing initiatives, tracking milestones, dependencies, and approvals.
  • Coordinate agency and vendor work, providing clear direction and timely feedback to support quality, budget, and schedule expectations.
  • Identify execution risks and bottlenecks, communicate them early, and work with partners to resolve issues.
  • Apply established promotional review, operational, and compliance processes to assigned work.

Partner Across the Commercial Organization

  • Build productive working relationships with HCP Marketing, Patient Marketing, Omnichannel, Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Insights & Analytics, Regulatory, Legal, and Global teams.
  • Partner with field colleagues to understand customer needs and identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.
  • Support launch readiness by delivering assigned marketing materials, field resources, and meeting content to agreed commercial timelines.
  • Contribute to alignment across HCP and patient marketing initiatives and help ensure a connected customer experience.

What We Expect Of You

Basic Qualifications

  • Doctorate degree and 2 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR
  • Master's degree and 4 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR
  • Bachelor's degree and 6 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR
  • Associate's degree and 10 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR
  • High school diploma / GED and 12 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of HCP marketing channels, promotional material development, and Medical, Legal, and Regulatory review processes.
  • Experience coordinating agency partners and external vendors to deliver marketing projects.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines.
  • Ability to collaborate, communicate clearly, and influence partners in a cross functional, matrixed organization.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to high-quality execution.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast paced, high visibility environment.

What you can expect from us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

Job Title: GO virtual tutor

Job Type: Part-Time/Contract

Location: Remote, must be located in the US

This is a remote-eligible role available to candidates residing in most U.S. states.
At this time, we are unable to hire in Ohio, North Dakota, Washington, or Wyoming due to state-specific employer registration requirements.

Snapshot:This is a part-time, virtual tutoring role for candidates based in select East Coast states who can commit to consistent weekday hours. You’ll work with small groups (1–4 students) primarily in math, so it’s a strong fit if you enjoy engaging students online, have solid subject knowledge, and can stick to a fixed weekly schedule. Strong communication and reliability are essential—tutors are expected to proactively communicate schedule changes and consistently follow provided lesson plans to support student progress. Ideal for college students or those with some teaching/tutoring experience looking for steady, short daily shifts during the school semester.

Job Summary

We are looking for dedicated and knowledgeable tutors to provide online academic support to students. The ideal candidate will be passionate about education, skilled in engaging students through virtual platforms, and capable of adapting to different learning styles. Tutors deliver virtual small-group instruction (typically 1-4 students per session) in a supportive virtual environment, leading to a significant increase primarily in math achievement. English Language Arts (ELA) tutoring opportunities may be offered based on the needs and decisions of our partner schools.

We are looking for tutors with a consistent schedule who are available at least 5 hours per week, Monday through Thursday between 8 am-3 pm ET. Schedules will be determined during training and remain consistent throughout the semester.

Fall 2026:

  • Training (asynchronous & synchronous): approx. 20 hours in August
  • Tutoring: September through December, various blocks between 8 am - 3 pm EST

Spring 2027:

  • Training (asynchronous & synchronous): approx. 20 hours in January
  • Tutoring: February through May, various blocks between 8 am - 3 pm EST

Compensation

  • Training: $18/hr payment to be received in a lump sum after the completion of training
  • Tutoring:
    • $18 an hour for new tutors / $20 an hour for experienced tutors
    • $22 per hour for returning GO virtual tutors
    • Payment to be invoiced every 2 weeks, with a 1-week turnaround in payment.
  • A perfect attendance bonus of $200 for tutors who attend all training sessions and tutoring sessions.
  • Fingerprint-based background check required (initial cost of $80–$180 per state paid by the candidate and fully reimbursed in the first paycheck after onboarding, training, and scheduling are complete). We are not able to accept mail in fingerprints and recommend searching for an IdentoGO location near you to confirm that you are able to get fingerprinted in-person.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide virtual tutoring to students in Math and/or English Language Arts (ELA)
  • Review lesson plans and instructional materials in advance to prepare for tutorial sessions
  • Assess student progress and provide constructive feedback
  • Utilize interactive and engaging teaching methods to enhance learning
  • Maintain records of student progress and session outcomes (e.g., online tracking system, reports)
  • Communicate effectively with students and parents via the online platform

Educational Requirements

  • Minimum: enrolled in higher ed or associate degree

Technology Requirements

  • A computer with camera and reliable internet access
  • Quiet space with no distractions or background noise
  • Headphones with microphone capability

Experience and Skills

  • Strong commitment to our students
  • Prior experience in tutoring, teaching, or mentoring is a plus
  • Strong subject knowledge in Math and/or English Language Arts (ELA)
  • Proficient in using virtual learning platforms, online collaboration tools, and digital teaching methods
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Patience, empathy, and the ability to engage students in an online environment
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Laptop or desktop computer, reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment

Interview Plan(beginning May 11th, 2026)

  • Oneway Interview
  • Subject knowledge assessment
  • Letter of Intent (signifying that you are eligible for hire)
  • Offer (contingent on training and onboarding)

Successful candidates are required to complete a fingerprint-based background check. The initial cost, which typically ranges from $80–$180, is paid out of pocket by the candidate. Once the candidate has successfully completed onboarding and training and is officially scheduled to begin tutoring, the cost of the background check will be reimbursed in the candidate’s first paycheck. We are not able to accept mail in fingerprints and recommend searching for an IdentoGO location near you to confirm that you are able to get fingerprinted in-person.

raw.excerpt: A DAY IN THE LIFEServing as a recognized technical leader within the Major Projects Group, the Lead Controls Engineer drives design quality, consistency, and innovation across concurrent projects spanning the wind, solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and gas business unit segments focusing on Controls and Systems Integration Engineering support in development and/or project execution phases.
raw.description:
A DAY IN THE LIFE

Serving as a recognized technical leader within the Major Projects Group, the Lead Controls Engineer drives design quality, consistency, and innovation across concurrent projects spanning the wind, solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and gas business unit segments focusing on Controls and Systems Integration Engineering support in development and/or project execution phases. The Lead Controls Engineer is the overall SCADA and Controls systems architect for large scale multi-technology projects, supports cross-department standards and initiatives, and prioritizes “We over Me” — placing collective success and team development above individual contribution. May lead a team of Senior Engineers, Engineer I/II staff, and CAD Designers, providing technical direction, mentorship, and professional development.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Leads and/or is responsible to provide technical support during the controls engineering lifecycle from pre-award development through design delivery, simulation, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and closeout — with emphasis on robust design development, schedule conformance, and financial impact.
  • Owns the control and data contract between the facility energy controller and third-party power plant controllers; defines the objects, fields, units, update rates, and staleness behavior that cross the boundary in each direction.
  • Defines the sequences of operation executed by the facility energy controller — normal operation, generation shortfall, source transitions, blackstart, and emergency shed — along with the degradation behavior for each.
  • Specifies the point maps, interlocks, and constraint classes that vendors build against; prototypes integrations, tests point maps against live devices, and holds vendors to them through factory (FAT) and site (SAT) acceptance testing.
  • Translates between electrical and software disciplines — turns electrical and generation constraints into requirements software can build, and software and data constraints into terms plant vendors and Engineer of Record (EOR) teams will accept.
  • Proves the controls interface in simulation prior to energization, covering every constraint class and mode transition, and carries that work forward into automated commissioning.
  • Serves as the lead controls engineering point of contact to Owners and EOR teams on submittal milestones, review timelines, procurement deliverables, page turns, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) outreach.
  • Ensures designs satisfy the facility's design requirements through compliance with local, state, and national codes, Owner contracts, and company best practices. Champions a quality-first culture across the team.
  • Supports Basis of Design (BOD) development and RFI management for assigned projects across wind, solar, BESS, and gas scopes focusing on controls and systems integration.
  • Performs drawing and design reviews, including control narratives, point lists, and network architectures, to ensure designs meet industry standards, Blattner's best practices and standards, and support safe work practices in the field; performs constructability and commissionability assessments on complex projects.
  • Validates controls equipment, I/O, and network material takeoffs; coordinates with electrical, protection, and software leads to establish design schedules, resource plans, and cross-discipline coordination across the project portfolio.
  • Performs contract and subcontract reviews and provides technical recommendations; challenges vendor scope and internal assumptions with data rather than opinion. Escalates high-risk issues to leadership as appropriate.
  • Leads coordination with Integrated Supply Chain (ISC), Estimating, and Construction teams on equipment and material selection and approval; partners with program management so field teams have the plans, point maps, and parameters needed to build and commission.
  • Champions change management discipline — ensures scope changes, point list changes, and design deviations are documented, communicated through change narratives, and resolved at the appropriate level. Leads lessons learned sessions and incorporates findings into future work.
  • Mentors, trains, and onboards Senior Engineers and Engineer I/II staff through coaching, feedback, and work product review; supports managers with hiring and promotion decisions.
  • Drives consistency in designs across projects by establishing and enforcing standard control philosophies, point maps, and design details. Leads department initiatives to enhance processes and standards, and sets goals with direct reports.
  • Communicates deliberately, intentionally, and purposefully with Owners, EOR teams, vendors, software and project engineering staff, and other internal stakeholders across all phases of work.
  • Adheres to the company's cultural basics and the National Society of Professional Engineers' code of conduct. Solves problems using factual evidence and sustainable solutions that are safe, transparent, and documentable.
  • Assists with special projects and performs other duties per supervisor's discretion.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering from an ABET-accredited college required, or relevant equivalent industry experience
  • Professional Engineering (PE) license or master’s degree in engineering is preferred.
  • Eight or more years of progressive engineering and/or engineering supervisory experience in a related energy or construction industry (e.g., electrical engineering firms, utilities, or power generation development with area of expertise in the controls engineering, SCADA, and systems integration domain).
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers and driving technical standards. Microgrid, behind-the-meter, and utility-scale generation controls experience across wind, solar, BESS, or gas is strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of utility-scale controls and integration equipment across wind, solar, BESS, and gas generation.
  • Working knowledge of the protocols that move data between machines and systems (MQTT, OPC UA, REST APIs), with the ability to justify selecting one over another for a given application.
  • Ability to read one-line diagrams and panel schedules and determine how protection, breakers, and sources will behave under a fault.
  • Experience designing data contracts between systems (objects, fields, units, update rates, stale-value behavior) and writing control narratives where multiple controllers must agree.
  • Fluency in both the controls and software worlds; ability to turn control requirements into something a software team can build, and to push back on designs that will not survive the field.
  • Effective communication skills (oral, written, listening, and presentation) to work with Owners, EOR firms, vendors, employees, and internal stakeholders.
  • Interpersonal skills — the ability to supervise, influence, and persuade people and groups toward common objectives.
  • Knowledge of engineering science and technology in applying principles, techniques, and equipment to the design of generation facilities; uses logic and reasoning to evaluate alternatives.
  • Excellent organizational, scheduling, and prioritization skills; ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with a drive for results and accountability across the team.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) and Procore
  • Working knowledge, experience, or interest in AI (Artificial Intelligence).
  • Accounting skills — familiarity with math, record-keeping, and cost tracking to manage budgets.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information; may be required to become a qualified individual in pursuit of company contract licensing.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and an acceptable motor vehicle driving record (MVR).
  • Up to 25% travel required, subject to fluctuations as needs dictate.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Microgrid and behind-the-meter controls (grid-forming BESS, PV plant controllers, turbine and genset dispatch); DNP3, IEC 61850 GOOSE, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP; OpenAPI/JSON Schema; automated Level 4 and 5 commissioning.

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

Competitive pay

100% employer paid HDHP insurance premiums for employees

401(k) with company match

HSA and FSA options

Dental and Vision insurance

Education Assistance (Tuition Reimbursement)

Work/Life balance

Employee/Family focused culture

Gym on site

And more!

Blattner is not able to sponsor H-1B visas or permanent residency for this or any position. We are able to consider candidates who hold valid, independent work authorization (e.g., U.S. citizenship, permanent residency, or other valid, non-expired work authorization).

#LI - Remote

$121,680.00 - $176,436.00 Individual Compensation to be determined based on the applicant's applicable experience and qualifications balanced against internal equity.

WHO ARE WE?


With more than 115 years of construction experience, Blattner has played a vital role in building America’s critical infrastructure, ranging from railroads and highways to dams and mines. Since 1997, the company has focused on renewable energy solutions and is responsible for some of the most significant solar, wind and storage projects in the U.S. Today, Blattner has installed over 20% of America’s utility-scale wind, solar and energy storage capacity. Blattner Company is the parent company of Blattner Energy and D.H. Blattner & Sons, of which all are members of the Quanta Services family of companies. Company headquarters are in Avon, Minnesota.


Blattner is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. Blattner will not tolerate discrimination against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental disability, military or veteran status, national origin, physical disability, race, receipt of public assistance, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local laws. This commitment governs all aspects of employment including, but not limited to: hiring, promotion, demotion, transfer, layoff, termination, compensation, discipline, and access to benefits and training. Additionally, Blattner is committed, in accordance with applicable law, to making reasonable accommodations for job applicants and employees based on a qualifying disability, a sincerely held religious belief or practice, and for pregnancy, childbirth or related health conditions. Applicants and employees who feel they have experienced or witnessed discrimination or who wishes to request a reasonable accommodation should contact the Human Resources Department. Blattner prohibits retaliation against any individual for making a complaint under this policy, for opposing discrimination, for participating in an investigation pursuant to this policy, or for requesting a reasonable accommodation.

Data Insight & Innovation Analyst
Remote - UK Based
Our talented people are creating the technology of the future.

From scheduling to maintenance to keeping people safe, 2.7 million people are helped by our software daily. Technology makes it possible; people make it happen and you could be part of that.

The Tracsis Group has grown rapidly, diversifying into related transport technologies, and successfully executing a strategy that has seen it make a total of seventeen acquisitions.

Today Tracsis is a leading provider of software, hardware, data analytics/GIS and services for the rail, traffic data and wider transport industries. The Group has c.550 permanent employees serving its growing customer base from offices in the UK, Ireland and the US.

The Role
Traffic data tells the story of how people and places move. As our Data Insight & Innovation Analyst, you'll transform complex datasets into meaningful insights that help shape transport decisions and future services.

You'll analyse traffic data, uncover actionable insights, explore new technologies and data sources, and create engaging visualisations for clients. Working across multiple teams, you'll help turn data into value and drive innovation across the business.

Crucially, you’ll spot opportunities to unlock more value from data and footage we’ve already collected – uncovering additional insights and services for clients and helping Tracsis grow new revenue streams.

What you will do
  • Deliver high-quality, accurate and reliable traffic survey data outputs in line with client specifications, deadlines and Tracsis standards.
  • Undertake data importing, cleaning, transformation and validation using Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Access, Tracsis AI platforms
  • Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of Tracsis’ data collection methods, advising suitability, accuracy and limitations of different applications.
  • Design, test and document robust methodologies for interpolating, factoring and gap-filling incomplete or missing data.
  • Identify, trial and evaluate new data collection technologies and methods.
  • Develop new and improved ways of presenting data and insight, including visualisations, dashboards and reporting templates.
  • Review existing and archived datasets and footage to identify additional insights, services and upsell opportunities.
  • Lead or support proof-of-concept projects, turning promising ideas into practical, repeatable processes and products.
  • Maintain clear documentation of workflows, methodologies and outputs
  • Communicate and coordinate effectively with UK and international Analysis Teams, Project Managers and wider stakeholders
  • Adhere to internal policies, procedures and data management protocols, including data protection requirements relating to video footage.

What you'll bring:
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with large, complex datasets.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, validate data and develop robust solutions where information is incomplete or imperfect.
  • A solid understanding of data quality, validation techniques and core statistical principles.
  • The ability to turn complex data into clear, engaging reports, visualisations and insights for a range of audiences.
  • Excellent attention to detail, ensuring outputs are accurate, reliable and defensible.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Commercial awareness and the ability to identify opportunities to create additional value from data and insights.
  • Experience working collaboratively across cross-functional and international teams.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Enthusiasm for AI, automation and emerging technologies

Desirable
  • Previous experience in traffic or transport survey data analysis or reporting.
  • Experience with data visualisation or BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and/or GIS software (e.g., QGIS, ArcGIS).
  • Knowledge of programming or database tools (e.g., Python, R, SQL).
  • A degree in a numerate discipline such as Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Geography, Engineering or Transport Planning.

Our values We’re guided by four core values that shape how we work and collaborate:
Progression – continually improving and developing
Integrity – doing the right thing, always
Collaboration – working together to achieve more
Ownership – taking responsibility and delivering with accountability

Benefits:

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Management of Loss Prevention Programs

  • Develop and maintain strong, athlete-focused relationships with store operations, human resources, visual, service & selling, facilities, and field leadership partners.

  • Implement, coordinate, and manage all aspects of the Loss Prevention program.

  • Assist store and field leaders with development of shrink reduction plans specific for each store and work to support adherence, measure performance, and management of plans.

  • Educate and elevate awareness of root causes of shrink and how teammates can reduce shrink through company programs and resources at all levels – from hourly teammates to field/CSC leadership.

  • Analyze key metrics and dashboards to identify potential operational deficiencies, awareness opportunities, or equipment issues that are hindering shrink reduction, develop strategies for remediation.

  • Support area of responsibility through active communication, conference calls and meeting participation.

  • Identify and address safety concerns and foster a safety-conscious culture among frontline teammates.

  • Complete new store security, alarm, video system reviews and provide appropriate system signoffs for security vendors.

  • Support the needs of the business.

Crisis, Emergency Events / External Event Response

  • Monitor, react and report significant / critical incidents within area of responsibility and as directed.

  • Support special events and incidents which may include providing or supplementing security coverage or coordinating contract services.

  • Establish and coordinate post incident response such as garnering resources, partnering with emergency first responders and communicating efforts with the CSC as needed.

Investigations Support

  • Work directly with supporting Field Investigations Manager for internal investigations support.

  • Support internal and external investigations in areas of responsibility based on regional trends, exception reporting, tips, or cases generated cases by company investigators.

  • Promote teammate awareness of internal theft and generation of tips through education of store teammates and the development of personal connections during store visits, training sessions, and virtual webinars.

  • Identify stores with low incident reporting to support education on elevating awareness related to theft identification, deterrence, and reporting.

  • Respond to theft events to ensure proper procedure, law enforcement engagement, help investigate losses, correct inventory, etc

  • Delivery of physical evidence to law enforcement.

  • Address external case errors and missing information used to deploy assets to stores.

  • Developed networks of law enforcement, retailer investigators in each market.

  • Attended court hearings for prosecuted cases.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage and mentor teams of highly skilled engineers, define methodologies, and deliver complex projects from research to high-volume manufacturing

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • A known pioneer in any industry standard high speed signaling technology

Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Grad Intern – R&D Execution, Strategy & Operations (Summer 2027)

What You Will Do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. We have multiple openings for graduate level students to further their educational goals. This internship will be approximately 12 weeks and includes both project-based and experiential learning. The intern will be an integral member of the R&D Execution, Strategy & Operations (R&D EOS) organization, which is focused on driving innovation beyond the molecule and applying digital (and other) strategies to simplify processes. The 4 functional areas within R&D EOS are:

  • Strategy: Powering-up industry-leading R&D through strategy, functional transformation, and performance excellence
  • Portfolio & Program Management: Turning product strategy into execution to bring medicines to patients faster 
  • R&D Business Operations: Innovating excellence and navigating efficiency to manage R&D operational activities, including budget planning and contracting, suppliers, laboratories, workforce strategy and environmental, social & governance (ESG)
  • R&D Knowledge & Learning: Transforming and advancing digitization and contemporized learning as well as cultivating talent & culture for a people-centric and inclusive workforce

As a member of Amgen's R&D EOS organization, your work will be highly collaborative across multiple functions and levels within Amgen, including, Research & Development, Chief Medical Office, Chief Technology Office, Quality & Compliance, and others. You will be uniquely responsible for one or more key projects that will advance R&D EOS’ mission, including the following:

  • Supporting a project within one of our functional areas
  • Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams on projects and/or programs that strive to improve R&D’s competitiveness through speed, agility and excellence in execution
  • Leveraging your analytical, leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to work in teams, identify problems, conduct research, develop recommendations through qualitative and quantitative analysis, and deliver final projects
  • Presenting your deliverables/findings through various forums including an intern-wide poster session and a final readout to executive management
  • Engaging in learning activities, networking with colleagues across the company, and enjoying full access to Amgen’s Employee Resource Groups

This description serves as a general outline for the responsibilities of a graduate intern in R&D EOS. The specific tasks and requirements may vary depending on the nature of the project.

Program Eligibility Requirements

  • Must be available to work a full-time schedule
  • Expected continued enrollment in an accredited college or university following the internship program / co-op
  • Student must be located in the United States for the duration of the internship program

What We Expect of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The collaborative individual we seek is hard-working with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

Amgen requires that all individuals applying for a grad internship or a co-op assignment at Amgen must meet the following criteria:

  • 18 years or older
  • Graduated with a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
  • Currently enrolled in an MBA program for an MBA internship OR a Master’s program for a Master’s internship OR a PharmD program for a PharmD internship OR Ph.D. for a PhD internship from an accredited college or university and completion of the first year of MBA OR Master’s OR Pharm D OR Ph.D. program before the internship starts

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Degree concentration(s) in Business, Finance, Management Sciences, Life Sciences, Engineering, Communications, Psychology, Human Resources, or a similar field
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical and organized, with the ability to synthesize information from different sources and manage tasks and deadlines
  • Enthusiastic, proactive, and a willingness to learn
  • Adaptability in navigating and effectively responding to ambiguity and evolving circumstances and priorities
  • Basic understanding of project management concepts is a plus

What You Can Expect of Us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The base pay range for this opportunity in the U.S. is $35.34 - $41.20 per hour.

  • Build a network of colleagues that will endure and grow throughout your time with us and beyond.
  • Bring your authentic self to the table and become the professional you’re inspired to be through accepting a culture that values the diversity of thought and experience and will flex to your strengths and possibilities.
  • Participate in executive and social networking events, as well as community volunteer projects.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

Application deadline

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.

Sponsorship

Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. for the duration of this program. Sponsorship for future FTE roles is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

raw.title: Senior Director, Global Commercial Development
raw.excerpt: Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers.
raw.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Executive Director, Global Commercial Development – Pancreatic Cancer, this role will lead global commercial strategy and lifecycle development for the pancreatic cancer portfolio. This job description is across numerous positions, including daraxonrasib and zoldonrasib and future pipeline candidates, supporting opportunities in first-line metastatic, locally advanced, perioperative, and adjuvant disease, as well as future indications. This leader will translate evolving clinical evidence, patient and biomarker insights, and competitive dynamics into integrated global commercial strategies, portfolio investment recommendations, and stage-appropriate launch readiness. The role requires strong cross-functional leadership and close alignment with existing asset and indication teams.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

  • Own integrated pancreatic portfolio strategy: Lead global commercial development across therapeutic and pancreatic cancer settings; connect indication strategies to overall portfolio value.

  • Guide indication and lifecycle prioritization: Evaluate clinical and commercial opportunities, unmet need, competitive differentiation, treatment sequencing, and investment trade-offs; present clear recommendations for development and governance decisions.

  • Build treatment-setting strategies: Develop differentiated commercial hypotheses for first-line treatment, locally advanced disease, surgical/perioperative pathways, and adjuvant therapy, recognizing distinct patient journeys, customers, and evidence requirements.

  • Integrate asset and combination positioning: Partner with relevant product teams to shape complementary daraxonrasib and zoldonrasib strategies, including biomarker-defined populations, potential combination approaches, and implications of future portfolio evolution.

  • Lead patient and market forecasting: Develop global epidemiology, treatment-flow and patient-segmentation models, revenue scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and commercial value assessments across the continuum of pancreatic cancer care.

  • Shape clinical development through a commercial lens: Collaborate with Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, HEOR, and Market Access on target populations, meaningful endpoints, duration of therapy, standards of care, and evidence needed for future adoption.

  • Advance biomarker and patient-identification strategy: Work with Precision Medicine and Diagnostics on RAS/KRAS testing, KRAS G12D-defined populations, laboratory and referral workflows, accessibility, and the commercial implications of molecularly guided care.

  • Connect the multidisciplinary ecosystem: Build a unified commercial understanding of oncologists, pancreatic surgeons, gastroenterologists, radiologists, pathologists, multidisciplinary tumor boards, academic centers, and community settings, in partnership with Medical Affairs and existing engagement teams.

  • Align with cross-portfolio leaders: Coordinate with established first-line/metastatic teams, regional affiliates, and global brand teams to share insights and ensure best in class launches.

  • Prepare for future launches and expansions: Develop stage-gated global commercialization frameworks, value propositions, brand positioning, affiliate readiness, access and customer-pathway assumptions, and launch scenarios for the U.S. and global markets.

  • Track market evolution and performance: Monitor scientific milestones, competing programs, diagnostic adoption, treatment patterns, and commercial assumptions; adjust strategic plans and forecasts as evidence and investment decisions evolve.

  • Lead execution and influence: Guide cross-functional working teams, agencies, market research and analytics partners; communicate succinctly with senior leaders and governance forums and apply innovative digital and data-driven approaches.

  • Up to 40% of travel required.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree with at least 15 years, or advanced degree with at least 8 years, of progressive commercial experience in a biotechnology and/or pharmaceutical company, including strategic marketing and ideally sales.

  • Proven success developing global oncology commercial strategies across products, indications, or stages of disease and influencing complex cross-functional product teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop patient and revenue forecasts, interpret market and clinical insights, and evaluate strategic trade-offs that inform portfolio investment decisions.

  • Strong leadership, ability to build high-performing teams and partnerships, and ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills and the ability to deliver high-quality strategic work under evolving timelines.

  • Strong clinical and scientific acumen; ability to translate emerging clinical evidence, trial design, and oncology treatment pathways into commercial implications.

  • Excellent executive communication, presentation, and external stakeholder engagement skills.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and commitment to improving outcomes for people with cancer.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in pancreatic or other gastrointestinal cancers, including first-line metastatic and earlier-stage treatment settings.

  • Experience with precision oncology, KRAS/RAS-targeted medicines, molecular testing, or biomarker-defined patient populations.

  • Experience developing global commercial strategies for oncology launches, indication expansion, or lifecycle management.

  • Familiarity with oncology care pathways and patient journeys in pancreatic cancer.

  • Experience working in a rapidly growing biotechnology company and partnering with global and regional commercial organizations.

Staples is building the future of Marketplace through practical, AI-enabled solutions that help teams work smarter, move faster, and create measurable business impact. The Marketplace organization sits at the intersection of product, commercial strategy, operations, and technology—solving complex challenges that directly support growth, efficiency, and customer experience.

As the Senior AI Solution Architect, you will be a business-embedded technical leader responsible for identifying, shaping, and rapidly delivering AI-enabled solutions to high-value operational and commercial challenges. This is a hands-on builder role—not a traditional roadmap-bound engineering role and not a sales or demo function. You will work directly with Marketplace leaders, product managers, commercial teams, Technology, and Data/AI partners to uncover real-world inefficiencies, translate ambiguous problems into structured technical approaches, and develop working solution pathways that can be validated, scaled, and operationalized.

This role is preferred to work out of our Framingham, MA HQ facility but we are open to 100% remote work with travel as needed.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Embed within Marketplace operations, product, and commercial teams to understand end-to-end workflows, undocumented processes, edge cases, and operational nuances.
  • Identify, define, and prioritize AI and automation opportunities based on business impact, scalability, and feasibility.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into structured technical approaches, solution hypotheses, and build plans.
  • Develop and deploy rapid prototypes or proof of concepts using internal platforms, enterprise data, and modern AI/ML and large language model tooling.
  • Validate solutions using real-world data and workflows to demonstrate measurable business value.
  • Partner with Technology and Data/AI teams to transition validated prototypes into scalable, production-ready solutions.
  • Serve as a critical bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring clarity of requirements and continuity of context.
  • Drive adoption of deployed solutions by staying engaged through rollout, iteration, and performance measurement.
  • Establish and track success metrics tied to business outcomes such as efficiency gains, cost reduction, revenue impact, and user adoption.
  • Contribute reusable learnings, frameworks, and enhancements to enterprise platforms based on field insights.
  • Lead or coordinate multiple concurrent, high-impact initiatives with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Mentor less experienced team members and contribute to capability building within the forward-deployed function.

What you bring to the table:

  • Strong problem-framing and critical-thinking skills, especially in ambiguous environments where the path forward is not predefined.
  • A builder mindset with the curiosity and ownership to move from problem discovery to working solution quickly.
  • Ability to connect technical solutions to clear business outcomes and communicate impact in practical terms.
  • Effective stakeholder engagement across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Adaptability and comfort operating in rapidly evolving technology and business environments.
  • Collaborative approach with the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Clear, concise communication skills across all organizational levels, including senior leadership.
  • Business acumen and judgment to balance value, feasibility, scalability, and adoption.

What’s needed- Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, a related technical field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering or technical solution development.
  • Experience building and deploying AI, machine learning, automation, or data-driven solutions in a business or enterprise environment.
  • Experience writing code and delivering working prototypes using modern programming languages such as Python, Java, or similar.
  • Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions in partnership with business stakeholders.
  • Experience delivering solutions from concept through prototype validation.
  • Experience integrating or working with structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Experience managing multiple complex projects or initiatives simultaneously.

What’s needed- Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or advanced technical training.
  • Experience in eCommerce, marketplaces, retail, or adjacent industries.
  • Experience implementing AI or automation solutions within large, matrixed enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with enterprise data platforms, cloud environments, and modern AI/LLM tooling ecosystems.
  • Experience working at the intersection of business units and centralized technology or data organizations.
  • Experience contributing to or enhancing reusable platforms, frameworks, or internal tools.
  • Prior experience in a forward-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or similar business-embedded technical role.
  • Experience quantifying and communicating the business impact of technical solutions.

We Offer:

  • Inclusive culture with associate-led Business Resource Groups
  • 22 days of PTO and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays + 1 floating holiday)
  • Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more!

Bring clarity and confidence to regional reporting. As our Regional Accountant, you’ll help North American entities deliver complete, accurate, and compliant results. You’ll bring together period-end review, variance analysis, tax compliance, and intercompany reconciliation to keep portfolio reporting on track.

Work Setup: Work From Home primarily, on a night shift schedule

Role Overview

You’ll be the finance link between regional Business Units (BUs) and the Portfolio Reporting Consolidation Manager, reviewing close deliverables, resolving reporting issues, and flagging risks early. Your regional focus includes US state sales and use tax (economic nexus), Canadian GST/HST/PST, US federal and state income tax returns, Canadian corporate returns, and provincial filings.

• Connect Regional Teams: Act as the main contact between the Portfolio Reporting Consolidation Manager and regional BUs, communicate reporting timetables, templates, and requirements, and follow up outstanding deliverables.

• Review Period-End Results: Check month-end, quarter-end, and year-end submissions for completeness, accuracy, and consistency with portfolio policies, resolving review points within close deadlines.

• Investigate Variances: Analyse unusual balances and movements, obtain supporting evidence from BUs, and flag potential misstatements and judgement areas to the Portfolio Reporting Consolidation Manager and Sub-Portfolio Finance Lead.

• Support Tax Compliance: Support BUs and external tax advisors with the preparation, review, and lodgement of indirect tax and income tax returns, including GST, VAT, and US sales tax where applicable. Respond to information requests and maintain a regional filing calendar.

• Reconcile Intercompany Balances: Check balances each period, resolve mismatches with counterparties across regions, and escalate outstanding differences before consolidation deadlines.

• Monitor Regulatory Changes: Stay current with local accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements, highlighting changes and their initial impact to the Portfolio Reporting Consolidation Manager and Director of GRC.

• Review OneStream Reconciliations: Confirm work papers and supporting documentation agree with balance sheet balances. Report concerns to the Portfolio Reporting Consolidation Manager, copying the relevant Sub-Portfolio Finance Leads.

• Support Portfolio Projects: Assist with system implementations, acquisition onboarding, process improvements, and other duties consistent with the role.

Skills & Experience

• Capability in period-end financial review, variance analysis, and intercompany reconciliation.

• Knowledge of US state sales and use tax, including economic nexus, and Canadian GST/HST/PST.

• Understanding of US federal and state income tax returns, Canadian corporate returns, and provincial filings.

• Ability to review OneStream reconciliations and validate supporting work papers against balance sheet balances.

• Clear communication and coordination skills when working with BU finance teams, portfolio stakeholders, and external tax advisors.

• Strong attention to accuracy, reporting deadlines, issue resolution, and changes in regional accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements.

What’s in It for You

  • Recognised by Great Place To Work:Ranked #8 Best Workplace in the Philippines and #3 Best Workplace in IT-BPM in the Medium category for 2026.

  • Room to Grow:Structured onboarding and ongoing Learning & Development programs that help employees build skills, strengthen capability and prepare for broader responsibilities.

  • Health Cover From Day 1:Health insurance coverage from Day 1 plus dependent coverage, giving employees and their families added peace of mind from the start.

  • Clear Pay, Clear Expectations:Compensation aligned with the role and experience, supported by clear responsibilities and expectations from the outset.

  • Work That Connects You to the Client:Work directly with international businesses as part of a dedicated team that operates as an extension of their business.

  • Support Beyond Day 1: Our People & Culture and support teams stay involved beyond onboarding, providing day-to-day guidance, employee support, engagement and recognition throughout the employee experience.

Plus the everyday extras: Modern workspaces, complimentary onsite meals, flowing coffee and drinks at our café bar, additional time off and tenure incentives.

About Us
At hammerjack, we connect skilled professionals in the Philippines with growing businesses across Australia and beyond—building teams that work as true extensions of our clients. We're proud to be named among the Fortune 100 Best Workplaces in Southeast Asia and ranked the 8th Best Workplace in the Philippines.

Our Impact
Our people aren't outsourced—they're embedded. With aligned tools, shared goals, and real accountability, they deliver at the same standard and pace as onshore teams while building long-term careers they're proud of, across accounting, tech, admin, and marketing.

At Amgen, if you feel like you are a part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
