Working closely with marketing leadership and cross-functional partners, this role will translate customer insights and brand priorities into coordinated, multichannel initiatives that support field engagement, campaign activation, and launch readiness.

Develop and Execute HCP Marketing Programs

raw.description:
A DAY IN THE LIFE

Serving as a recognized technical leader within the Major Projects Group, the Lead Controls Engineer drives design quality, consistency, and innovation across concurrent projects spanning the wind, solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and gas business unit segments focusing on Controls and Systems Integration Engineering support in development and/or project execution phases. The Lead Controls Engineer is the overall SCADA and Controls systems architect for large scale multi-technology projects, supports cross-department standards and initiatives, and prioritizes “We over Me” — placing collective success and team development above individual contribution. May lead a team of Senior Engineers, Engineer I/II staff, and CAD Designers, providing technical direction, mentorship, and professional development.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Leads and/or is responsible to provide technical support during the controls engineering lifecycle from pre-award development through design delivery, simulation, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and closeout — with emphasis on robust design development, schedule conformance, and financial impact.
  • Owns the control and data contract between the facility energy controller and third-party power plant controllers; defines the objects, fields, units, update rates, and staleness behavior that cross the boundary in each direction.
  • Defines the sequences of operation executed by the facility energy controller — normal operation, generation shortfall, source transitions, blackstart, and emergency shed — along with the degradation behavior for each.
  • Specifies the point maps, interlocks, and constraint classes that vendors build against; prototypes integrations, tests point maps against live devices, and holds vendors to them through factory (FAT) and site (SAT) acceptance testing.
  • Translates between electrical and software disciplines — turns electrical and generation constraints into requirements software can build, and software and data constraints into terms plant vendors and Engineer of Record (EOR) teams will accept.
  • Proves the controls interface in simulation prior to energization, covering every constraint class and mode transition, and carries that work forward into automated commissioning.
  • Serves as the lead controls engineering point of contact to Owners and EOR teams on submittal milestones, review timelines, procurement deliverables, page turns, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) outreach.
  • Ensures designs satisfy the facility's design requirements through compliance with local, state, and national codes, Owner contracts, and company best practices. Champions a quality-first culture across the team.
  • Supports Basis of Design (BOD) development and RFI management for assigned projects across wind, solar, BESS, and gas scopes focusing on controls and systems integration.
  • Performs drawing and design reviews, including control narratives, point lists, and network architectures, to ensure designs meet industry standards, Blattner's best practices and standards, and support safe work practices in the field; performs constructability and commissionability assessments on complex projects.
  • Validates controls equipment, I/O, and network material takeoffs; coordinates with electrical, protection, and software leads to establish design schedules, resource plans, and cross-discipline coordination across the project portfolio.
  • Performs contract and subcontract reviews and provides technical recommendations; challenges vendor scope and internal assumptions with data rather than opinion. Escalates high-risk issues to leadership as appropriate.
  • Leads coordination with Integrated Supply Chain (ISC), Estimating, and Construction teams on equipment and material selection and approval; partners with program management so field teams have the plans, point maps, and parameters needed to build and commission.
  • Champions change management discipline — ensures scope changes, point list changes, and design deviations are documented, communicated through change narratives, and resolved at the appropriate level. Leads lessons learned sessions and incorporates findings into future work.
  • Mentors, trains, and onboards Senior Engineers and Engineer I/II staff through coaching, feedback, and work product review; supports managers with hiring and promotion decisions.
  • Drives consistency in designs across projects by establishing and enforcing standard control philosophies, point maps, and design details. Leads department initiatives to enhance processes and standards, and sets goals with direct reports.
  • Communicates deliberately, intentionally, and purposefully with Owners, EOR teams, vendors, software and project engineering staff, and other internal stakeholders across all phases of work.
  • Adheres to the company's cultural basics and the National Society of Professional Engineers' code of conduct. Solves problems using factual evidence and sustainable solutions that are safe, transparent, and documentable.
  • Assists with special projects and performs other duties per supervisor's discretion.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering from an ABET-accredited college required, or relevant equivalent industry experience
  • Professional Engineering (PE) license or master’s degree in engineering is preferred.
  • Eight or more years of progressive engineering and/or engineering supervisory experience in a related energy or construction industry (e.g., electrical engineering firms, utilities, or power generation development with area of expertise in the controls engineering, SCADA, and systems integration domain).
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers and driving technical standards. Microgrid, behind-the-meter, and utility-scale generation controls experience across wind, solar, BESS, or gas is strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of utility-scale controls and integration equipment across wind, solar, BESS, and gas generation.
  • Working knowledge of the protocols that move data between machines and systems (MQTT, OPC UA, REST APIs), with the ability to justify selecting one over another for a given application.
  • Ability to read one-line diagrams and panel schedules and determine how protection, breakers, and sources will behave under a fault.
  • Experience designing data contracts between systems (objects, fields, units, update rates, stale-value behavior) and writing control narratives where multiple controllers must agree.
  • Fluency in both the controls and software worlds; ability to turn control requirements into something a software team can build, and to push back on designs that will not survive the field.
  • Effective communication skills (oral, written, listening, and presentation) to work with Owners, EOR firms, vendors, employees, and internal stakeholders.
  • Interpersonal skills — the ability to supervise, influence, and persuade people and groups toward common objectives.
  • Knowledge of engineering science and technology in applying principles, techniques, and equipment to the design of generation facilities; uses logic and reasoning to evaluate alternatives.
  • Excellent organizational, scheduling, and prioritization skills; ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with a drive for results and accountability across the team.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) and Procore
  • Working knowledge, experience, or interest in AI (Artificial Intelligence).
  • Accounting skills — familiarity with math, record-keeping, and cost tracking to manage budgets.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information; may be required to become a qualified individual in pursuit of company contract licensing.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and an acceptable motor vehicle driving record (MVR).
  • Up to 25% travel required, subject to fluctuations as needs dictate.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Microgrid and behind-the-meter controls (grid-forming BESS, PV plant controllers, turbine and genset dispatch); DNP3, IEC 61850 GOOSE, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP; OpenAPI/JSON Schema; automated Level 4 and 5 commissioning.

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

Competitive pay

100% employer paid HDHP insurance premiums for employees

401(k) with company match

HSA and FSA options

Dental and Vision insurance

Education Assistance (Tuition Reimbursement)

Work/Life balance

Employee/Family focused culture

Gym on site

And more!

Blattner is not able to sponsor H-1B visas or permanent residency for this or any position. We are able to consider candidates who hold valid, independent work authorization (e.g., U.S. citizenship, permanent residency, or other valid, non-expired work authorization).

WHO ARE WE?


With more than 115 years of construction experience, Blattner has played a vital role in building America’s critical infrastructure, ranging from railroads and highways to dams and mines. Since 1997, the company has focused on renewable energy solutions and is responsible for some of the most significant solar, wind and storage projects in the U.S. Today, Blattner has installed over 20% of America’s utility-scale wind, solar and energy storage capacity. Blattner Company is the parent company of Blattner Energy and D.H. Blattner & Sons, of which all are members of the Quanta Services family of companies. Company headquarters are in Avon, Minnesota.

Additionally, Blattner is committed, in accordance with applicable law, to making reasonable accommodations for job applicants and employees based on a qualifying disability, a sincerely held religious belief or practice, and for pregnancy, childbirth or related health conditions. Data Insight & Innovation Analyst
Remote - UK Based
Our talented people are creating the technology of the future.

From scheduling to maintenance to keeping people safe, 2.7 million people are helped by our software daily. Technology makes it possible; people make it happen and you could be part of that.

The Tracsis Group has grown rapidly, diversifying into related transport technologies, and successfully executing a strategy that has seen it make a total of seventeen acquisitions.

Today Tracsis is a leading provider of software, hardware, data analytics/GIS and services for the rail, traffic data and wider transport industries. The Group has c.550 permanent employees serving its growing customer base from offices in the UK, Ireland and the US.

The Role
Traffic data tells the story of how people and places move. As our Data Insight & Innovation Analyst, you'll transform complex datasets into meaningful insights that help shape transport decisions and future services.

You'll analyse traffic data, uncover actionable insights, explore new technologies and data sources, and create engaging visualisations for clients. Working across multiple teams, you'll help turn data into value and drive innovation across the business.

Crucially, you’ll spot opportunities to unlock more value from data and footage we’ve already collected – uncovering additional insights and services for clients and helping Tracsis grow new revenue streams.

What you will do
  • Deliver high-quality, accurate and reliable traffic survey data outputs in line with client specifications, deadlines and Tracsis standards.
  • Undertake data importing, cleaning, transformation and validation using Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Access, Tracsis AI platforms
  • Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of Tracsis’ data collection methods, advising suitability, accuracy and limitations of different applications.
  • Design, test and document robust methodologies for interpolating, factoring and gap-filling incomplete or missing data.
  • Identify, trial and evaluate new data collection technologies and methods.
  • Develop new and improved ways of presenting data and insight, including visualisations, dashboards and reporting templates.
  • Review existing and archived datasets and footage to identify additional insights, services and upsell opportunities.
  • Lead or support proof-of-concept projects, turning promising ideas into practical, repeatable processes and products.
  • Maintain clear documentation of workflows, methodologies and outputs
  • Communicate and coordinate effectively with UK and international Analysis Teams, Project Managers and wider stakeholders
  • Adhere to internal policies, procedures and data management protocols, including data protection requirements relating to video footage.

What you'll bring:
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with large, complex datasets.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, validate data and develop robust solutions where information is incomplete or imperfect.
  • A solid understanding of data quality, validation techniques and core statistical principles.
  • The ability to turn complex data into clear, engaging reports, visualisations and insights for a range of audiences.
  • Excellent attention to detail, ensuring outputs are accurate, reliable and defensible.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Commercial awareness and the ability to identify opportunities to create additional value from data and insights.
  • Experience working collaboratively across cross-functional and international teams.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Enthusiasm for AI, automation and emerging technologies

Desirable
  • Previous experience in traffic or transport survey data analysis or reporting.
  • Experience with data visualisation or BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and/or GIS software (e.g., QGIS, ArcGIS).
  • Knowledge of programming or database tools (e.g., Python, R, SQL).
  • A degree in a numerate discipline such as Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Geography, Engineering or Transport Planning.

Our values We’re guided by four core values that shape how we work and collaborate:
Progression – continually improving and developing
Integrity – doing the right thing, always
Collaboration – working together to achieve more
Ownership – taking responsibility and delivering with accountability

Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Poland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Poland. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

raw.description:
Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Poland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Poland. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

About Fello:

Fello is a profitable, hyper-growth, VC-backed B2B SaaS company building the agentic real estate platform of the future.

Our platform combines data intelligence, marketing automation, and conversational AI to help real estate teams engage smarter and scale faster. At the center of it is Felix, our AI teammate, which takes real work off a team's plate — running follow-up across calls, texts, and emails today, with more of the team's day-to-day work coming next.

We're not another tool in the stack. We're the system that powers it — learning, adapting, and executing in real time so teams can focus on growth, not guesswork.

If you're excited about building an AI product that's changing how an entire industry works, you'll fit right in.

About You:

You’re a customer-focused, technically curious problem solver who enjoys understanding how technology works and helping customers achieve meaningful results.

You combine strong communication skills with an analytical mindset, allowing you to investigate challenges, identify solutions, and translate complex information into actionable recommendations.

You understand that delivering customer value goes beyond building relationships. It’s about helping customers effectively leverage technology, optimize their workflows, and achieve measurable business outcomes.

You thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment where technology, AI, and customer needs are constantly changing.

You Will:

  • Drive customer value and retention – Help customers maximize their investment in Fello by driving product adoption, improving utilization, and supporting long-term success.
  • Demonstrate measurable customer success – Leverage platform analytics, engagement metrics, and performance data to demonstrate ROI, identify opportunities for improvement, and reinforce the value of Fello.
  • Be a technical, solution-focused partner – Investigate customer challenges, troubleshoot platform issues, identify potential root causes, and drive solutions through resolution, collaborating with technical teams when needed.
  • Optimize AI-powered workflows – Help customers effectively leverage Fello’s AI capabilities, automation, integrations, and platform configurations to improve efficiency and performance.
  • Provide strategic guidance and coaching – Understand customer business operations, identify process inefficiencies, and recommend practical changes that improve results.
  • Proactively manage customer health – Monitor adoption, engagement, and performance trends to identify risks early and implement strategies that reduce churn.
  • Collaborate and advocate – Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, and other internal teams to address customer needs, share actionable feedback, and improve the overall customer experience.

You Have:

  • Proven experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a related customer-facing SaaS role.
  • Strong technical aptitude with hands-on experience navigating SaaS platforms, CRM systems, integrations, and automation technologies.
  • Analytical and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and recommend effective solutions.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered technologies and their application in improving business processes and workflows.
  • The ability to interpret customer data, product analytics, and performance metrics to develop actionable recommendations.
  • A consultative approach to customer relationships, with the ability to understand business needs and influence positive outcomes.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nontechnical audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills, a proactive ownership mindset, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting AI-powered SaaS products, particularly within real estate technology or marketing automation.
  • Knowledge of real estate industry operations, sales workflows, and CRM best practices.
  • Experience troubleshooting software integrations, data synchronization, or automated workflows, with familiarity in tools such as Zapier, API Nation, and custom email domain configurations being a plus.
  • A demonstrated track record of improving customer retention, product adoption, or measurable business outcomes.

Our Benefits:

  • Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary and benefits package.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Fully remote work with flexible hours to promote work-life balance.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
  • Paid Time Off: Generous PTO and paid holidays to recharge and relax.
  • Collaborative Culture: A supportive team environment that values innovation and collaboration.
  • Equity Options: Opportunity to own a part of Fello and share in our success.

raw.title: Account Executive (Inbound Closer) – Ecommerce Agency, Remote
raw.excerpt: Chronos has closed new business the same way for nine years: the founder takes the calls.
raw.description:
Chronos has closed new business the same way for nine years: the founder takes the calls. This seat changes that. You'll run discovery and proposal calls on inbound and referral leads, work from a documented playbook, and carry your own number. There is no cold prospecting in this job.

About Chronos

Chronos Agency runs retention marketing (email, SMS, and push) for direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands. We're in our ninth year and have worked with more than 600 brands. Our buyers are founders and marketing leaders in the US, UK, Australia, and Europe. We sell the same way we deliver: we find where a brand's retention setup is leaking revenue, put a number on it, and prescribe the fix.

This is our first dedicated closer seat. The discovery framework, the word-for-word scripts, and the call library the founder built are all documented and ready for you. The CEO keeps the largest and most complex deals. You take the rest, report directly to the CEO, and work daily with our sales operations lead and our marketing team.

What You'll Own
  • Execute discovery and proposal calls using our documented framework and scripts to maintain high conversion standards.
  • Maximize show rates by contacting new bookings within minutes to confirm appointments and build prospect intent.
  • Manage the end-to-end follow-up process in HubSpot, ensuring every call concludes with a clear, dated next step.
  • Drive account expansion by supporting account managers with seasonal upgrade packages and campaign tiers for existing clients.
  • Collaborate on deal scoping and pricing while providing marketing with feedback on lead quality from the front line.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven track record with 2–5+ years closing B2B deals, preferably in agency services or ecommerce SaaS.
  • Expertise in consultative selling and discovery frameworks such as SPIN or Sandler.
  • Exceptional verbal English skills with the ability to communicate effectively with global founders.
  • Availability to work within South African or similar time zones for optimal overlap with UK, US, and AU markets.
  • High coachability and commitment to following a documented playbook while implementing feedback from reviews.
  • Diligent CRM hygiene, maintaining accurate deal stages and data in HubSpot independently.
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo or retention marketing economics is highly advantageous.
How You'll Be Measured

Your job is to turn inbound and warm pipeline into new clients predictably, so closing runs on a system instead of on the founder being in the room. The scorecard is explicit from day one:

  • Targeted close rate on inbound opportunities with a formal performance review at 90 days.
  • Show rate excellence: 15-minute response time for bookings and a minimum 75% attendance rate.
  • Commitment to next steps: All calls ending with a confirmed, dated follow-up action.
  • Data integrity: Real-time accuracy of deal values and sources within HubSpot.
  • Price integrity: Consistent adherence to established pricing tiers and packaging.
Your First 90 Days
  1. Days 1–30: Onboarding & Shadowing — Master sales playbooks, scripts, and HubSpot hygiene. Shadow live calls and assume responsibility for show-rate management. Conduct initial discovery calls with CEO supervision.
  2. Days 31–60: Pipeline Ownership — Execute discovery calls independently and lead proposal sessions. Manage the full follow-up pipeline and participate in weekly performance reviews of call recordings.
  3. Days 61–90: Full Autonomy — Achieve full solo status on all warm and inbound deals. Meet close-rate targets to unlock additional lead sources and expanded quota responsibilities.

Please review the job details below.

Lanteris Space LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Intuitive Machines, is hiring a Security Automation Engineer to design, implement, and maintain security controls and automation across our platform infrastructure. This role can be based in our Palo Alto, CA office or remotely in the US. You will work with Cilium/Tetragon for runtime security, Kyverno for policy enforcement, Wiz for cloud security posture management, and implement vulnerability management and software supply-chain security practices.

As a member of our platform team, you'll enforce security policies in Kubernetes environments, automate security controls, ensure CMCC Level 2 and ITAR compliance, manage vulnerability remediation workflows, and protect the software supply chain that supports spacecraft development and mission operations.

Intuitive Machines is a leading space infrastructure company that builds spacecraft, connects networks, and operates infrastructure-as-a-service for commercial, civil, and national security customers. With a proven track record across the space domain, the Company, through organic growth and portfolio expansion, has built over 300 spacecraft, delivered over 260 kilograms of payload to the lunar surface, and provided precision navigation expertise that has guided spacecraft across our solar system.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design and implement runtime security controls using Cilium for network policies and Tetragon for eBPF-based security observability and enforcement
  • Develop and maintain Kyverno policies for Kubernetes admission control, resource validation, and security policy enforcement
  • Configure and manage Wiz for cloud security posture management, vulnerability scanning, and compliance monitoring across AWS environments
  • Implement and maintain vulnerability management programs including scanning, prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting
  • Design and enforce software supply-chain security controls including container image signing, SBOM generation, and artifact verification
  • Automate security workflows including vulnerability remediation, policy enforcement, and compliance reporting
  • Monitor security events and alerts from Cilium, Tetragon, Wiz, and other security tools
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines
  • Ensure compliance with CMMC Level 2, ITAR, and NIST 800-171 security requirements
  • Conduct security assessments of infrastructure and applications, providing remediation guidance
  • Create and maintain security documentation including runbooks, policies, and incident response procedures
  • Participate in security incident response and post-incident analysis

Minimum Requirements

  • US Citizen or permanent resident
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related discipline, four additional years of experience may be substituted for a degree
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant industry experience in security engineering or DevSecOps
  • Experience with Kubernetes security including network policies, pod security standards, and admission controllers
  • Experience with at least two of the following: Cilium/Tetragon, Kyverno, or similar policy/security enforcement tools
  • Experience with vulnerability management tools and processes including scanning, assessment, and remediation tracking
  • Experience implementing security controls in CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in container security best practices
  • Experience with cloud security in AWS environments
  • Scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go
  • Understanding of compliance frameworks (CMMC, NIST 800-171, or similar)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist), or CEH
  • Experience with Wiz or similar cloud security posture management (CSPM) platforms
  • Experience with Cilium for Kubernetes networking and Tetragon for runtime security enforcement
  • Experience with Kyverno or OPA (Open Policy Agent) for policy-as-code
  • Experience implementing software supply-chain security including SLSA framework, Sigstore, or similar
  • Experience with container image scanning tools (Trivy, Black Duck, Snyk, Aqua)
  • Experience in aerospace, defense, or government sectors with ITAR or CUI environments
  • Experience implementing CMMC Level 2 or FedRAMP security controls
  • Experience with eBPF-based security tools and observability
  • Experience with SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) generation and analysis
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS)
  • Experience with GitOps security practices (ArgoCD, Flux)
  • Experience with AWS security services (GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, Config)
  • Experience with observability and SIEM tools (Grafana, Splunk, Cribl)
  • Experience with zero-trust architecture and micro-segmentation
  • Experience with security automation frameworks and orchestration

This is a hunter-oriented commercial role focused on expanding access, building high‑impact customer relationships, and integrating the therapy into clinical workflows across implanting centers and community hospitals.


What You’ll Work On

  • Sales & Customer Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with physicians, HF clinics, administrators, and key stakeholders. Deliver clinical, technical, and strategic presentations to drive therapy understanding and adoption. Lead pricing discussions, contract negotiations, and value‑based conversations. Plan and execute educational events focused on hemodynamics, GDMT, published data, biomarkers, patient selection, and local case studies. Provide day‑of‑procedure support and post‑operative troubleshooting as needed. Meet or exceed sales targets and execute quarterly business plans. Collaborate closely with Marketing, Professional Education, and Commercial Excellence teams. Track territory performance, customer engagement, and pipeline activity.
  • Account Management & Program Development: Conduct quarterly business reviews with key accounts to assess performance and identify growth opportunities. Partner effectively with Clinical Account Representative to support priority accounts with a unified strategy. Develop long‑term relationships with both new and existing customers. Submit timely and accurate sales reports, forecasts, and competitive insights.
  • Market Development & Competitive Strategy: Identify, qualify, and convert new business opportunities across implanting and community sites. Use market insights to understand customer needs, emerging trends, and competitive dynamics. Build and execute territory strategies to increase market share and drive sustainable adoption. Maintain strong knowledge of CardioMEMS, competitive products, and alternative therapies.
  • Technical & Procedural Support: Provide on-call technical, clinical, and engineering support for field questions and procedural needs. Offer procedural case coverage across the region, ensuring high-quality support for implanting teams. Support HF clinics with training, education, clinical data collection, and new product introductions.
  • Compliance & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Adhere to FDA regulations, company policies, quality standards, and operating procedures. Maintain accurate documentation of sales activities, customer interactions, and expenses. Work collaboratively with internal partners, customers, contractors, and vendors. Interact with patients, when necessary, in a professional, compliant manner.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of direct healthcare sales experience; 2+ years in cardiology structural heart/heart failure preferred.
  • Track record of ≥100% to quota for 2 consecutive years
  • Demonstrated success opening 3–5+ net‑new accounts/year or expanding underdeveloped accounts to sustained utilization.
  • Strong understanding of payor and insurance reimbursement landscape.
  • Recent launch experience (Preferred) (last 3–5 years) leading 2–3 program or therapy launches/year with proof of sustainability (e.g., active clinic users, adherence to workflows, utilization trends), including: Pre-launch planning, Stakeholder alignment and executive sponsorship, Training, education, and clinical workflow integration, Post launch support and long-term sustainability plans.
  • Experience driving program implementation and ongoing program maturity, such as: HF clinic onboarding, Remote monitoring workflow development, Utilization ramp and adoption metrics
  • Strong executive presence, clinical/technical presentations to audiences of 1–50 stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to influence cross‑functional buying groups (value analysis committees, supply chain, service line leadership) Influencing multiple key stakeholders to drive growth.
  • Strong understanding of market dynamics
  • Strong commercial acumen with ability to produce data‑driven territory strategies, forecasting models, and QBRs using CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), analytics, and Excel.

raw.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace topower access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your impact on our Mission:

Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. As a Revenue Enablement Lead, you’ll help our revenue teams build the product knowledge and customer insight they need to create better conversations and deliver more value to healthcare providers.

You’ll own enablement for assigned Zocdoc products and healthcare domains—from launch readiness through ongoing learning. You’ll also partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, and Revenue leaders to turn complex information into practical, scalable experiences that improve seller readiness and business outcomes. In this highly visible role, you’ll shape how teams learn, adapt, and bring new products to market, thereby helping Zocdoc deliver more value to providers and the patients they serve.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are...

  • Energized by turning complex product and healthcare concepts into clear, useful learning experiences.
  • Comfortable owning programs from strategy and planning through hands-on execution.
  • Curious, collaborative, and motivated by building trusted partnerships across teams.
  • Interested in using feedback, data, and experimentation to improve how people learn and perform.
  • Excited to help revenue teams connect product knowledge to meaningful customer and business outcomes.
  • Adaptable when priorities evolve, and thoughtful about balancing quality, speed, and scale.

Your day to day is…

  • Leading enablement plans for product launches, enhancements, and new capabilities.
  • Translating complex product, business, and healthcare concepts into clear, actionable learning experiences.
  • Building and maintaining scalable programs using a mix of self-paced learning, live training, practical exercises, assessments, and reinforcement.
  • Partnering with onboarding teams to help new hires develop the product and domain knowledge they need to succeed.
  • Defining readiness goals and using learner feedback, assessments, and business data to measure and improve program effectiveness.
  • Developing trusted partnerships across Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Leadership, and subject matter experts.
  • Ensuring educational content is accurate and relevant as products, processes, and priorities evolve.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Enablement, Sales Enablement, Product Enablement, Learning & Development, or a related field.
  • Experience developing and delivering enablement or learning programs that support product launches, seller readiness, or ongoing capability development.
  • Strong instructional design and learning skills, with the ability to make complex topics easy to understand and apply.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, balancing priorities, and delivering high-quality work in a changing environment.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership, stakeholder management, written communication, and presentation skills.
  • A data-informed approach to connecting learning goals with seller behavior and business outcomes.
  • Experience with LMS platforms, e-learning authoring tools, Salesforce, Gong, or similar enablement technologies is helpful.
  • Familiarity with healthcare, provider needs, or healthcare technology is a plus—not a requirement.

Benefits

  • Flexible work environment
  • Unlimited Vacation
  • 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)
  • 401(k) with employer funded match
  • Corporate wellness program with Wellhub
  • Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)
  • Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement
  • Cell phone reimbursement
  • Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging
  • Great Place to Work Certified

Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by oursix core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

  • Resilience and the ability to handle rejection
  • Ability to set and follow your own daily routines
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills

Chief Digital Officer (CDO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Digital Officer (CDO) is responsible for developing and executing the organization's digital strategy, leading enterprise-wide digital transformation, and leveraging technology to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, innovation, and business growth across insurance and investment operations.

The CDO will oversee digital platforms, technology-enabled business transformation, automation, data-driven innovation, and digital product development. Working closely with executive leadership and business units, the role will ensure that digital capabilities support the organization's strategic objectives, enhance competitiveness, and deliver secure, scalable, and customer-centric financial services.

2. Key Responsibilities

Digital Strategy & Transformation

  • Develop and implement the organization's enterprise-wide digital strategy and transformation roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize business processes through technology, automation, and digital innovation.
  • Align digital initiatives with corporate strategy, business growth, operational priorities, and customer expectations.
  • Lead large-scale digital transformation programs across insurance, investment, finance, and corporate functions.
  • Establish digital governance frameworks, transformation priorities, budgets, and performance measures.

Digital Platforms & Product Development

  • Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of digital platforms, customer portals, mobile applications, and online service channels.
  • Drive digital insurance solutions, including online policy applications, premium payments, claims submissions, renewals, and policy servicing.
  • Support digital investment platforms for account management, portfolio reporting, transactions, and client engagement, where applicable.
  • Collaborate with product, technology, and business teams to develop innovative digital financial products and services.
  • Ensure platforms are scalable, accessible, user-friendly, and aligned with customer and business requirements.

Technology Innovation & Emerging Solutions

  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, cloud computing, robotic process automation (RPA), blockchain, and advanced analytics.
  • Promote technology adoption to improve underwriting, claims processing, customer service, risk assessment, investment operations, and reporting.
  • Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and evaluate the commercial value of new technologies.
  • Establish partnerships with fintech companies, insurtech providers, technology vendors, and digital solution providers.
  • Monitor digital industry trends and translate relevant innovations into practical business opportunities.

Data & Analytics

  • Develop a data-driven organizational culture through effective data governance, analytics, and business intelligence.
  • Oversee digital analytics capabilities to support customer insights, business performance, risk assessment, and strategic decision-making.
  • Collaborate with data teams to develop dashboards, predictive models, and reporting systems.
  • Improve data accessibility, quality, accuracy, and consistency across business units.
  • Ensure responsible data use and compliance with applicable privacy and data protection requirements.

Operational Automation & Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual and repetitive business processes.
  • Drive workflow digitization across underwriting, claims, policy administration, investment operations, finance, HR, and compliance.
  • Improve process efficiency, service turnaround times, productivity, and cost effectiveness.
  • Promote integration between enterprise systems, CRM platforms, policy administration systems, and financial applications.
  • Measure the operational impact and return on investment of digital transformation initiatives.

Cybersecurity, Data Protection & Digital Risk

  • Work closely with IT, information security, risk, and compliance teams to ensure secure digital operations.
  • Promote cybersecurity awareness and responsible technology practices.
  • Ensure digital platforms comply with applicable financial services regulations, privacy laws, and data protection standards.
  • Support business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology resilience initiatives.
  • Establish appropriate controls for third-party technology providers and digital service partners.

Digital Customer Experience

  • Improve customer journeys through seamless digital onboarding, self-service, communication, and service delivery.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Experience Officer, marketing, and business teams to improve digital customer engagement.
  • Use customer feedback, analytics, and usability testing to enhance digital platforms.
  • Expand digital access to insurance products, investment services, and financial information.
  • Promote consistent experiences across websites, mobile applications, branches, and other customer touchpoints.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead digital transformation, digital product, data, and technology strategy teams.
  • Establish digital performance objectives, budgets, governance structures, and delivery accountability.
  • Collaborate with the CIO, CTO, CISO, COO, CXO, and business leaders to coordinate technology priorities.
  • Manage relationships with technology vendors, implementation partners, consultants, and strategic digital partners.
  • Present digital strategy, transformation progress, investment requirements, and performance results to the CEO and Board.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Technology Management, Digital Transformation, Business Administration, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in digital transformation, technology leadership, IT strategy, digital product development, or technology-enabled business innovation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership or executive technology/digital management position.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, wealth management, fintech, or other regulated financial services.
  • Proven track record of leading enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of digital platforms, cloud technologies, enterprise systems, automation, data analytics, and emerging technologies.
  • Experience managing technology budgets, digital projects, vendor relationships, and cross-functional teams.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity, data governance, regulatory compliance, and technology risk management.
  • Strong strategic thinking, commercial awareness, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Progress against the enterprise digital transformation roadmap.
  • Digital adoption and active usage rates across customer channels.
  • Percentage of business processes digitized or automated.
  • Reduction in operational costs and manual processing time.
  • Digital customer acquisition and onboarding rates.
  • Digital platform availability, reliability, and performance.
  • Customer satisfaction with digital products and services.
  • Return on investment (ROI) of digital initiatives.
  • Data quality, analytics adoption, and reporting effectiveness.
  • Cybersecurity incidents and digital risk mitigation performance.
  • Delivery of digital projects within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Revenue generated or supported through digital channels.

Introduction

EdgeCortix seeks to hire a talented and experienced Electronic Engineer to join our US based team and lead the design and development of our board level hardware products, including PCBAs and reference designs featuring our proprietary AI Accelerator chips.

About Edgecortix

At Edgecortix we are a deep-tech startup revolutionizing edge computing with artificial intelligence and novel high efficiency silicon on chip design. Originating from multiple years of research, our unique AI hardware & software co-design principle and the Dynamic Neural Accelerator ® AI processor IP are geared towards positively disrupting the rapidly growing artificial intelligence edge hardware space and bring the power of AI and machine learning to all kinds of devices. Our operations are headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with offices in Singapore, Virginia, and California in the US.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Electronic Engineer to lead the design, development, and validation of our next-generation, high-speed PCIe-based hardware products. In this role, you will own the entire hardware development lifecycle, from initial architecture and high-speed schematic design to complex multi-layer PCB layout supervision, signal integrity analysis, hands-on lab bring-up, and transition to full production. You will collaborate closely with firmware, software, and mechanical teams to deliver robust, high-performance electronic products.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Hardware Architecture & Design: requirements specification, component selection, schematic capture, and BOM management. Lead the design and schematic capture of complex, multi-layer digital boards featuring power delivery networks (PDNs), high-speed SerDes and PCIe Gen 4/5/6 interfaces, BMCs, AI Accelerators, FPGAs, CPUs, and high-speed memory (e.g. LPDDR5x).
  • Signal & Power Integrity (SI/PI): Collaborate with simulation engineers or independently utilize tools to analyze and optimize robust data transmission (e.g. eye diagrams, crosstalk, jitter), as well as clean PDNs (accuracy, noise, drop, and thermal performance).
  • PCB Layout Supervision: Work closely with PCB layout designers and thermal mechanical engineers to guide material and stack-up selection, high-speed routing and power delivery constraints, component placement, and thermal management strategies.
  • Bring-up & Validation: Define and lead hands-on board bring-up, debugging, characterization, and validation in the lab.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with firmware and driver teams to ensure proper operation of AI acceleration workloads and integration into deployable systems.
  • Compliance & Testing: Design for and support regulatory compliance testing including EMI/EMC, safety, protocol compliance, and interoperability, as well as validation of environmental reliability requirements.
  • Reference Design Documentation: Create and assemble reference design guides, schematics documentation, layout notes, block diagrams, operational concepts, and validation procedures to enable external customers to recreate and modify our products to do chip-down design of our AI accelerator chips. Support the Marketing team to package these materials into polished, customer-ready documentation and solutions that facilitate customer adoption and accelerate design-in activities.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of proven experience designing complex, high-density, multi-layer (12+ layers) PCBs that implemented high-speed protocols (e.g., 25G/56G/112G Ethernet, DDR4/DDR5, PCIe Gen 3+).
    Direct experience with PCIe board development is highly preferred (Gen 3/4 minimum, Gen5/6 a plus)
  • EDA Tools: High proficiency with major schematic capture and PCB layout tools such as Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, or Altium Designer. Hands-on experience (directly or indirectly) with SI/PI simulation software (e.g., Ansys HFSS/SIwave, or Cadence Sigrity).
  • Lab/Bench Skills: Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, proficiency with high-speed digital test equipment.
  • Technical Fundamentals: Deep understanding of high-speed data transmission and with power electronics design, including multi-phase buck converters and PMICs for high-power accelerators. Experience with, and appreciation of PCB fabrication, SMT assembly, and PCBA thermal management.

Location:

U.S.-based; remote work permitted. East Coast time zone preferred, with Washington, DC/DMV-area candidates a plus.

What’s in It for You

  • The opportunity to shape the category narrative for next-generation AI infrastructure.
  • The chance to join a company at the forefront of Generative and Agentic AI at the edge.
  • The opportunity to work alongside a world-class global team across engineering, research, product, and business.
  • A critical role in scaling a high-growth deep-technology company.

Benefits and Perks

  • Competitive salary, benefits, and equity participation.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Remote-work options.

raw.description:
Description

Sentra is the AI Data Readiness platform for enterprises deploying AI at scale. Sentra continuously discovers, classifies, and governs sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, data warehouses, and AI environments - giving security teams complete visibility into what AI systems can access, what they can expose, and where compliance violations exist. Unlike alternatives that copy data to vendor clouds or require customer-managed outpost infrastructure, Sentra provisions ephemeral scanners directly inside the customer's environment, delivering petabyte-scale classification at a fraction of the cost. Trusted by Lyft, SoFi, Munich RE, PennyMac, Glovo and others.

About the Role

As Sentra continues to expand globally, we're looking for a driven and hands-on Field Marketing Manager, EMEA to help build our presence and accelerate growth across the region.

Based in the UK, you'll play a key role in developing and executing regional marketing strategies that increase brand awareness, generate pipeline, and support our growing EMEA sales organisation.

This is more than an event management role. You'll have the opportunity to help shape our go-to-market strategy in EMEA, build relationships with partners and customers, and create marketing programs that directly contribute to business growth.

You'll work closely with regional Sales leadership and our global Marketing team to identify opportunities, execute impactful campaigns, and establish Sentra as a recognised leader in data security and AI readiness.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building from the ground up, thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, and is equally comfortable developing a strategy and rolling up their sleeves to execute it.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the EMEA field marketing strategy, aligned with regional sales priorities, pipeline targets, and business growth objectives.
  • Partner closely with EMEA Sales leadership to identify target accounts, priority markets, and opportunities to accelerate pipeline generation.
  • Build and manage regional marketing programs, including industry conferences, executive roundtables, customer events, partner activities, webinars, and account-based marketing initiatives.
  • Help establish and grow Sentra's brand presence across key EMEA markets, with an initial focus on the UK and strategic European markets.
  • Collaborate with Sales and global Marketing teams to develop targeted campaigns that drive engagement, generate qualified opportunities, and support deal progression.
  • Build relationships with regional technology partners, channel partners, industry associations, and event organisers to expand Sentra's market reach.
  • Own the end-to-end planning and execution of regional events, including budgeting, venue selection, vendor management, logistics, promotional materials, and follow-up activities.
  • Work with Sales and BDR teams to ensure effective pre-event outreach, lead follow-up, and conversion of marketing engagement into sales opportunities.
  • Track and report on marketing performance, including pipeline contribution, event ROI, lead conversion, and campaign effectiveness.
  • Adapt global marketing campaigns and messaging to resonate with regional audiences and market needs.
  • Manage regional marketing budgets, vendors, agencies, and promotional inventory.
  • Identify new opportunities to strengthen Sentra's visibility within the EMEA cybersecurity and cloud security communities.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in B2B field marketing, regional marketing, or demand generation, preferably within cybersecurity, enterprise software, or SaaS.
  • Experience developing and executing marketing programs across the UK and/or broader EMEA markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with Sales teams to generate pipeline and support revenue growth.
  • Experience managing conferences, executive events, partner marketing initiatives, and targeted regional campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of B2B marketing metrics, pipeline attribution, and campaign ROI.
  • Experience working in a fast-growing startup or high-growth technology company is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with the cybersecurity, cloud security, or data security market is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate across international teams.
  • Experience with Salesforce and marketing automation platforms.
  • A proactive, resourceful, and hands-on approach, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.
  • Willingness to travel across the UK and EMEA as needed for events, customer engagements, and regional marketing activities.

Job Description

Are you passionate about transforming complex data into meaningful insights that drive better decisions?

Would you like to work with innovative data solutions that help shape the future of insurance risk?

About the Business
LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Insurance vertical, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. Our insurance risk solutions help drive better data-driven decisions across the insurance policy lifecycle, all while reducing risk. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at 1

About our Team

The Data Engineering Team in the UK&I features 20 individuals but sits within a global Data Engineering team of over 400+ individuals. Data Management is currently a team of 2.5 team members but is expanding as out product offerings grow within the UK.

About the Role
In this role, you will analyse and interpret complex data to support business decisions and improve data quality across the insurance lifecycle. You’ll collaborate with a variety of stakeholders to deliver insights, resolve issues, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. This is an opportunity to combine analytical expertise with modern tools to drive efficiency and innovation.

  • Present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Support data onboarding, workflow improvements, and operational efficiency initiatives (including automation/AI use)
  • Identify process inefficiencies and contribute to optimisation, risk management, and change initiatives

Requirements

  • 3+ years’ experience in data management, analysis, or customer-facing data roles
  • Strong analytical skills with experience handling large or complex datasets
  • Advanced SQL and Power BI reporting capabilities
  • Knowledge of data lifecycle processes (profiling, validation, reconciliation)
  • Experience with root-cause analysis and data quality improvement
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Exposure to APIs, data integration formats, and modern data platforms (e.g., Azure) preferred

Work Flexibility: Remote

The Implementation Engineer is a customer-facing technical professional responsible for the planning, design, integration, deployment, testing, and validation of healthcare communication solutions within complex customer environments. The role requires a strong foundation in server technologies, networking, databases, healthcare integrations, and structured implementation methodologies. Implementation Engineers work collaboratively with customers, internal teams, and third-party technology vendors to integrate solutions within the broader healthcare technology ecosystem. This includes clinical communication systems, Electronic Health Record Systems (EHR), nurse call, patient monitoring, messaging infrastructure, telephony, and other third-party platforms. Successful candidates will combine strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly learn new technologies, communicate effectively with customers and technical stakeholders, and execute complex implementations using structured and repeatable methodologies.


What You Will Do

  • Plan, design, install, configure, test, and validate healthcare communication solutions within customer environments.
  • Integrate solutions with external systems such as EHRs, nurse call systems, physiological patient monitoring systems, telephony systems, messaging middleware, and other third-party applications.
  • Perform technical discovery and collaborate with customer stakeholders to understand infrastructure, networking, integration, and application requirements.
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot Stryker clinical communication solutions running on Windows Server and Linux environments, including application services, OS-level dependencies, and physical and virtualized infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues across application, server, network, database, and integration layers.
  • Apply TCP/IP networking and security fundamentals when deploying and troubleshooting solutions in customer environments.
  • Collaborate with clinical leads to understand workflow requirements and translate clinical and technical requirements into appropriate solution configurations.
  • Execute structured implementation methodologies including technical discovery, solution configuration, integration, testing, validation, documentation, and transition to support.
  • Develop and execute test plans and perform end-to-end system testing to validate solution functionality, integration, and performance.
  • Coordinate effectively with internal cross-functional teams throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  • Communicate project status, technical risks, dependencies, and issues clearly and consistently to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Follow applicable security practices to protect customer, medical, and sensitive information.

What you need:

Required

  • Bachelors in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in a customer-facing technical services or support

Preferred:

  • Demonstrated ability with HL7 integrations or healthcare IT interoperability
  • Prior VMWare vCenter experience in large production environments; working knowledge of the supporting infrastructure (blade server systems, storage arrays, networking equipment) associated with creating and supporting modern virtualized data centers
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Nagios Zabbix, and Configuration management tools like Ansible or similar is a plus
  • Experience with TCP/IP networking & security fundamentals as well as network load balancers (Citrix ADC; NetScaler or F5 Big IP)
  • Demonstrated understanding of structured implementation methodologies, with an emphasis on end-to-end testing of complex systems
  • Prior experience integrating nurse call and/or patient monitoring systems
  • Ability to deploy technology in the healthcare market is highly desired

raw.title: Network Engineer (m/w/d)
raw.excerpt: deine missionDu entwickelst und betreibst robuste, skalierbare und sichere Netzwerklösungen, die unsere Mission unterstützen, eine souveräne Cloud-Infrastruktur für den öffentlichen Sektor bereitzustellen.
raw.description:
deine mission

Du entwickelst und betreibst robuste, skalierbare und sichere Netzwerklösungen, die unsere Mission unterstützen, eine souveräne Cloud-Infrastruktur für den öffentlichen Sektor bereitzustellen. Das bedeutet, Du sorgst für eine robuste und hochverfügbare Netzwerkarchitektur mit exzellenten Monitoring. Du gestaltest Systemarchitekturen, automatisierst Betriebsabläufe und stellst sicher, dass unsere Plattform performant läuft.

deine aufgaben

  • Verantwortung für Design, Aufbau und Betrieb hochsicherer Netzwerkinfrastrukturen (inklusive isolierter Airgap-Systeme)
  • Planung von maßgeschneiderten Netzwerksetups in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden (auch auf Basis des kundeneigenen Hardware-Stacks)
  • Konfiguration und Optimierung komplexer Routing-Szenarien unter Verwendung von BGP, MPLS und IPv6 in einer mandantenfähigen Umgebung
  • Entwicklung und Pflege von Automatisierungen (z. B. mit Ansible, Python) für effiziente Updates, Skalierungen und reibungslose Hardware-Integrationen im laufenden Betrieb
  • Durchführung von Fehleranalysen, Troubleshooting und kontinuierliche Verbesserung des Monitorings zur Sicherstellung der Hochverfügbarkeit

das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Netzwerk-Engineering, idealerweise im ISP-Umfeld oder in großen Rechenzentren
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Data-Center-Networking, speziell mit Cumulus Linux und Juniper Junos
  • Tiefgehendes Verständnis von Netzwerkkonzepten und Protokollen (TCP/IP, BGP, MPLS, IPv6, VXLAN/EVPN)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit der Linux-Konsole und Erfahrung in der Scripting-Automatisierung (Bash, Python)
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Konfigurationsmanagement-Tools wie Ansible oder Terraform ist von Vorteil
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Dokumentationsfähigkeit und sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

was dich bei uns erwartet

Du wirst Teil eines engagierten crossfunktionalen Teams, das an der Stabilität und Verlässlichkeit kritischer Infrastruktur arbeitet. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von Offenheit und technischer Tiefe. Wir setzen auf Open Source und moderne Technologien. Dich erwarten ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld mit der Wahl zwischen 100% Remote oder Büro in Berlin, freie Hardwarewahl mit strikter no Microsoft Windows Policy :-) . Wir bieten Dir Gestaltungsspielraum und ein Umfeld, in dem technische Expertise und Verantwortung zählen.

raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

This shared services role includes supporting various accounting teams for various accounting tasks. This includes supporting external and internal reporting, margin accounting, opex/capex accounting, and our newly acquired entity of Alkira. You will operate in a high‑accountability environment where expectations are clear, decisions matter, and trust is built through rigor, consistency, and results.

If you thrive in complex environments, value ownership over process for process’ sake, and are motivated by building systems that enable the business to move faster and smarter, this is a role where your impact is visible and meaningful.

The Main Responsibilities

•Lead and execute month-end and quarter-end close activities for assigned entities, including account reconciliations and journal entries
•Oversee and review daily accounting operations—AP, AR, and GL—to ensure accuracy and timeliness
•Prepare, review and analyze financial statements, variance analyses and management reports in compliance with IFRS/GAAP
•Coordinate and support statutory and internal audit processes, providing necessary schedules and documentation
•Develop, implement and maintain robust internal controls, policies and procedures to mitigate risk and ensure compliance
•Mentor, train and guide junior accounting staff, fostering a collaborative team environment and continuous development
•Drive process improvement and automation initiatives to enhance efficiency and accuracy in financial reporting
•Collaborate with tax and treasury teams to ensure timely and accurate tax filings, compliances and cash flow management
•Support annual budgeting and forecasting processes, gathering data, validating assumptions and analyzing variances
•Conduct SOX control testing and remediation, ensuring adherence to corporate governance requirements
•Partner with cross-functional teams on financial projects, system implementations and process standardization
•Provide actionable financial analysis and insights to stakeholders to inform strategic decision-making and performance optimization

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Contribute to the monthly close process, including preparing and reviewing journal entries, variance analysis, and reporting for margin accounting, opex/capex accounting, and our newly acquired entity of Alkira.
  • Deep expertise in USGAAP Technical accounting memo, ASC 842 and preparation of SEC schedules.
  • Prepare and review reconciliations of General Ledger accounts.
  • Assist with the end‑to‑end intercompany accounting processes, including settlements, interest, eliminations, and affiliate roll‑forwards.
  • Assist with the monthly cost allocation process, including governance of methodologies, drivers, and statistical key figures.
  • Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual legal entity consolidations, including income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow reporting.
  • Review and approve consolidation entries, eliminations, and top‑side adjustments.
  • Provide ownership of finance master data (GL accounts, cost centers, profit centers, hierarchies, and attributes).
  • Safeguard the integrity of the general ledger, including account structure, posting logic, and reconciliation standards.
  • Assist with tasks related to mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures as applicable.
  • Partner with FP&A to help drive business decisions.
  • Support financial statement audits.
  • Maintain internal control integrity and related SOX documentation and compliance.
  • Use critical thinking and attention to detail to help ensure financial statements are free from misstatement.
  • Work on complex issues which require input from multiple sources and innovative problem solving.
  • Work on ERP – S4 Hanna initiatives as requested
  • Create and/or maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all tasks performed and review SOPs to identify opportunities to streamline and automate processes.
  • Assist with Ad hoc analysis and research as needed.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clear ownership, disciplined execution, and trusted financial data that leadership can rely on.
  • Finance master data that enables, not constrains, reporting, analysis, and business insight.

Teams that operate with clarity, accountability, and confidence during change.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • 10-15 years of accounting experience, including leadership roles in complex, multi‑entity environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and SOX controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in a high‑accountability environment, take ownership of outcomes, and lead through complexity and change.
  • Proven experience partnering cross‑functionally with Treasury, Tax, Legal, FP&A, and Systems teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • CPA/ Chartered Accountant
  • Experience working within large‑scale, publicly traded organizations undergoing transformation or operating across global entities.
  • Hands‑on experience with SAP S/4HANA and modern consolidation platforms.
  • Track record of driving process simplification and automation while maintaining strong internal controls.
  • Experience supporting or leading teams through modernization, system implementations, or operating model changes.
