Position Summary We are looking for a marketing professional who will be a tactical, execution expert for customer-first, integrated marketing campaigns and initiatives. As part of our marketing delivery and operations team, you will drive marketing execution in your assigned area(s.) You will develop, implement, assess, report and communicate on high performing, data-driven integrated marketing tactics and campaigns. Within this team, you will be the execution expert for your assigned areas, working hand-in-hand with and mentoring other experts on the team. You will also collaborate closely with our creative team, our client marketing team and our marketing strategy team to ensure on-time, on-strategy, highest quality delivery of marketing campaigns and initiatives. As the execution expert, you will help bring plans and ideas to life. If you love making things happen, are motivated by digging into data to get insights to improve, can’t stop yourself from seeking and building new skills and then teaching what you’ve learned to others and thrive helping all people use our world’s precious resources more efficiently, this is the job for you! Essential Duties and Responsibilities This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.

Accountable for delivery of tactics on-time, on quality and on strategy within assigned area(s) Collaborate with the client marketing, performance marketing, creative strategy, and creative services teams to execute marketing campaigns and tactics. Be the “go-to” expert in in your assigned area(s) including process, tool and technologies related to assigned area(s.) On-board new team members to learn assigned areas, including being a resource and guide for support. Provide edits to completed designs as needed. Provide copy development support to the creative team for marketing materials. Work within the marketing project management system to keep work on track and all stakeholders up to date and informed. Identify areas to be improved in how we manage and delivery our work and work with leadership to implement these improvements. Manage workflow, review cycles and approvals of marketing materials from multiple internal and external parties. Implement, update and manage assigned tactics, including content creation, basic template design/updates, call-to-action, workflow automation, A/B testing and metrics reporting. Collaborate with creative team as needed. Create strong cross-functional relationships with marketing and other peers to foster shared learning and leverage best practices. Serve as point and support to internal customers and lead communications and management for tactics. Mentor other team members in your areas of expertise. Work with team to identify and implement better, faster, smarter and higher quality ways of executing with assigned areas and channels. Contribute to a positive, creative, fast-paced and innovative marketing team environment.

Position Requirements Education and Experience

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in marketing, communications, business or a related field. 5+ years of marketing experience. Demonstrated mastery including up to date certifications in two or more areas of marketing execution such as e-mail marketing, events, digital media or other.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

Proven experience with eCommerce platforms and online storefront management. Experience with Adobe Commerce (Magento) and BigCommerce is strongly preferred. Familiarity with eCommerce operations, merchandising, and digital customer experiences is a plus. Must be able to handle a wide variety of work and work in a fast-paced environment. Must be a detail-oriented, organized, self-starter, and have an ability to prioritize workload. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to raise issues and lead project management as a subject matter expert in your specific discipline. Ability to analyze and interpret data and solve practical problems. Knowledge of mathematical concepts such as fractions, percentages and ratios. Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, specifically Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook. Paid search, SEO, social media and email marketing tactical experience required. Certifications in marketing platforms such as Salesforce Marketing cloud, Hubspot, Google Analytics and Google Ads strongly preferred Growth-Driven Design certification a plus. Committed to diversity and inclusion Reliable transportation

Licenses & Certifications

Valid driver’s license

Overview

Lifeway is seeking a Remote Paid Social Media Strategist to own our paid social presence on Meta and Pinterest as we bring paid media management in-house. You’ll plan, build, optimize, and measure campaigns that drive customer acquisition, lead generation, eCommerce revenue, and ministry reach. You will be the go-to expert on audience strategy, creative testing, catalog and commerce advertising, and budget stewardship, turning ministry and business goals into media plans that deliver. This is a remote role with in-person gatherings in the Nashville, Tennessee area.

Why Lifeway?

Lifeway is a place where you can bring your faith and work experience to join in the most important mission in the world: making disciples of Jesus Christ. Whether you’re a creator or storyteller, data guru or problem-solver, or anywhere in between, if you’re passionate about serving the church, we have a place for you. Lifeway has a strong Work from Anywhere (WFA) culture that is deeply focused on our mission and values. While headquartered in Nashville, TN, many of our positions are remote-eligible and have autonomy and flexibility with work hours. We provide equipment and resources to ensure team members have access to a productive and ergonomic workspace. We believe building relationships and community is essential to how we work together, so Lifeway hosts all-team meetings several times per year and provides travel for key team gatherings for remote-based team members. Full-time employees are eligible for enrollment in our comprehensive benefits plans including healthcare, vacation and sick time, holiday pay, care days, 401(k) plan, maternity and parental leave, adoption assistance, mission trip time, and more. If this sounds like a place where you would be excited to serve the kingdom of God, we would love for you to join our team.

Learn more about our culture at team.lifeway.com/culture-code

This is a remote position in the U.S. with occasional travel to Nashville for in-person team gatherings.

Responsibilities

  • Lives out Lifeway’s mission and values, showing deep commitment to Kingdom work
  • Own channel strategy, account structure, naming conventions, and best practices for paid social on Meta and Pinterest
  • Turn ministry and business objectives into media plans covering audiences, bidding, budget allocation, flighting, creative requirements, and measurement
  • Build and traffic campaigns, ad sets, audiences, and creative variations, and complete pre-launch quality checks before anything goes live
  • Manage budgets against authorized amounts, monitor pacing, reallocate spend to maximize return, and report variances with recommendations
  • Optimize bids, audiences, placements, and creative rotation daily and weekly based on performance
  • Design and run a structured testing roadmap, including A/B and incrementality tests, and document what you learn and apply it across campaigns
  • Set up and maintain pixels, Conversions API, conversion events, and UTM structures, and keep audiences, exclusions, and first-party data uploads current and policy-compliant
  • Build dashboards and recurring reports that interpret results and deliver clear recaps and recommendations to ministry partners and leadership
  • Advise ministry and business partners, brief Creative using performance evidence, and manage relationships with Meta and Pinterest representatives
  • Limited travel: 2-4 times per year, typically overnight for 2-3 days

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Analytics, or a related field, required

Master's degree, preferred

Advanced graduate degree (PhD, etc.), not required

Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, required

  • 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience managing campaigns directly in platform interfaces, in-house or at an agency
  • Demonstrated depth in Meta Ads Manager, including campaign structure, bidding, audience strategy, and troubleshooting
  • Proven management and pacing of media budgets against CPA/CPL, ROAS, revenue, or lead goals
  • Strong knowledge of audience development, retargeting, first-party data activation, automated bidding and targeting, creative formats, catalog ads, and conversion optimization
  • Working proficiency with Meta Pixel, Pinterest tag, GA4, UTMs, and attribution concepts and their limitations
  • Demonstrated experience designing and running structured tests and turning results into documented, applied recommendations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining media performance to non-technical ministry and leadership audiences
  • Ability to travel to the Middle Tennessee area 2-4 times annually for team gatherings

Actively involved in an evangelical Christian church

Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, preferred

  • Experience in Pinterest Ads Manager, including campaign structure, bidding, audience strategy, and troubleshooting
  • Platform certification such as Meta Blueprint or Google Analytics, or comparable credentials
  • Experience with Meta Commerce Manager, product feeds, catalog management, or eCommerce and direct-response media
  • Experience managing paid social for multiple brands, audiences, or business units, including annual investments of $1M+ or comparable budgets
  • Experience with Data Studio, Tableau, Power BI, Supermetrics, or comparable reporting tools and/or Conversions API
  • Familiarity with incrementality testing, media mix modeling, or multi-touch attribution
  • Experience in retail, eCommerce, publishing, ministry/nonprofit, or a multi-brand organization

Position: Strategic Engineering Lead, SWIFT

Move Security Forward with Acre
Are you passionate about transforming the future of security? Do you thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment where your contributions drive real impact? If so, Acre Security is the place for you.

About Acre
At Acre, we're not just building security solutions. We’re empowering security professionals to adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world. Since 2012, Acre has been at the forefront of innovation in access control, visitor management, and intrusion software, delivering smarter and more adaptable security technologies to organisations worldwide.

Your Impact
Acre is seeking an experienced engineering leader to establish and lead a remote SWIFT Escalation Engineering team focused on resolving complex customer escalations involving product defects through software code fixes, as well as feature implementation outside the broader product roadmap.

The successful contractor will help establish the team's operating structure, technical practices and cross-functional relationships, supporting customer-impacting defects from escalation and investigation through correction, validation, release and customer confirmation.

This role combines strategic technical leadership with hands-on software development and customer escalation management, working closely with Global Technical Support, Research and Development, Quality Assurance, Product Management and Release Management.

What You’ll Do

  • Establish the SWIFT team operating model, including responsibilities, intake standards, decision paths, delivery routines, documentation and stakeholder communication.
  • Support the onboarding, technical development and coordination of software development and quality assurance professionals.
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for priorities, customer escalations, product defects, delivery risks and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Lead complex defect investigations, including issue reproduction, root cause analysis, solution architecture, software correction, peer review, testing and release validation.
  • Remain hands-on with software development and troubleshooting across applications, databases, APIs, integrations, cloud services, infrastructure and deployment environments.
  • Partner with R&D to ensure defect corrections align with product architecture, engineering standards and release strategy.
  • Coordinate with Tier 3 Technical Support to ensure escalations include appropriate reproduction steps, logs, diagnostics, environment details, customer impact and validation criteria.
  • Manage priorities through Jira, balancing customer impact, engineering effort, release risk, dependencies and available capacity.
  • Provide clear technical and non-technical stakeholder updates during customer-impacting situations.
  • Improve product reliability through root cause analysis, regression coverage, technical documentation, reusable diagnostics and knowledge transfer.
  • Identify recurring product and support issues and recommend preventive engineering, process, training and support-readiness improvements.
  • Facilitate team stand-ups and case reviews to identify priorities, blockers and coverage requirements across global Tier 3 support teams.
  • Support cross-training, knowledge sharing and skills development to reduce dependency on individual team members.
  • Provide insight on capacity, resourcing and process risks within the scope of the engagement.
  • Contribute to operating plans and improvement initiatives that enhance reliability, efficiency and customer outcomes.
  • Comply with applicable Acre requirements relating to information security, customer data, remote access, documentation, safety and ethical business conduct.
What You’ll Bring
  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Significant experience in software engineering, quality assurance, sustaining engineering, production support, technical operations or customer escalation within an enterprise software environment.
  • Strong experience investigating complex software and production issues through troubleshooting, root cause analysis, log review, database analysis, API testing and application diagnostics.
  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as C#, .NET, Python, PowerShell, Bash, SQL and REST APIs, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with containerised, cloud-based or distributed enterprise applications and production troubleshooting, deployment validation or release readiness.
  • Experience coordinating technical work across development, QA, infrastructure, operations, support and other stakeholders.
  • Strong technical leadership skills with the ability to establish priorities, address blockers and coordinate multidisciplinary technical work.
  • Experience managing customer or partner escalations involving software defects, integrations, authentication, databases, infrastructure or application behaviour.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings, customer impact and delivery risks for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across R&D, QA, Technical Support, Product Management and Release Management in a remote, global environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in one or more of the following would be an advantage:
  • Leading or building software engineering, sustaining engineering, QA, DevOps or advanced technical support teams.
  • Establishing technical operating models, delivery practices and service expectations.
  • Developing corrective software changes, code reviews and integrating fixes into maintained product branches.
  • Microsoft Azure, Azure Kubernetes Service, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
  • PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, identity and authentication services or event-driven architectures.
  • Hotfix, maintenance release, controlled deployment and customer validation processes.
  • Access control, identity, physical security, intrusion, video management or other enterprise security platforms.
  • AI-assisted engineering tools for requirements analysis, troubleshooting, testing, code analysis, automation or technical documentation.

Contractor Engagement
This opportunity will be offered under an Independent Contractor Agreement. The successful contractor will provide services remotely from the Philippines.
The scope of services, fees, working arrangements, confidentiality, intellectual property requirements and other applicable terms will be set out in the contractor agreement.

Join the Future of Security
At Acre, we’re moving security forward. If you're ready to make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative industry, we’d love to hear from you.

raw.title: Remote CDL Driver Recruiter | Independent Contractor
raw.excerpt: Remote CDL Driver Recruiter — Commission Only Class A Solutions | Independent Contractor | Work From Home Class A Solutions is growing, and we’re looking for motivated, dependable individuals to join our recruiting team!
raw.description:
Remote CDL Driver Recruiter — Commission Only
Class A Solutions | Independent Contractor | Work From Home

Class A Solutions is growing, and we’re looking for motivated, dependable individuals to join our recruiting team! If you enjoy talking to people, building relationships, and helping others find opportunities, this could be a great fit.

As a recruiter, you’ll connect with CDL-A truck drivers, learn what they’re looking for, and help match them with available driving positions. You’ll guide drivers from the first conversation through the application and hiring process while staying organized and maintaining consistent communication.

What You’ll Do

  • Contact driver leads by phone and text.
  • Ask questions about driving experience, location, preferred home time, and job interests.
  • Review available positions and explain pay, schedules, freight, and job requirements.
  • Help interested drivers complete applications and submit their information.
  • Follow up with drivers about application progress and next steps.
  • Keep accurate notes and update driver information in our recruiting tools.
  • Communicate with the team when you need help finding a position or resolving a question.

Training and Support

You don’t have to know everything about trucking to get started. We provide training materials, recruiting tools, and ongoing guidance to help you learn the process.

This is a hands-on learning opportunity. Successful recruiters take time to review the training, ask specific questions, apply feedback, and put what they’ve learned into practice. You’ll have support along the way, but you’ll also need to take initiative and follow through.

Who Would Be a Good Fit?

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Is comfortable making calls and starting conversations.
  • Can listen to a driver’s needs and clearly explain job options.
  • Stays organized and follows up consistently.
  • Works independently and manages their time well.
  • Is coachable and willing to follow the recruiting process.
  • Understands that recruiting takes persistence and that every conversation won’t result in a hire.

Previous experience in recruiting, sales, customer service, or the trucking industry is helpful, but it is not required. Beginners who are ready to learn are welcome to apply.

What You’ll Need

  • A computer and reliable internet connection.
  • A phone for communicating with drivers.
  • A quiet place to make calls.
  • Basic computer skills and comfort using online training and tracking tools.
  • Consistent availability to contact drivers and respond to follow-ups.

Compensation

This is a fully commission-based independent contractor position. Compensation is earned through successful driver hires under the commission plan. There is no hourly pay or base salary, and calls, training time, and applications alone do not generate commission.

Earnings vary based on successful placements. This role is best suited for someone who understands commission-based work and is prepared to build results through consistent effort and follow-through.

Ready to Get Started?

raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Every Instacart employee on a work visa relies on timely, accurate immigration guidance to maintain status and travel with confidence. We are building a more resilient program: a reliable, well-documented experience backed by an external immigration partner and a clearly owned internal function. As our Senior Immigration & Global Mobility Specialist, you will own the vendor relationship, partner closely with our Employment Legal team, and shift Tier 1 support to our vendor and a contingent worker, freeing you to focus on the complex cases and high-stakes moments that matter most. Twelve months from now, employees will have a smoother, more self-service immigration experience, and the program will run on documented process instead of institutional memory.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

You are a hands-on immigration expert who is equally comfortable owning a vendor relationship and rolling up your sleeves on a case. You thrive on a very small team, work independently, and know exactly where and when to escalate. You are curious, willing to stretch into new territory, and good at turning constraints into opportunities. You can explain nuanced immigration issues clearly to employees, managers, and directors, and you handle sensitive matters with care and urgency.

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 7+ years of US business immigration experience, with recent in-house corporate experience (or law firm experience paired with program-level ownership)
  • End-to-end knowledge of employment-based immigration: nonimmigrant (H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN, E-3) and immigrant (PERM, I-140, adjustment of status)
  • Hands-on compliance ownership: I-9 and reverification, Public Access Files, DOL requirements, audit readiness
  • Experience managing outside counsel and immigration or relocation vendors, including SLAs and invoice review
  • Experience supporting budget tracking and spend forecasting in partnership with Finance or a budget owner
  • Proven ownership of workflows, SOPs, and reporting on case metrics
  • Ability to advise and partner with HR, Talent Acquisition, Legal, and business leaders
  • Working exposure to global mobility, such as relocation coordination, transfers, and cost estimates

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience working with global immigration vendors.
  • Comfort with Workday and case or ticketing tools (Jira Service Desk, ServiceNow, or Salesforce)
  • M&A diligence and integration, or vendor RFP experience
  • Policy design, remote work policy, or tax vendor coordination
  • Dashboards and data skills (Excel, Google Sheets) and KPI setting
  • Using generative AI to automate reporting and policy summaries

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

raw.excerpt: DescriptionEarnix is looking for a highly creative and strategic Digital Designer to serve as the lead designer across the organization, with a primary focus on our digital presence.
raw.description:
Description

Earnix is looking for a highly creative and strategic Digital Designer to serve as the lead designer across the organization, with a primary focus on our digital presence. This role will be responsible for bringing the Earnix brand to life across every digital touchpoint, ensuring a consistent, compelling, and innovative visual identity that strengthens our market presence and creates meaningful audience experiences.

As part of the Global Content & Creative team, you will partner closely with teams across brand marketing, communications, product marketing, demand generation, sales, events, and executive stakeholders to develop creative solutions that elevate the Earnix brand. From our website and landing pages to digital advertising, social media campaigns, email, and motion content, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how our brand is experienced online around the world, while also extending that identity into events, presentations, and day-to-day business needs.

This is an ideal opportunity for a designer who combines a strong creative vision with exceptional digital execution and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

What You'll Do

Serve as the lead designer across the organisation, ensuring brand consistency and creative excellence across all channels, with a primary focus on digital.

Bring the Earnix visual identity to life in new, compelling, and innovative ways.

Lead the design development across digital experiences, paid media, and customer experiences, and support global events and experiential marketing programs.

Design and develop assets with a digital-first approach, including:

  • Website assets and landing pages
  • Digital advertising and paid media creative

· Social media campaigns

  • Email and content marketing assets
  • Motion graphics, animation, and short-form video
  • Presentations and executive communications

· Sales and marketing collateral

  • Internal communications materials
  • Event branding and environments (supporting)

Design and prototype user-centred web and digital experiences in Figma, including page templates, UI components, and interactive elements, in partnership with web and marketing technology teams.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business objectives into engaging visual concepts and creative solutions.

Identify opportunities to evolve and strengthen the visual expression of the Earnix brand while maintaining consistency and scalability.

Support the development and stewardship of brand guidelines, design standards, and a scalable digital design system with reusable templates and components.

Stay current on digital design, UX, motion, and emerging technology trends, including AI-assisted design tools, to continuously bring fresh ideas and innovation to the organisation.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while delivering high-quality work on deadline.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

A big-thinking creative with bold, original ideas and a distinctive point of view, able to move beyond the obvious and develop concepts that stand out.

Experience applying, extending, and evolving a creative design system, using it as a springboard for fresh work rather than a rigid set of rules.

5+ years of experience in digital design, web design, visual design, brand design, or creative services.

Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence across digital, web, social, and motion design, with additional experience in brand, event, and experiential design.

Exceptional visual design skills, including typography, layout, color, composition, and storytelling.

Deep understanding of how brands come to life across digital, web, social, and emerging channels, as well as experiential environments.

Hands-on experience designing websites, landing pages, and UI components, with a working knowledge of UX principles.

Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), plus experience with motion and video tools such as After Effects or Premiere Pro.

Working knowledge of AI-assisted design tools and a clear point of view on how to use them well: as an accelerator for ideation and production, not a replacement for your own thinking, taste, and craft.

Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, audience engagement, and content performance, including using analytics and A/B testing to inform creative decisions.

Ability to think strategically about brand expression while executing at a high level of creative craft.

Experience designing presentations and executive-level communications.

Ability to work independently, prioritize competing requests, and manage projects from concept through execution.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Experience designing for events, conferences, trade shows, or experiential activations is a plus.

What Sets You Apart

Have a strong creative point of view and can translate ideas into impactful visual experiences.

You are passionate about building brands and creating memorable customer experiences.

You excel at balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

You are energized by finding innovative ways to express a brand across digital channels and audiences.

You bring curiosity, creativity, and a continuous-improvement mindset to your work.

You understand how design influences perception, engagement, and business outcomes.

Why Join Earnix?

You'll have the opportunity to shape and influence a global brand during an exciting phase of growth. As the lead designer, you'll play a critical role in defining how Earnix shows up online and in the market, creating digital experiences that connect with customers, elevate our reputation, and drive business impact across every channel.

This role offers significant visibility, creative ownership, and the opportunity to leave your mark on a rapidly growing global technology company.

Salary $110,000-130,000

Position Intro

Earnix is the first AI company purpose-built for insurance decisioning, providing the industry with the intelligence, governance, and decisioning agility to drive profitable growth, improve resilience, and operate with speed and precision in a rapidly changing risk environment. A trusted provider of production-grade AI and decisioning technology, Earnix builds on more than 25 years of experience in artificial intelligence risk, pricing, rating, analytics, and decisioning. Earnix brings vertical AI into the workflows and decisions that shape insurance performance across insurers’ pricing, underwriting, claims, customer engagement, retention, and other insurers high-value insurance moments. Earnix’s AIOS enables insurers to orchestrate intelligence across the insurance decision lifecycle and drive governed, real-time decisions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Earnix is headquartered in Boston, MA and has been innovating for insurers and banks since 2001 with customers in over 35 countries across six continents and offices in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Israel.

SBI Card is proud to be an equal opportunity & inclusive employer and welcome employees without any discrimination on the grounds of race, colour, gender, religion, creed, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, caste etc. SBI Card is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees are treated equally with dignity and respect which makes it a promising place to work.

Join us to shape the future of digital payment in India and unlock your full potential.

What’s in it for YOU

  1. SBI Card truly lives by the work-life balance philosophy. We offer a robust wellness and wellbeing program to support mental and physical health of our employees
  2. Admirable work deserves to be rewarded. We have a well curated bouquet of rewards and recognition program for the employees

Role Purpose

Responsible for end-to-end management of dialer strategies and tele-verification processes across partner sites, ensuring alignment with credit guidelines, agency SLAs, and turnaround times. Drives automation, process improvements, vendor management, cost efficiency, information security compliance, audits, and ongoing change initiatives to elevate customer experience.

Role Accountability

  1. Develop response based models to refine selection criteria, policies and eligibility models for targeted strategies like Days on Dialer, Best time to call and other downstream strategies
  2. Optimize dialer strategies for all vendor sites basis analysis of call volumes and ensure implementation across all sites
  3. Ensure operational rigor through forecasting portfolio performance and pertinent metrics to enable seamless end delivery by optimizing contact-centre operations through monitoring and reviewing productivity drivers
  4. Develop real time analysis and reporting for monitoring and tracking process performance for operational leaders and front line managers

  7. Collaborate with IT and Process owners to discuss the new technologies in market and persuade vendors for POC
  8. Perform real time monitoring of operational metrics, logistics and seat planning, voice bandwidth projections, contractual and performance reporting, analysis & interpretation of reports
  9. Conduct Monthly Reviews with PM's & VM's for respective portfolios
  10. Lead periodic Internal audit to identify gaps in implementation of dialer strategies and take corrective action
  11. Ensure compliance and regulatory aspects being covered by following the RBI and TRAI guidelines around call timings
  12. Facilitate change management for efficiency and productivity related idea/initiative implementation
  13. Tele-verification process at Partner Site
  14. Lead tele verifications and ensure applications are decisioned within credit guidelines
  15. Monitor system changes in verifications and drive process improvement across Tele Verification for North & South Hub
  16. Manage vendor relationship for the assinged zones and drive timely closure of customer requests for address changes, and complaints across business and consistent delivery within business defined SLA

  18. Conduct training session for the zone with continuos focus on skill development by formulating revised training modules in collaboration with training teams
  19. Review and publish MIS, daily/ monthly key metrics reporting (to Internal as well as external stakeholders), internal analytics; oversee process data management
  20. Monitor monthly performance dashboards & also use internal metrics to identify & highlight areas where management intervention is required for improvement of the process; Lead & execute process improvement projects on Turn around time,accuracy, productivity & standardization
  21. Roll out & implement compliance & process related guidelines to all vendors & locations along with monitoring & implementation of new process changes across locations
  22. Drive better controls through SVCL, Code of conducts, info-security guidelines, tele- audits and explore technological advancements for ensuring data privacy; ensure 100% accurate process audit for the zone
  23. Ensure process documentation and compliance adherence

Measures of Success

  1. Timely & accurately development of dialer strategies

Technical Skills / Experience / Certifications

  1. Knowledge of credit card products & services

Wir besetzen aktuell die Position als SAP SuccessFactors Consultant (w/m/d) für eine etablierte Boutique-HR-Beratung, die moderne HR- und IT-Kompetenz vereint, um ihre Kunden erfolgreich bei der ganzheitlichen Digitalisierung der Personalarbeit zu begleiten.

In dieser Position bist du maßgeblich dafür verantwortlich, Unternehmen bei der strategischen Umstellung auf SuccessFactors zu begleiten, bestehende SAP-Landschaften zu optimieren, gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen zukunftsweisende HR-Prozesse zu konzipieren, anspruchsvolle Abrechnungs- und Zeitwirtschaftsthemen zu lösen sowie dich je nach deinen persönlichen Stärken aktiv in die Projektleitung oder den Pre-Sales einzubringen.

Wir suchen nach einer engagierten Persönlichkeit, die tiefgehende praktische Erfahrung im Umfeld von SAP SuccessFactors (oder langjährige SAP HCM-Expertise kombiniert mit ersten SuccessFactors-Projekten) sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse mitbringt.

| WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Betreue und steuere als zentraler Ansprechpartner renommierte Firmen bei der strategischen sowie technischen Umstellung auf SAP SuccessFactors.
  • Untersuche und optimiere vorhandene SAP-Systemlandschaften zur Gewährleistung einer zukunftssicheren und skalierbaren IT-Infrastruktur.
  • Konzipiere und implementiere in enger Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen neuartige, maßgeschneiderte und hocheffiziente HR-Prozesse.
  • Gestalte ganzheitliche Konzepte und Systemarchitekturen für anspruchsvolle Aufgabenstellungen in den Bereichen Payroll und Zeitwirtschaft.
  • Führe Einführungs- und Transformationsprojekte als Projektleiter eigenverantwortlich zum erfolgreichen Go-Live.
  • Wirke aktiv am Pre-Sales-Prozess mit, indem du deine individuellen Stärken für überzeugende Kundenpräsentationen und passgenaue Lösungsdesigns einbringst.

| WHOM WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Fundierte Praxiserfahrung in SAP SuccessFactors (Schwerpunkt Employee Central, EC Payroll, Time) oder langjährige SAP HCM-Expertise mit ersten SF-Einblicken – unabhängig davon, ob dein Background aus der Beratung, Anwendung oder dem Key-User-Umfeld stammt.
  • Tiefgehendes Fachwissen in mindestens einer der Kerndisziplinen: Entgeltabrechnung, Zeitwirtschaft, Personaladministration oder Organisationsmanagement.
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Freude an der Arbeit mit Menschen, um selbst hochkomplexe Fachthemen zielgruppengerecht und verständlich zu vermitteln.
  • Neugierige Grundhaltung, souveränes Auftreten, hohe Eigenverantwortung und eine konsequente Orientierung an Kundenbedürfnissen.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die reibungslose Mitarbeit in internationalen Projekten.
  • Agile Denkweise gepaart mit praktischer Erfahrung im Einsatz moderner Projektmanagementmethoden.
  • Bereitschaft für sporadische Vor-Ort-Termine bei Kunden oder an Unternehmensstandorten (durchschnittlich etwa einmal pro Monat).
  • Von Vorteil sind Vorkenntnisse in angrenzenden Modulen wie SuccessFactors Compensation, Performance & Goals, Learning oder modernen E-Recruiting-Systemen (z. B. SmartRecruiters).
  • Eine gültige SAP SuccessFactors-Zertifizierung in einem der relevanten Fachbereiche ist ein deutliches Plus.

| REMOTE WORK POLICY

In dieser Rolle kannst du fully remote aus dem Office in Deutschland arbeiten. Bereitschaft zu regelmässigen Kunden- oder Team-workshops/-meetings (ca. 1 mal pro Monat) solltest du allerdings mitbringen - deine Reisekosten werden dabei natürlich übernommen.

| WHAT YOU WILL GET

raw.title: Senior Systems Administrator
raw.excerpt: Company DescriptionZayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society.
raw.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo Group is seeking an experienced and highly motivated System Administrator to join our Network Automation Software Engineering team. Our team develops and maintains the software platforms, microservices, and automation solutions that enable the provisioning, configuration, and management of Zayo's large-scale telecommunications network infrastructure.


In this role, you will be responsible for the availability, performance, reliability, security, and ongoing maintenance of the infrastructure and development platforms that support our network automation ecosystem. These systems are critical to both our software engineering workflows and the operational capabilities of Zayo's network.


You will administer and support a variety of platforms, including Cisco Network Services Orchestrator (NSO), GitLab, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Swarm, and other supporting development, deployment, and automation technologies. Your responsibilities will include system administration, software installation and upgrades, performance tuning, troubleshooting, capacity planning, and proactive maintenance.


The ideal candidate is a highly capable Linux system administrator who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems, takes ownership of system reliability, and is comfortable working with both traditional Linux infrastructure and modern containerized application environments.

You will work closely with software engineers and network engineering teams to ensure our platforms are stable, performant, secure, and capable of meeting evolving business and technical requirements.


Key Responsibilities

Systems Administration & Infrastructure Management

  • Install, configure, administer, and maintain Linux-based servers and application infrastructure supporting the network automation environment.
  • Manage the availability, reliability, and performance of critical platforms, including Cisco NSO, GitLab, Jenkins, Docker, and Docker Swarm.
  • Perform routine system administration tasks, including operating system maintenance, software installations, package management, configuration changes, and system health checks.
  • Plan and execute software upgrades, patches, and platform migrations while minimizing disruption to development workflows and production operations.
  • Monitor system resource utilization, including CPU, memory, disk, network, and application performance, to identify and address potential issues.
  • Perform system tuning and configuration optimization to improve performance, stability, and resource efficiency.
  • Manage system capacity and resource allocation to support application growth and evolving infrastructure requirements.
  • Maintain accurate system documentation, configuration records, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

Platform Administration & Support

  • Administer and maintain Cisco NSO environments, including software upgrades, patching, configuration management, application health monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Support GitLab infrastructure, including repository services, CI/CD runners, application configuration, system upgrades, and performance optimization.
  • Maintain Jenkins servers, agents, plugins, integrations, and build execution environments.
  • Administer Docker hosts and Docker Swarm clusters, including cluster health, node management, service scheduling, networking, storage, and resource allocation.
  • Manage supporting developer tooling and infrastructure services as required by the engineering team.
  • Collaborate with software engineers to troubleshoot application deployments, build failures, infrastructure dependencies, and environment-related issues.
  • Maintain consistent, reliable development, testing, staging, and production environments.

Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Reliability

  • Proactively monitor infrastructure and application health to detect and address potential problems before they impact users or network operations.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex system issues involving Linux, application services, containers, networking, storage, and system dependencies.
  • Investigate service outages, performance degradation, deployment failures, and unexpected system behavior.
  • Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and diagnostic information to identify root causes and implement lasting solutions.
  • Participate in incident response, service restoration, root cause analysis, and preventative improvement efforts.
  • Develop and maintain monitoring, alerting, and health-check capabilities to improve system visibility and reduce operational risk.
  • Identify recurring issues and implement improvements that increase platform stability, recoverability, and maintainability.
  • Establish and maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures for critical infrastructure and application platforms.

Security, Maintenance & Lifecycle Management

  • Apply application updates and security patches in accordance with established maintenance practices.
  • Maintain secure system configurations, appropriate access controls, and service account permissions.
  • Support certificate management, secrets management, and secure communication between infrastructure components.
  • Monitor platform versions, software dependencies, and vendor support lifecycles to identify necessary upgrades or replacements.
  • Evaluate the operational impact of proposed changes and coordinate maintenance activities with affected engineering and operations teams.
  • Ensure infrastructure changes are documented, tested when appropriate, and implemented with suitable rollback procedures.
  • Assist with vulnerability remediation and compliance with organizational security policies.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and maintain scripts and automation tools to reduce manual administration tasks and improve operational consistency.
  • Use scripting languages such as Bash and Python to automate system maintenance, monitoring, configuration, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize system configurations and improve infrastructure management processes.
  • Work with software engineers to improve CI/CD infrastructure, application deployment reliability, and development environment performance.
  • Evaluate and recommend improvements to existing tools, platforms, and operational practices.
  • Contribute to capacity planning, infrastructure modernization, and lifecycle management initiatives.

Collaboration & Operational Ownership

  • Work closely with software engineers, network engineers, security teams, and infrastructure stakeholders to understand system requirements and operational priorities.
  • Serve as a primary technical resource for infrastructure and platform administration within the Network Automation team.
  • Take ownership of infrastructure issues from initial investigation through resolution and follow-up.
  • Participate in team planning, technical discussions, and Agile development activities as appropriate.
  • Communicate maintenance activities, outages, risks, and technical issues clearly to affected stakeholders.
  • Coordinate changes to critical systems to minimize operational disruption.
  • Support production incident response and scheduled maintenance activities, including occasional after-hours work when required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of professional Linux systems administration experience, supporting production servers, applications, or infrastructure platforms.
  • Strong Linux expertise is required, including proficiency with the command line, system configuration, service management, package management, networking, storage, permissions, and process troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, maintaining, upgrading, and troubleshooting applications running on Linux systems.
  • Experience administering Docker or similar container technologies, including container lifecycle management, networking, storage, and resource management.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD platforms and developer tooling, such as GitLab, Jenkins, or similar systems.
  • Experience diagnosing system performance issues and tuning configurations to improve reliability and efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of Linux networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, and troubleshooting connectivity issues.
  • Experience working with system logs, monitoring tools, and performance metrics to diagnose infrastructure problems.
  • Proficiency with shell scripting, particularly Bash, for system automation and administrative tasks.
  • Experience performing software upgrades, applying patches, and managing system maintenance activities in production environments.
  • Understanding of system security principles, access controls, SSH, authentication, and operating system hardening.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, communicate effectively, and collaborate with software engineers and other technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience administering Cisco Network Services Orchestrator (NSO), including installation, configuration, upgrades, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Experience supporting GitLab in a self-managed environment, including GitLab Runners, CI/CD execution infrastructure, backups, and upgrades.
  • Experience administering Jenkins, including controllers, agents, plugins, job execution environments, and integrations.
  • Hands-on experience managing Docker Swarm clusters, including manager and worker nodes, service deployment, overlay networking, persistent storage, and cluster troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting distributed applications and microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting and infrastructure automation.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code or configuration management tools such as Ansible or Terraform.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with centralized logging and log analysis solutions.
  • Experience with Linux performance analysis tools and techniques.
  • Knowledge of high availability, redundancy, load balancing, backup strategies, and disaster recovery.
  • Familiarity with TLS certificates, PKI, secrets management, and application security practices.
  • Experience supporting development teams and maintaining infrastructure used for software development, testing, and continuous delivery.
  • Understanding of network infrastructure, telecommunications systems, or service provider environments.
  • Familiarity with network automation technologies, including NETCONF, RESTCONF, YANG, or network device management systems.
  • Experience supporting applications that interface with APIs, databases, or external infrastructure services.

What Success Looks Like

  • Maintain high availability and reliable performance of the systems that support network automation and software development.
  • Ensure critical platforms, including Cisco NSO, GitLab, Jenkins, and Docker Swarm, are properly maintained, monitored, and kept on supported software versions.
  • Quickly identify, diagnose, and resolve infrastructure issues while minimizing disruption to engineering activities and network operations.
  • Proactively identify performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, security risks, and emerging infrastructure problems.
  • Establish effective monitoring, maintenance, backup, and recovery practices that improve the overall reliability of our systems.
  • Reduce recurring operational issues through automation, documentation, and systematic improvements.
  • Become a trusted technical resource for engineers who depend on the infrastructure you manage.
  • Demonstrate strong ownership of system health, operational stability, and continuous improvement.

Why Join Our Team?

At Zayo, network automation plays a critical role in supporting the scale, reliability, and operational efficiency of our telecommunications infrastructure.

Our Network Automation Software Engineering team builds and operates the software systems that enable network provisioning, configuration, and service management across Zayo's network.


As a System Administrator on this team, you will be responsible for maintaining the foundational infrastructure that allows our software engineers to develop, test, deploy, and operate these critical automation capabilities.

You'll work with a diverse technology stack spanning Linux systems, Cisco NSO, GitLab, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Swarm, and modern software development infrastructure, giving you the opportunity to solve meaningful technical challenges and directly influence the reliability of our engineering platforms.


If you enjoy working hands-on with Linux systems, troubleshooting complex infrastructure problems, and keeping mission-critical platforms running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you


Estimated base salary range: $112,800 - $173,600 USD/annually.

Work Authorization Requirement: This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. Zayo will not provide, transfer, or assume sponsorship for any employment visa or work authorization for this position now or in the future.

The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Non- sales roles may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive plan. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan.


Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off.


The posting will be active for a minimum of 3 days. The active posting will continue to extend by 3 days until the position is filled.


Benefits, Rewards & Wellness

  • Excellent Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Retirement 401(k) Savings Plan
  • Generous paid time off policy including paid parental leave

Zayo is an equal opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact us.


This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.


As part of the application, hiring, onboarding, and/or employment process, Zayo or its affiliates, partners, and vendors may collect, store, and use biometric identifiers and biometric information (collectively, “Biometric Data”), such as fingerprints, facial geometry scans or other unique biological characteristics. Zayo uses CLEAR1, a third-party identity verification service, to verify applicant identity during the hiring process. CLEAR1 may collect Biometric Data, including facial geometry scans and/or other biometric identifiers, to authenticate your identity. Biometric Data will be retained pursuant to CLEAR1’s policies, which can be found here: Zayo will not sell, lease, trade, or otherwise profit from any applicant's or employee's Biometric Data. By proceeding with your application, you acknowledge this disclosure. Prior to any collection of Biometric Data — including through CLEAR — you may be presented with a separate consent form and asked to provide your written authorization in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA), the Texas Capture or Use of Biometric Identifier Act (CUBI), and other applicable biometric privacy statutes.

This is a remote position.

Commitment:Approximately eight hours per week, worked as one day or two half-days
Budget:Up to R4,350 per week, depending on experience and agreed scope
Arrangement:Ongoing freelance / independent contractor
Location:Remote, South Africa-based applicants only

About the opportunity

An established Australian mortgage and commercial finance advisory business is looking for a practical, creative marketer to take ownership of its social media and content marketing.

The business works primarily with professionals, business owners and property investors, helping them understand how debt, lending structure and cash flow can support their financial objectives.

An established brand, substantial AI-assisted content system, founder-led videos and separate technical website support are already in place.

Your role is to turn that material into engaging, consistent marketing that attracts relevant prospective clients.

What you’ll do

Working with the internal team, you will:

  • Refine, visually enhance and publish approximately three content pieces per week.

  • Edit and distribute approximately one short founder-led video per week.

  • Create engaging graphics for Instagram, LinkedIn and website articles.

  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve content quality and workflows.

  • Identify timely financial topics and opportunities for useful content.

  • Coordinate focused marketing and lead-generation initiatives.

  • Monitor website traffic, social engagement and enquiries.

  • Provide a concise monthly report covering results, lessons and recommended changes.

Technical SEO, website development and complex financial research are handled separately.


Requirements

What you’ll bring

You should be creative, commercially minded, organised and comfortable working independently, with:

  • Practical experience managing social media and digital content.

  • Strong graphic design and short-form video editing skills.

  • Experience using AI tools, Canva, CapCut or similar platforms.

  • A reasonable understanding of mortgages, banking, debt and personal finance.

  • Experience with analytics, campaign monitoring and lead generation.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • The initiative to recommend improvements and carry them through without constant supervision.

Experience marketing financial or professional services would be advantageous.

What success looks like

Success means thoughtful content, consistent delivery, stronger engagement from relevant audiences and progress towards generating qualified enquiries.

You’ll monitor results, explain what is working and recommend practical improvements. All substantive financial content will be reviewed and approved internally before publication.

How to apply

following:

  • A brief introduction outlining your relevant experience.

  • Examples of social media visuals and short-form videos you personally created or edited.

  • Examples of campaigns you managed, including results where available.

  • Your proposed weekly fee within the advertised budget.

  • Your availability and how you would allocate approximately eight hours per week.

Clearly explain your contribution to the work you submit.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to discuss how they would use the existing content and improve its effectiveness.

This is intended to be an ongoing working relationship, with regular monthly reviews rather than a lengthy formal trial period.

Web Marketing Manager — Spring Education Group Position Summary Spring Education Group is seeking a Web Marketing Manager to own search engine optimization (SEO) execution, conversion rate optimization (CRO), technical web delivery, and directory data quality across Spring’s ecosystem of 200+ sites. Reporting to the Director of Web Product Marketing, this manager owns the day-to-day delivery and health of our websites and our testing program. You'll be the team's link to IT, keep our sites technically sound for search, decide what's worth testing, and coach a UI/UX designer who builds tests. You'll also manage two analysts. This is a hands-on role that manages and mentors a team of Analysts while partnering closely with the Content, Paid Media, Brand, and Email Lifecycle teams. Position Overview The Web Marketing Manager owns search engine optimization (SEO) execution, conversion rate optimization (CRO), technical web delivery, and directory data quality across Spring Education Group’s ecosystem of 200+ sites. This role serves as the team’s primary information technology (IT) interface, translating business needs into technical specifications and coordinating implementation with technical resources. The manager also leads SEO, experimentation, and analytics programs that translate website data into traffic and conversion gains. This is a hands-on role that manages a team of Analysts and partners closely with the Content, Paid Media, Brand, and Email Lifecycle teams. Key Responsibilities Web Project Execution and IT Coordination (about 50%)

Lead web projects from specifications through IT and developer coordination, user acceptance testing (UAT), and implementation across 200+ sites. Own technical SEO health across our sites: audits, sitemaps, site structure and making sure page changes don't hurt search performance. Serve as the team’s primary interface with IT and engineering resources. Partner with the Director, our content lead and an outside SEO consultant on SEO and AI search priorities, and help roll out their recommendations across our brands. Partner with the Content team to brief Marketing partners on keyword, topic, and page-level optimization priorities.

Experimentation and Conversion (about 30%)

Own the CRO and experimentation roadmap from end to end: establish testing priorities and strategy, then direct team execution from test design and development in Optimizely through analysis and rollout of winning variants. Partner with Paid Media and Content teams to align user journeys, calls to action (CTAs), and page experiences with conversion goals. Identify and prioritize the highest-impact funnel and behavioral insights to test, and direct Analyst efforts accordingly. Use GA4, heatmaps and session recordings to find where families drop off. Translate test results and analytics into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders and leadership.

Data and Analytics (about 10%)

Extract and analyze performance data from GA4, Google Search Console, Domo, and Google Business Profile (GBP) to inform content, SEO, and CRO decisions.

Team Leadership (about 10%)

Manage and mentor Analysts, overseeing website governance, SEO execution, A/B testing, directory management, and day-to-day execution.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience in web management, conversion optimization, experimentation, web analytics. Experience running A/B tests from hypothesis through readout, with a working grasp of sample size, test duration and statistical significance. You should be able to teach test design to someone newer to it. Experience running experiments on websites with low traffic volumes is required. Hands-on analytics skills in GA4 and a business intelligence (BI) tool, such as Domo or a comparable platform. Experience working with IT or developers through specs, prioritization and UAT. Working knowledge of SEO: you've done an SEO audit, worked with an SEO team or fixed technical SEO issues. Strong organizational, project management, cross-functional communication, and collaboration skills. Strong GA4 skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with answer engine optimization (AEO) or AI search. Experience in a multi-brand or multi-location marketing environment. Basic user experience and user interface (UX/UI) literacy sufficient to brief and evaluate external design partners. Testing on lower-traffic sites.

raw.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Role Overview

As Cresta’s first AI Growth Engineer, you'll own the systems behind how Cresta shows up on the internet. In this role, you will own the technical decisions behind cresta.com and help shape how Cresta puts its own AI agents to work for marketing use cases. You'll architect and build our web platform, create the tooling that lets marketers ship without an engineer in the loop, and develop custom AI agents on Cresta's platform. This position requires strong engineering fundamentals, high agency, and the ability to go deep in an unfamiliar domain quickly. If you are self-driven, AI-native, and eager to own something end to end, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

The web platform

  • Own how cresta.com is built end to end: how it’s structured, how content flows through it, and how it connects to everything else.
  • Set the technical vision for how our website stack and CMS should evolve to meet the growing needs of our business and the rapidly changing workflows of the marketing team. Our website runs on Webflow today.
  • Partner with brand and design on the interactive experiences that carry our identity. They set the creative vision; you architect and build it. Own the component system so the site stays consistent as it grows.
  • Own the instrumentation where the site meets our GTM stack — forms, gated content, event tracking, and attribution — so data lands cleanly downstream, in partnership with marketing ops.
  • Build the technical foundation for localization as we scale into new markets, including locale routing, URL architecture, and hreflang, partnering with our web strategy lead on CMS translation workflows and content structure
  • Put in the engineering practices that let us move quickly without breaking things. Enough to ship with confidence, not so much that it slows us down.
  • Ship the technical work behind our SEO and AEO programs, in partnership with the owners of those programs

AI Agent Creation

  • Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents on Cresta's platform for marketing use cases, working alongside our forward deployed engineering team.
  • Take agents from prototype to production, including the evaluation criteria, guardrails, and human review steps prospect-facing work requires.
  • Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through what you learn deploying against a real audience.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years working in software development, web development, AI/ML engineering, or growth engineering.
  • Strong across the stack — application code, APIs, data, and infrastructure — in Python, TypeScript, Node, or similar.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred.
  • A track record of learning a domain fast and going deep. You've been dropped into something unfamiliar and become the person other people come to.
  • High agency. You define your own work, ship without being told what to build, and treat gaps as yours to close.
  • Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Comfortable as the deepest technical voice on a non-engineering team, scoping ambiguous requests and explaining tradeoffs to marketers.
  • Ownership. You treat the outcome as yours, including when something breaks or was built badly before you arrived.

Nice To Have

  • Experience owning a marketing website. Useful context, not a hard requirement.
  • Technical SEO and AEO experience grounded in tests rather than theory.
  • Marketing and GTM systems integration: HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, Segment, GA4, GTM.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Compensation for this position includes a Base Salary + Equity.

Base Salary Range: $160K - $280K + Equity

Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Your recruiter can provide further details. In addition, total compensation includes a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. raw.title: Email & SMS Marketing Strategist
raw.excerpt: The short version You’ll be second in command of a client pod, sitting directly beside a senior Retention Strategist and learning to do their job while you’re still doing yours.
raw.description:
The short version
You’ll be second in command of a client pod, sitting directly beside a senior Retention Strategist and learning to do their job while you’re still doing yours.
Most agency roles at this level hand you a brief and expect you to build it. This one expects you to read the brief, understand why it exists, and tell us when it’s wrong.

Why this role exists
We run client work in pods. Each pod has a Strategist who owns the thinking, the client relationship and the revenue outcome; an Activations Specialist who owns the technical build and QA in Klaviyo; plus a designer and a copywriter.
We kept hitting the same gap. The Strategist gets pulled into execution when things get busy. The Activations Specialist can execute anything but hasn’t been trained to think about why. Neither can fully cover the other.

So we’re building the seat in between.

You’re the Strategist’s right hand. When they’re on a client call, you’re moving the pod. When they’re on leave, you hold the account. When the Activations Specialist is buried, you build. You’re the person who knows enough about both sides to keep an account running without either one of them in the room.
That’s a lot of responsibility for a junior seat. It’s also the fastest way we know to make someone a strategist.

What you’ll learn here
This is the part most job posts skip, so we’ll be specific.
You’ll learn to diagnose instead of guess. Klaviyo revenue is down 20% this month. Is that a flow problem, a deliverability problem, a list fatigue problem, or is store revenue just down and email is fine? Most people at your level can’t tell those apart. You’ll learn to, on real accounts, with a senior strategist checking your reasoning.
You’ll learn what actually moves retention revenue. Flow architecture, segmentation, offer strategy, cadence. Not formatting tweaks, not sending more email.
You’ll learn to think in leverage. On any account there are twenty things you could do. Two of them matter. Picking those two is the entire job of a strategist, and it’s a skill you build by being asked the question every week until you have an answer.
You’ll learn to own a client narrative. What happened, why it happened, what we’re doing about it. Delivered clearly enough that a client trusts you in a bad month, not just a good one.
You’ll sit in gameplan reviews, standups and client calls with senior strategists from day one. You’ll be asked for your view. You’ll be wrong sometimes and told why.
Do this well and you’re running your own pod as a full Strategist inside 12 to 18 months. That’s not a vague promise. It’s the path, and we’ve moved people down it.

What you’ll actually do
Execute at a level that never needs checking. Build flows, campaigns, segments and popups in Klaviyo. Triggers, filters, conditional splits, send windows, suppression logic, UTMs. Correct the first time.
Own QA like your name is on it. Rendering across Gmail, Apple Mail and Outlook. Live links. Dynamic content resolving properly. Exclusions actually excluding. A send with an error is worse than a late send, and you’re the last line before it goes out.
Question the brief. This is the part we mean seriously. If a flow doesn’t make sense, if a segment will overlap with something already live, if the timing will cannibalise a campaign — say it before you build, not after. Executing a bad brief perfectly is still a bad outcome, and we’d rather you push back.
Read the numbers and form a view. Pull the data, then tell us what it means. “Browse abandonment RPR dropped 30% after we changed the segment” is worth more than a clean export.
Keep production honest. ClickUp current in real time. Blockers flagged the moment you see them, not the day of the deadline. Nobody should have to chase you.
Step into either seat when the pod needs it. Cover the Strategist on a call or a weekly update. Cover the build when the Activations Specialist is stretched.

Who this is for
You’re already fast in the tools. This part isn’t negotiable.

  • 2+ years hands-on in Klaviyo for an ecommerce brand or agency. Not “familiar with.” You’ve built multi-branch flows, written nested segment logic, debugged a trigger that wasn’t firing, and know exactly where Klaviyo’s date-relative filters trip people up.
  • Working knowledge of Shopify — how the integration feeds Klaviyo, what the standard events and properties are, where the data breaks.
  • Comfortable with the wider stack (reviews, subscriptions, loyalty, SMS, popups) and able to figure out a new tool without a walkthrough.
  • You want to know why, and you ask.
  • You flag what looks wrong even when it isn’t strictly yours.
  • You can explain a decision in one sentence.
  • You manage your own timelines.

You think past the ticket.

You don’t need to be the smartest person in the room. You need to be curious, accurate, and hard to rattle. We’ll teach you the rest.
This isn’t for you if: you want a pure strategy seat and expect someone else to build. In this role you build, and the building is what earns you the strategic seat.

Setup
Fully remote, full-time. A defined portfolio of ecommerce clients, a small pod you’ll work with daily, and direct access to senior strategists and managers. You will not be left to figure it out alone.
