Department Overview

This position is being posted as a blended role and will be filled as a Program Director 1 or Program Director 2 depending on the candidate's qualifications and experience.

The Center for Health Systems Effectiveness (CHSE) at OHSU is a health policy research center focused on actionable, cross-disciplinary, collaborative research.

The Principal State Evaluation Manager (PSEM) to lead CHSE’s large, multi-year state policy research and evaluation contracts. This is a highly visible leadership role for someone with deep expertise in Medicaid policy and evaluation and a track record of strategic stakeholder engagement. This is not a faculty-track position.

The PSEM is accountable for the successful execution of CHSE’s evaluation of Washington State’s Medicaid Transformation Project (MTP), the state’s Section 1115 Medicaid demonstration waiver. The role spans three connected areas: research oversight and delivery, stakeholder relations, and center leadership.

Research oversight and delivery. The PSEM has final decision-making authority over MTP project management and coordinates faculty and quantitative and qualitative research teams across many evaluation components. This includes providing study teams with the direction and information they need, developing and maintaining timelines, and ensuring appropriate staffing in line with the budget and work needs. The PSEM is responsible for bringing all work together into cohesive final products and often writes reports, manuscripts, and presentations directly.

Stakeholder relations. Strong partnerships are essential both to delivering impactful evaluations and to winning future contracts. The PSEM builds and maintains collaborative relationships with state legislative offices and agency leaders at the program, division, and department levels. Throughout the contract lifecycle, the PSEM bridges differences in how researchers and state partners approach methods, priorities, and timelines.

Center leadership. The PSEM works with a high degree of autonomy and serves on CHSE’s Strategic Research Governing Team, which sets the Center’s vision, develops annual objectives and key results (OKRs), guides center-wide resource planning, and shares CHSE’s findings with policy audiences to inform policy change. The PSEM will serve as a staff mentor and may directly supervise staff. The PSEM works with and is supported by CHSE faculty Principal Investigators, quantitative and qualitative analysts, and a regulatory specialist.

CHSE is committed to a welcoming, inclusive work environment that promotes diversity. We put that into practice through distributed leadership, where staff at every level help shape decisions, and a culture of continuous growth built on feedback in all directions.

Classification and salary are both commensurate with experience, education, and internal equity.

Program Director 1 salary range is $105,414 - $181,771.

Program Director 2 salary range is $121,201- $209,040.

Function/Duties of Position

  • Research oversight: Oversee research methodology, implementation, and completion of state policy evaluation designs, including ongoing consultation, direction, mentorship to qualitative analysts, and collaboration with quantitative colleagues. Understand the full state context. Track analyses across teams and project life cycles to identify and delegate coverage of analysis gaps. Holds final decision-making authority.
  • Project and contract management: Responsible for all aspects of complex research projects, including coordination of qualitative and quantitative teams. Work to establish timelines for project tasks to deliver final products (e.g., reports, briefs, and manuscripts for peer review). Monitor timelines, review output, and work with other staff as needed to revise work or make corrections to deliver results on time and meet high-quality standards. Oversee research compliance (e.g., receipt of IRB approval, execution of data use agreements, and subsequent revisions or amendments), data collection and data management, and data analysis.  
  • Final product delivery: Responsible for high-quality final written reports, manuscripts, and presentations through writing, editing, synthesizing, and coordination across team members. Must meet expectations for review by federal and state agencies.
  • External stakeholder relations management: Serve as the primary contact for state agency sponsors and other key stakeholders, building, fostering, and maintaining positive and collaborative relationships and bringing research literacy to decision-making interactions.
  • Business development: Leverage strong relationships with Washington State to generate and secure additional work with the state. Contribute to research project proposals, including responses to requests for proposals (RFPs) from government agencies and private foundations. Coordinate work on proposals among PIs, faculty, research analysts, and other staff. Prepare project staffing plans and budgets that support sufficient project staffing, high-quality deliverables, and CHSE budget sustainability.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

PD1: Bachelor’s degree in a related field and seven (7) years of progressively responsible program leadership, management, or administrative experience; OR equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

PD2: Bachelor’s degree in a related field and eight (8) years of progressively responsible leadership, management, or administrative experience; OR equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

  • Demonstrated accountability for designing and leading complex, mixed-methods program evaluation, particularly in the field of health policy and across a project life cycle, including development of a scope of work/analysis plan, project kick-off, analysis, QA, interpretation of results, synthesis, report production, and presentation to clients and key stakeholders

The Contract Medical Writer assists in managing various aspects of medical writing activities, ensuring efficiency and compliance with regulations. This role encompasses responsibilities such as the research, creation, and editing of protocols, investigator brochures, clinical study reports, pre-IND briefing books, and IND submissions and updates for clinical trials/research (Phase I-IV). The Contract Medical Writer is also responsible for assisting with the development of corporate practices related to document handling, establishing guidance procedures, and ensuring adherence to corporate standards for clinical writing.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIESinclude the following.

Other duties may be assigned. Employee performs all, part, and/or any combination of the duties listed below.

  1. Collaborate closely with internal and external teams, including Programming, Biostatistics, Regulatory Operations, Quality Operations and Project Management.
  2. Develop and maintain document templates tailored for clinical trials.
  3. Create and maintain writing guides specific to clinical trials.
  4. Lead the development and implementation of study protocols and any protocol amendments.
  5. Provide comprehensive medical writing support throughout the lifecycle of clinical trial studies, including regulatory submissions and various required documents.
    • Initial Investigational New Drug (IND) applications and amendments
    • Protocols and protocol amendments
    • Investigator brochures and updates
    • Interim and final clinical study reports
    • IND annual reports
  6. Ensure all clinical study documentation complies with regulatory requirements.
  7. Proactively coordinate and execute activities in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  8. Manage project timelines and projections proactively.
  9. Ensure project quality through Quality Control of work.
  10. Actively engage in sponsor/project team meetings.
  11. Contribute to departmental and organizational meetings and initiatives.
  12. Maintain open communication with cross-functional groups throughout the project lifecycle and monitor project scope.
  13. Cultivate and maintain key vendor relationships when applicable.
  14. Perform other miscellaneous duties as required.
  15. Participate in corporate initiatives related to SOPs, standardization efforts, methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for projects, programs, and personnel.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • BS/BA in a health-related or life science-related field. Master’s degree preferred.
  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in medical writing is required.
  • Demonstrates extensive experience in the design, execution, and analysis of clinical studies.
  • Experience in the Contract Research Organization (CRO) industry is preferred.

SKILLS and/or ABILITIES

  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with industry principles of drug safety, US and international regulatory guidelines, drug development, biostatistics, pharmacology, and clinical trial methodology.
  • Knowledge of clinical research including regulatory requirement GCP/ICH.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and computer skills.

Contractor shall be responsible for their own insurance.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a contractor to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the Contractor regularly reaches with hands and arms. The contractor periodically is required to lift and/or carry up to 10 pounds. Occasionally, contractor stoops, bends, kneels, and crouches; and pushes/pulls filled wheeled carts. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a contractor encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

May work in an office or home office environment where the noise level is largely controlled by the contractor. Contractor may be subject to many interruptions; pressure due to meet deadline requirements; and handling multiple tasks simultaneously while performing assigned duties.

SAFETY REQUIREMENTS

In the interest of safety, Lotus Clinical Research contractors should practice safe use of cell phones and other mobile devices while driving on Company business and/or Company time, if applicable.

raw.description:
As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Position Summary

The Pricing Accountant supports the daily pricing and valuation activities that underpin accurate unit value calculations across the organization. This role offers the opportunity to build broad knowledge of the mutual fund pricing function, financial operations, systems, corporate actions, and audit support.

This is a dual-level opportunity. The position will be filled at the F or G level based on the selected candidate’s experience, capabilities, and readiness. Candidates who demonstrate strong potential but are not yet ready for the G level may be hired at the F level with a development path toward expanded responsibilities and G-level expectations.

The successful candidate will bring strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to learn all facets of the pricing functions rather than specialize in a single area. This role is also intended to build the breadth of business knowledge, credibility, and leadership capability needed for future people leadership opportunities. As experience grows, the role may take on increasing responsibility for coordinating work, supporting team capability, reinforcing quality standards, and helping improve team processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather daily net asset value, dividend-per-share, and capital-gain-per-share information for nearly 8,000 mutual funds from approximately 300 mutual fund companies.
  • Use mutual fund pricing information to support approximately 930,000 unit value calculations each day the New York Stock Exchange is open.
  • Review pricing inputs and processes to help ensure the accuracy of each unit value calculation.
  • Calculate net asset values for approximately 81 fund-of-fund portfolios across three different NRS plans using the MFACT vendor package.
  • Work with the UVC system, the front-end financial operations system supporting the pricing function.
  • Assist with corporate action activities, including mutual fund name changes, mutual fund mergers, unit value calculations, and internal mapping structures.
  • Support internal and external audit requests by providing accurate information and documentation.
  • Develop working knowledge across all areas of the pricing function and contribute to process improvements and team initiatives.
  • Take ownership of assigned work, exercise sound judgment, and identify and resolve issues in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate effectively with partners across teams and positively influence and develop others without direct authority.
  • Coordinate assigned daily pricing activities and communicate priorities, coverage needs, and handoffs to help the team meet nightly deadlines
  • Provide peer coaching, process guidance, and cross-training; help teammates build working knowledge across pricing activities and systems.
  • Support consistent execution by maintaining clear process documentation and communicating updates to affected partners.
  • Partner with the manager and teammates to identify recurring issues and implement practical process improvements.
  • Build the business perspective and organizational knowledge needed to support future expanded responsibilities and leadership opportunities.

Work Schedule

Nightly pricing responsibilities typically continue until approximately 9:30 p.m. and may extend later depending on business needs. The Pricing Accountant must be willing to work a rotating schedule to provide coverage for nightly pricing processes. Certain Nationwide Holidays where the market is open will also need nightly coverage.


Required Qualifications

  • FINRA Series 6 registration. Candidates who do not currently hold the designation must obtain it within one year of their hire date.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office products, particularly Microsoft Access and Excel.
  • Knowledge of mutual funds and related pricing or valuation concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new systems, processes, and business concepts quickly.
  • Ability to take ownership, use sound judgment, meet deadlines, and deliver dependable results.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with mutual fund pricing, net asset value calculations, unit value calculations, financial operations, or related investment operations.
  • Experience working with financial systems, vendor applications, corporate actions, or audit requests.
  • Demonstrated interest in learning multiple areas of a function and expanding organizational knowledge.
  • Experience influencing, coaching, mentoring, or developing others without formal supervisory authority.
  • Evidence of leadership potential and a desire to pursue future people leadership opportunities.

 

Success in This Role

Success in this position means delivering accurate and timely pricing results today while continuously expanding knowledge across the pricing function. As responsibilities expand, success also includes helping the team deliver consistently through clear coordination, effective knowledge sharing, constructive peer coaching, timely escalation of quality concerns, and practical process improvements. The ideal candidate will be curious, adaptable, accountable, and collaborative, with the credibility and leadership mindset to influence others and grow into future leadership opportunities.


This position can be staffed remotely for potential applicants with critical industry skills and relevant experience.


This role does not qualify for employer sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the STEM OPT extension program.

About The Role:

As a CBRE Sector Lead - Managing Director, you will lead consulting services to several high-profile groups of corporate real estate clients to support the growth and delivery of our advisory services in Workplace and Portfolio Strategy, Occupancy Planning, and Change Management.   • Act as the conduit between the CBRE consulting platform and our account teams to ensure alignment between services and contract obligations.
  • Supervise organizational performance and report on data collected.
  • Manage the annual account resource and workplace technology budget, provide administrative mentorship, and report on account financial health.
  • Develop sophisticated strategies to reduce costs for clients for resources, workplace technology, and programs/processes.
  • Gain an in-depth understanding of the client's business. Ensure that resources and programs align with the business’s strategic direction.
  • Supply expert commercial and financial knowledge during business strategy development and presentations.
  • Provide formal supervision to employees, supervise staff training and development, conduct performance evaluations and coaching, and coordinate the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
  • Apply a robust knowledge of multiple subject areas, the business, and key drivers which impact departmental and cross-functional performance.
  • Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Persuade managers and other colleagues to take action while being guided by the organization's functional business plans. Negotiate with external partners, vendors, and customers of divergent interests to reach a common goal.
  • Identify and solve complex, sophisticated, operational, and organizational problems leveraging the appropriate resources within or outside the department.
  • Significantly improves and changes existing methods, processes, and standards within job field.

What You'll Need:

To perform this job successfully, an individual will need to perform each crucial duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.   • Bachelor's Degree preferred with 8-12 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.

  • Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention is preferred.

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to realize your full potential.

Our Values in Hiring:

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. raw.description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.


Job Description

Main purpose of the role & responsibilities in the business:

At Kainos, we provide innovative and creative products designed to help Workday customers reduce risk and maximize their Workday investment. Our solutions include Workday testing, compliance, data masking, and document management. As a business with a proven record of year-on-year growth and over 500 customers we have multiple exciting opportunities for Product Owners across each of our growth products.


As a Product Owner at Kainos, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our market leading Workday solutions. You'll own the product backlog across one or more functional areas, ensuring we stay at the forefront of the industry. This means you'll gather and prioritize product and customer requirements, and work closely with our top-notch development, sales, pre-sales, marketing, and professional services teams to surpass customer satisfaction goals and maintain our leading market position.


Your passion for product management will shine through in everything you do. You will relish the challenge of solving complex problems and experience the thrill of seeing your products flourish and make a real difference. This is your chance to make a significant impact and leave your mark on our products and services during this exciting growth phase. As a result you will have ample opportunities to advance into senior roles within the Workday Products business or the wider Kainos organisation. Join us at Kainos and be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future with innovative and impactful products.


You will be responsible for:

  • Understanding customer needs, personas and why they engage with your product.
  • Becoming an expert in the problems we solve for and “why” they matter.
  • Running structured workshops with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Defining and building solutions to address customer needs.
  • Defining the benefits your solutions deliver and how to measure success.
  • Know your competition and how to stay ahead of them.
  • Launching products and features including organising and enabling internal teams such as delivery, pre-sales, onboarding to maximise impact etc.
  • Supporting Roadmap Delivery and the product backlog;
    • Creating actionable user stories for development teams.
    • Supporting the prioritision of the backlog to ensure goals are met.
    • Identifying and measuring the success criteria for each delivered feature.
    • Defining and communicating release acceptance criteria for each product feature, including the criteria for MVP.
    • Measuring, tracking and improving non-functional aspects of the product.
  • As required, stepping in to support sales efforts with product demos and customer discussions on more technical aspects of the product.

Minimum (essential) requirements:

  • Experience of leading and architecting Workday based solutions
  • Demonstrable experience of delivering as part of an agile team. This should include excellent user story creation skills, articulating the business needs in a format that is easily consumable by the scrum team
  • Excellent communication skills are vital. You’ll need to be a persuasive and effective communicator with strong negotiating skills. It’s not only about talking, you’ll need to be able to listen, understand, and build on other’s viewpoints.
  • You will have an enthusiasm for new technologies and innovation and be prepared to take advantage of the flexibility provided to challenge and be proactive in bringing new ideas to how we work and to the product roadmap.
  • You will need an eye for detail, particularly to interpret supplied information and understand sources and challenge where necessary.
  • Comfort and ability to engage with customers (including internal) to understand requirements, and support functional or technical product discussions.

Desirable:

  • Prior Workday implementation or management
  • Experience with Product Management in a Workday context

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

The Contract Medical Writer assists in managing various aspects of medical writing activities, ensuring efficiency and compliance with regulations. This role encompasses responsibilities such as the research, creation, and editing of protocols, investigator brochures, clinical study reports, pre-IND briefing books, and IND submissions and updates for clinical trials/research (Phase I-IV). The Contract Medical Writer is also responsible for assisting with the development of corporate practices related to document handling, establishing guidance procedures, and ensuring adherence to corporate standards for clinical writing.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIESinclude the following.

Other duties may be assigned. Employee performs all, part, and/or any combination of the duties listed below.

  1. Collaborate closely with internal and external teams, including Programming, Biostatistics, Regulatory Operations, Quality Operations and Project Management.
  2. Develop and maintain document templates tailored for clinical trials.
  3. Create and maintain writing guides specific to clinical trials.
  4. Lead the development and implementation of study protocols and any protocol amendments.
  5. Provide comprehensive medical writing support throughout the lifecycle of clinical trial studies, including regulatory submissions and various required documents.
    • Initial Investigational New Drug (IND) applications and amendments
    • Protocols and protocol amendments
    • Investigator brochures and updates
    • Interim and final clinical study reports
    • IND annual reports
  6. Ensure all clinical study documentation complies with regulatory requirements.
  7. Proactively coordinate and execute activities in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  8. Manage project timelines and projections proactively.
  9. Ensure project quality through Quality Control of work.
  10. Actively engage in sponsor/project team meetings.
  11. Contribute to departmental and organizational meetings and initiatives.
  12. Maintain open communication with cross-functional groups throughout the project lifecycle and monitor project scope.
  13. Cultivate and maintain key vendor relationships when applicable.
  14. Perform other miscellaneous duties as required.
  15. Participate in corporate initiatives related to SOPs, standardization efforts, methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for projects, programs, and personnel.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • BS/BA in a health-related or life science-related field. Master’s degree preferred.
  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in medical writing is required.
  • Demonstrates extensive experience in the design, execution, and analysis of clinical studies.
  • Experience in the Contract Research Organization (CRO) industry is preferred.

SKILLS and/or ABILITIES

  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with industry principles of drug safety, US and international regulatory guidelines, drug development, biostatistics, pharmacology, and clinical trial methodology.
  • Knowledge of clinical research including regulatory requirement GCP/ICH.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and computer skills.

Contractor shall be responsible for their own insurance.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a contractor to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the Contractor regularly reaches with hands and arms. The contractor periodically is required to lift and/or carry up to 10 pounds. Occasionally, contractor stoops, bends, kneels, and crouches; and pushes/pulls filled wheeled carts. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a contractor encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

May work in an office or home office environment where the noise level is largely controlled by the contractor. Contractor may be subject to many interruptions; pressure due to meet deadline requirements; and handling multiple tasks simultaneously while performing assigned duties.

SAFETY REQUIREMENTS

In the interest of safety, Lotus Clinical Research contractors should practice safe use of cell phones and other mobile devices while driving on Company business and/or Company time, if applicable.

raw.excerpt: As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless!
raw.description:
As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Position Summary

The Pricing Accountant supports the daily pricing and valuation activities that underpin accurate unit value calculations across the organization. This role offers the opportunity to build broad knowledge of the mutual fund pricing function, financial operations, systems, corporate actions, and audit support.

This is a dual-level opportunity. The position will be filled at the F or G level based on the selected candidate’s experience, capabilities, and readiness. Candidates who demonstrate strong potential but are not yet ready for the G level may be hired at the F level with a development path toward expanded responsibilities and G-level expectations.

The successful candidate will bring strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to learn all facets of the pricing functions rather than specialize in a single area. This role is also intended to build the breadth of business knowledge, credibility, and leadership capability needed for future people leadership opportunities. As experience grows, the role may take on increasing responsibility for coordinating work, supporting team capability, reinforcing quality standards, and helping improve team processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather daily net asset value, dividend-per-share, and capital-gain-per-share information for nearly 8,000 mutual funds from approximately 300 mutual fund companies.
  • Use mutual fund pricing information to support approximately 930,000 unit value calculations each day the New York Stock Exchange is open.
  • Review pricing inputs and processes to help ensure the accuracy of each unit value calculation.
  • Calculate net asset values for approximately 81 fund-of-fund portfolios across three different NRS plans using the MFACT vendor package.
  • Work with the UVC system, the front-end financial operations system supporting the pricing function.
  • Assist with corporate action activities, including mutual fund name changes, mutual fund mergers, unit value calculations, and internal mapping structures.
  • Support internal and external audit requests by providing accurate information and documentation.
  • Develop working knowledge across all areas of the pricing function and contribute to process improvements and team initiatives.
  • Take ownership of assigned work, exercise sound judgment, and identify and resolve issues in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate effectively with partners across teams and positively influence and develop others without direct authority.
  • Coordinate assigned daily pricing activities and communicate priorities, coverage needs, and handoffs to help the team meet nightly deadlines
  • Provide peer coaching, process guidance, and cross-training; help teammates build working knowledge across pricing activities and systems.
  • Support consistent execution by maintaining clear process documentation and communicating updates to affected partners.
  • Partner with the manager and teammates to identify recurring issues and implement practical process improvements.
  • Build the business perspective and organizational knowledge needed to support future expanded responsibilities and leadership opportunities.

Work Schedule

Nightly pricing responsibilities typically continue until approximately 9:30 p.m. and may extend later depending on business needs. The Pricing Accountant must be willing to work a rotating schedule to provide coverage for nightly pricing processes. Certain Nationwide Holidays where the market is open will also need nightly coverage.


Required Qualifications

Sector Lead - Managing Director

About The Role:

As a CBRE Sector Lead - Managing Director, you will lead consulting services to several high-profile groups of corporate real estate clients to support the growth and delivery of our advisory services in Workplace and Portfolio Strategy, Occupancy Planning, and Change Management. You will also guide the consulting business in multiple geographic regions.
This job is part of the Client Consulting function. They are responsible for Advisory services in relation to real estate operations and investments.

What You'll Do:

  • Collaborate with Regional Group Presidents and Sr. Management to implement enterprise critical initiatives.
  • Achieve insight into market performance against growth and other operational objectives.
  • Build real estate strategies and consulting teams for large-size clients.
  • Deliver strategies with assigned clients. Develop solutions to assist with regional portfolio critical initiatives.
  • Align business direction and vision with senior management.
  • Act as the conduit between the CBRE consulting platform and our account teams to ensure alignment between services and contract obligations.
  • Supervise organizational performance and report on data collected.
  • Manage the annual account resource and workplace technology budget, provide administrative mentorship, and report on account financial health.
  • Develop sophisticated strategies to reduce costs for clients for resources, workplace technology, and programs/processes.
  • Gain an in-depth understanding of the client's business. Ensure that resources and programs align with the business’s strategic direction.
  • Supply expert commercial and financial knowledge during business strategy development and presentations.
  • Provide formal supervision to employees, supervise staff training and development, conduct performance evaluations and coaching, and coordinate the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
  • Apply a robust knowledge of multiple subject areas, the business, and key drivers which impact departmental and cross-functional performance.
  • Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Persuade managers and other colleagues to take action while being guided by the organization's functional business plans. Negotiate with external partners, vendors, and customers of divergent interests to reach a common goal.
  • Identify and solve complex, sophisticated, operational, and organizational problems leveraging the appropriate resources within or outside the department.
  • Significantly improves and changes existing methods, processes, and standards within job field.

What You'll Need:

To perform this job successfully, an individual will need to perform each crucial duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
  • Bachelor's Degree preferred with 8-12 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
  • Prior experience in servicing clients or managing projects in the healthcare sector, with a strong preference for candidates who have worked with life sciences clientele.
  • Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention is preferred.
  • Ability to lead the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and balance problems
  • Leadership skills to set, manage and achieve targets with a direct impact on multiple department results within a function.
  • In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
  • Expert organizational skills and an advanced inquisitive approach.
  • Sophisticated math skills. Ability to calculate mildly sophisticated figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

Why CBRE:

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to realize your full potential.

Our Values in Hiring:

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

The minimum salary for the Sector Lead - Managing Director position is $150,000 annually and the maximum salary for the position is $180,000 annually. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. Successful candidates will also be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on CBRE’s applicable benefit program. raw.description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.


Job Description

Main purpose of the role & responsibilities in the business:

At Kainos, we provide innovative and creative products designed to help Workday customers reduce risk and maximize their Workday investment. Our solutions include Workday testing, compliance, data masking, and document management. As a business with a proven record of year-on-year growth and over 500 customers we have multiple exciting opportunities for Product Owners across each of our growth products.


As a Product Owner at Kainos, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our market leading Workday solutions. You'll own the product backlog across one or more functional areas, ensuring we stay at the forefront of the industry. This means you'll gather and prioritize product and customer requirements, and work closely with our top-notch development, sales, pre-sales, marketing, and professional services teams to surpass customer satisfaction goals and maintain our leading market position.


Your passion for product management will shine through in everything you do. You will relish the challenge of solving complex problems and experience the thrill of seeing your products flourish and make a real difference. This is your chance to make a significant impact and leave your mark on our products and services during this exciting growth phase. As a result you will have ample opportunities to advance into senior roles within the Workday Products business or the wider Kainos organisation. Join us at Kainos and be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future with innovative and impactful products.


You will be responsible for:

  • Understanding customer needs, personas and why they engage with your product.
  • Becoming an expert in the problems we solve for and “why” they matter.
  • Running structured workshops with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Defining and building solutions to address customer needs.
  • Defining the benefits your solutions deliver and how to measure success.
  • Know your competition and how to stay ahead of them.
  • Launching products and features including organising and enabling internal teams such as delivery, pre-sales, onboarding to maximise impact etc.
  • Supporting Roadmap Delivery and the product backlog;
    • Creating actionable user stories for development teams.
    • Supporting the prioritision of the backlog to ensure goals are met.
    • Identifying and measuring the success criteria for each delivered feature.
    • Defining and communicating release acceptance criteria for each product feature, including the criteria for MVP.
    • Measuring, tracking and improving non-functional aspects of the product.
  • As required, stepping in to support sales efforts with product demos and customer discussions on more technical aspects of the product.

Minimum (essential) requirements:

  • Experience of leading and architecting Workday based solutions
  • Demonstrable experience of delivering as part of an agile team. This should include excellent user story creation skills, articulating the business needs in a format that is easily consumable by the scrum team
  • Excellent communication skills are vital. You’ll need to be a persuasive and effective communicator with strong negotiating skills. It’s not only about talking, you’ll need to be able to listen, understand, and build on other’s viewpoints.
  • You will have an enthusiasm for new technologies and innovation and be prepared to take advantage of the flexibility provided to challenge and be proactive in bringing new ideas to how we work and to the product roadmap.
  • You will need an eye for detail, particularly to interpret supplied information and understand sources and challenge where necessary.
  • Comfort and ability to engage with customers (including internal) to understand requirements, and support functional or technical product discussions.

Desirable:

  • Prior Workday implementation or management
  • Experience with Product Management in a Workday context

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

raw.excerpt: ABOUT GENERATIONAt Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives.
raw.description:
ABOUT GENERATION

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

As part of the BOOST Project, Generation is expanding its network of experienced freelance professionals to support and mentor Digital Marketing graduates as they transition into freelancing and remote work opportunities. Through expert mentorship, practical guidance, and industry connections, Super Agents play a critical role in helping graduates build sustainable freelance careers, secure income-generating opportunities, and achieve greater financial independence.

JOB OBJECTIVES

Generation is seeking experienced freelance Digital Marketing professionals based in South Africa (Johannesburg preferred) to serve as Super Agents and mentors for graduates entering the freelance/gig economy.

As Super Agent, you will play a critical role in guiding, coaching, and supporting graduates as they build freelance careers, secure clients, deliver quality work, and generate sustainable income. This role combines mentoring, technical guidance, accountability coaching, freelance business development support, and practical knowledge sharing.

The ideal candidate is an experienced Digital Marketing freelancer with a successful track record of delivering client work, building freelance income streams, and supporting others to grow professionally.

Most importantly, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about helping young people build skills, confidence, and financial independence through freelancing and remote work.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Mentorship & Coaching

  • Provide ongoing one-on-one and group mentoring sessions for assigned graduates.
  • Support graduates in applying digital marketing skills in real-world client environments.
  • Guide graduates in building confidence, professionalism, and effective work habits.
  • Provide constructive feedback on portfolios, proposals, project work, and client communications.
  • Help graduates identify strengths, overcome challenges, and achieve their professional goals

Freelance Career Development

  • Share practical insights from your own freelance journey and professional experience.
  • Support graduates in understanding the freelance marketplace and how to position themselves effectively.
  • Help graduates identify opportunities for income generation through freelance and remote work.
  • Guide graduates in building sustainable freelance businesses and long-term client relationships.
  • Advise graduates on sourcing opportunities through personal networks, referrals, direct outreach, LinkedIn, and freelance platforms.

Pricing Strategy & Business Development Support

  • Guide graduates in developing competitive and sustainable pricing strategies.
  • Support graduates in packaging and positioning their services effectively.
  • Review proposals and quotations and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Help graduates understand client discovery, negotiation, and project scoping processes.
  • Provide practical advice on managing freelance income and growing client accounts.

Profile Setup & Optimization

  • Assist graduates in creating and optimizing professional profiles on platforms such as LinkedIn, Upwork, Fiverr, Contra, and other relevant marketplaces.
  • Review graduate portfolios and recommend improvements in line with global recruitment standards.
  • Support graduates in developing compelling personal brands and professional online presence.
  • Advise graduates on improving profile visibility and attracting potential clients.

Project Support & Quality Assurance

About Us

Sanofi focuses on developing specialty treatments for debilitating diseases that are often difficult to diagnose and treat, providing hope to patients and their families.

Sanofi has pioneered the development and delivery of transformative therapies for patients affected by rare and debilitating diseases for over 30 years. We accomplish our goals through world-class research, collaboration with the global patient community, and with the compassion and commitment of our employees. With a focus on rare diseases, oncology, immunology, and multiple sclerosis, we are dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of the patients and families we serve. Sanofi's portfolio of transformative therapies, which are marketed in countries around the world, represent groundbreaking and life-saving advances in medicine.

At Sanofi, we are committed to the growth of our people, connected in purpose by career, life, and health.

The Rare Blood Disorders franchise is a patient-centric organization responsible for delivering the highest quality education and service regarding disease and treatment. The goal of the franchise is to penetrate existing and new markets to meet business goals by educating physicians and healthcare professionals on a portfolio of products while upholding the Company's mission and values.   

About the job

The Corporate Accounts and Precision Medicine Orchestrator is a strategic, cross-functional role that partners with the Precision Medicine Executive (PME), Key Account Manager (KAM), and Corporate Account Director (CAD) field teams to “orchestrate” consistent, high-quality execution of account and precision medicine strategies. Reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Accounts and Precision Medicine, this individual will create field enablement resources, deliver KPI reporting and analysis, and serve as the operational liaison to the Go-To-Market Capabilities (GTMC) organization.

The Orchestrator will translate field and leadership needs into clear requirements for GTMC, coordinate priorities and timelines, and help ensure the PME, KAM, and CAD teams have the tools, data, and resources needed to execute account plans and diagnostic and precision medicine initiatives effectively and in full compliance with company policies.

Responsibilities

Field Enablement (PME, KAM, and CAD Teams)

· Partner with the PME, KAM, and CAD teams and their leaders to identify enablement needs and priorities across account, GPO, and diagnostic and precision medicine activities.

· Create and maintain field enablement resources, including account planning templates, playbooks, process guides, quick-reference tools, and training and onboarding materials for new team members.

· Support the rollout of new tools, processes, and approved resources, including communication, training, and adoption follow-up.

· Gather field feedback on workflows, tools, and barriers, and translate it into practical improvements.

· Identify and share best practices across the three field teams to promote aligned, consistent execution.

· Ensure enablement resources reflect approved content and follow applicable review and compliance processes.

KPI Reporting and Analysis

· Partner with the VP and team leaders to define KPIs and success measures for PME, KAM, and CAD activities.

· Develop, maintain, and distribute recurring KPI reports, dashboards, and scorecards at the team, region, and account level using GTMC reporting and analytics platforms.

· Analyze account, GPO, diagnostic testing, and field activity data to identify trends, performance gaps, and opportunities, and deliver clear insights and recommendations to leadership.

· Prepare data and analysis to support business reviews, leadership meetings, and planning cycles.

· Support account prioritization, segmentation, and target-list refinement using data and field insights.

· Promote consistent metric definitions and data accuracy, and identify and escalate data quality issues.

· Train field teams to use dashboards and reports to support account planning and pre-call planning.

GTMC Operational Liaison

· Serve as the primary operational liaison between the PME, KAM, and CAD teams and GTMC, including the IT and Operations teams that support CRM, reporting, and analytics.

· Translate field and leadership needs into clear business requirements, and submit and track requests for CRM enhancements, report changes, data access, and system issues.

· Coordinate priorities, timelines, and communication so the needs of the three field teams are represented in GTMC planning and release cycles.

· Participate in testing and validation of CRM and reporting enhancements, and communicate changes and available capabilities to the field.

· Maintain a clear intake and tracking process for field requests and issues, and provide regular status updates to field teams and leadership.

· Optimize the use of CRM and related systems to improve data accuracy and streamline field workflows.

Orchestration and Special Projects

· Coordinate operating rhythms across the PME, KAM, and CAD teams, including meeting cadences, planning calendars, and action tracking.

· Lead or support special projects and process improvements that increase efficiency, alignment, and collaboration across the three field teams.

· Partner with Marketing, Market Access, Medical, Sales Operations, and other cross-functional teams to align resources and reduce duplication of effort.

· Leverage analytics and AI tools to generate customer insights and recommendations that support resource allocation and execution.

· Operate in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and Sanofi policies and procedures.

About You

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device sales experience, and/or in sales operations, commercial or sales excellence, field operations, account operations, analytics, or other relevant life science or clinical experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing field enablement, training, or communication resources for commercial teams.
  • Proven ability to build KPI reports and dashboards and to turn data into clear, actionable insights.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM systems (e.g., Veeva CRM) and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI), with advanced Excel skills.
  • Demonstrated success working cross-functionally and influencing without direct authority.
  • Experience in rare disease, hematology/oncology, or another specialty market.
  • Familiarity with corporate or key account management, GPO and enterprise agreements, or precision medicine and diagnostic testing.
  • Strong project management, organization, and prioritization skills to manage multiple initiatives at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information for field and leadership audiences.
  • Working knowledge of compliance requirements in a pharmaceutical commercial environment.
  • Ability to travel as business needs require, including to field and team meetings.
  • Familiarity with AI and advanced analytics tools to support customer insights and resource allocation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, curiosity, adaptability, and a customer-centric, patient-focused mindset.

Why choose us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

Pursue progress, discover extraordinary

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

Who we are:

At Vireo, we're growing something bigger than a business. The best part is that we're just getting started.

What sets us apart isn't just our footprint. It's our people. From cultivation and manufacturing to retail, corporate operations, and our expanding agribusiness ventures, every role here plays a real part in shaping where this industry goes next. We look for people with drive, a positive attitude, and a genuine desire to make a difference and in return, we offer real opportunities to grow, contribute, and make an impact.

We're also proud to be one of the most diverse and inclusive workplaces in cannabis. Our culture is built on collaboration, respect, and continuous improvement. This shows in how we support each other, engage with our communities, and celebrate wins together.

If you're ready to turn your passion into a career, we'd love to have you on the team. Let's grow the future together.

What we offer:

  • Compensation: $80,000-85,000 annually depending on experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance on the first of the month after you begin employment

  • Competitive additional benefits including HSA, FSA, Dependable Care, EAP services, etc.

  • 15 Days of accrued PTO in addition to 2 Wellness Days & Volunteer Hours that will increase with tenure

What the role is about:

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will play a key role in building our team by finding and connecting with top talent across the organization. You'll manage the full recruitment cycle, from sourcing to hiring, providing flexible support for retail, operations, cultivation, production, and corporate teams depending on the needs of the business. You'll do this while creating a positive candidate experience. The ideal candidate is resourceful, personable, and excited about helping a growing company thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced industry.

What impact you'll make:

  • Post job openings and source candidates via job boards, social media, and networking, tailoring strategies to the unique talent pools for retail, operations, cultivation, production, and corporate roles

  • Support the full recruitment life cycle — from screening candidates and coordinating interviews with hiring managers to extending offers — across multiple departments and business functions

  • Help maintain candidate pipelines and databases, including high-volume pipelines for retail and production roles as well as specialized pipelines for cultivation and corporate positions

  • Assist in preparing recruitment materials and job descriptions specific to retail, operations, cultivation, production, and corporate functions

  • Conduct regular recruitment training for hiring managers and interviewers across departments

  • Support compliance with state and federal employment regulations across all supported business areas

  • Provide a positive candidate experience and help build relationships with potential hires at every level, from frontline retail and production roles to corporate positions

  • Develop and execute strategies to strengthen the company's employer brand, including creating engaging job postings, managing social media recruitment campaigns, and coordinating candidate events

  • Track recruitment metrics and help prepare reports for HR leadership, highlighting trends across retail, operations, cultivation, production, and corporate recruiting

  • Continue to evolve our recruitment strategies and processes to meet the needs of a growing, multi-functional business

What you’ve accomplished:

  • 3+ years of recruiting experience, preferably in retail or hospitality; cannabis industry experience a strong plus

  • Proven experience with full-cycle recruitment

  • Strong understanding of employment laws and compliance requirements

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (ATS) and recruiting tools

Why Choose Vireo?

Life’s too short to work somewhere that doesn’t ignite your passion. The cannabis industry is fast-paced, innovative, and full of opportunity—where science meets creativity, and wellness meets culture.  

 

At Vireo Health, we’re pioneering the future of cannabis with a team that’s as dynamic as the industry itself. Here, you’ll find a workplace that’s collaborative, inclusive, and driven by HEART and purpose, where your work has a real impact on people’s lives.  
 
Whether you’re cultivating the highest-quality plants, crafting cutting-edge products, or shaping unforgettable customer experiences, you’ll be part of something bigger. If you’re looking for a career that’s exciting, meaningful, and full of growth, let’s build the future of cannabis together.  
 
✅ A Growing Industry: Work at the leading tech company in the cannabis industry and help shape the future 
✅ Passionate Culture: Join a team that truly cares about the plant, the people, and the purpose behind what we do 
✅ Employee Perks: Enjoy competitive pay and benefits, paid time off, and employee discounts 
✅ Making an Impact: We’re committed to education, sustainability, and giving back to the communities we serve. 
 
EEO Statement

Our Yugabeings (distributed, like our database) span 12+ countries and multiple time zones, sharing expertise from diverse backgrounds and industries.

Developer Advocate, Community

Location: Remote US

About the role

Yugabyte has redefined the data infrastructure developers use for distributed Postgres applications and multi-agent AI systems. As a Developer Advocate focused on Yugabyte’s rapidly growing community, you will energize the developers building with YugabyteDB, YugabyteDB AMP (Agentic Multitenant Postgres), and Meko, our agent-native data platform that gives multi-agent systems shared memory and knowledge.

You will own community programs end-to-end, including workshops, meetups, hackathons, partner events, and the online spaces where developers ask questions, share what they built, and help each other. Success in this role means more developers showing up, building something real, and coming back. You will work closely with product, engineering, marketing, and the rest of the DevRel team, and you will bring what you hear from the community into the roadmap. Most importantly, you will collaborate with the rest of our Developer Advocacy team to present a unified, global approach to how we work with devs. This is a fun role on a fun team at the most important (and fun) time in our company’s history. Should be fun!

What you’ll do

Grow the community

  • Build and run a community growth plan across YugabyteDB, YugabyteDB AMP, and Meko, with goals for membership, active participation, and contribution.
  • Run and grow the Yugabyte community Slack and Discord, and build an active presence in the channels where developers already gather, including Reddit, GitHub, Stack Overflow, LinkedIn, Bluesky, and X.
  • Launch programs that recognize and reward participation, such as a community champions program, contributor spotlights, and regular office hours.
  • Turn active community members into speakers, authors, sample app contributors, and meetup hosts.

Run hands-on events

  • Design and deliver workshops that take developers from first install to a working app, including labs on building agent memory with Meko and multi-tenant Postgres applications on YugabyteDB AMP.
  • Launch and scale Yugabyte-run meetups in key developer hubs, and support community-led chapters with playbooks, content, and swag.
  • Organize virtual and in-person hackathons, including AI agent hackathons built on Meko and YugabyteDB.
  • Represent Yugabyte at developer conferences such as KubeCon, PGConf.dev, Linux Foundation events, and AI engineering conferences, running demos, workshops, and booth sessions.
  • Contribute community programming to Yugabyte’s Distributed SQL Summit, such as hands-on labs, community tracks, and DevRel sessions.

Build with partners

  • Co-host workshops, meetups, and hackathons with cloud, AI framework, and open source ecosystem partners.
  • Create sample apps, integrations, and tutorials that show YugabyteDB, AMP, and Meko working alongside the agent frameworks, developer tools, and cloud platforms developers already use.
  • Build relationships with user groups and open source projects in the Postgres, Kubernetes, and AI agent communities.

Create content the community uses

  • Produce demos, tutorials, sample apps, blogs, livestreams, and webinars, both live and recorded.
  • Package workshops into reusable kits and starter templates that community leaders and partners can run on their own.
  • Hold developer-facing content, quickstarts, and getting-started paths to a high bar for clarity and accuracy.

Be the voice of the developer

  • Collect feedback from community channels, events, and hackathons, and bring it to product and engineering in a form they can act on.
  • Track and report community health, including growth, engagement, event attendance, and conversion to active usage.
  • Help shape the DevRel strategy, processes, and tooling, including community platforms and event tech stack.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in developer relations, developer advocacy, or developer community management, including programs you built from the ground up.
  • A track record of growing an online developer community on Slack, Discord, or a similar platform.
  • Experience planning and running in-person events such as meetups, workshops, or hackathons.
  • Hands-on technical skills, including building demos and sample apps and working comfortably with SQL and Postgres.
  • Familiarity with, and creative ideas for AI agent development, LLM frameworks, vector search, or a demonstrated ability to get up to speed fast.
  • Experience in open source communities as a contributor, maintainer, or community organizer.
  • Confidence presenting and facilitating, both live and on camera.
  • An active social presence and following in a relevant developer community.
  • Comfort working autonomously in a fast-moving startup. B2B SaaS or infrastructure experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience with distributed databases, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience running ambassador or champion programs.
  • Experience running co-marketing or joint events with technology partners.

Success in year one, in conjunction with our DevRel team

  • Community membership across Slack and other channels grows to 10X
  • Dozens of workshops, hackathons, and meetups delivered
  • At least a dozen hackathons run, focused on AI agents built with Meko.
  • Ten partner co-hosted events delivered.
  • A champions program launched with 50+ active members.

We feel strongly about equal pay for equal work, and transparency in compensation is one way to help achieve that. The cash compensation for this role is market competitive, with a range of $160,000-$215,000, as well as equity (when applicable), and benefits including health plans, retirement plans, and unlimited paid time off (PTO). Some roles also include variable/incentive compensation, or a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. The pay range for this position is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. The actual pay will vary based on factors including experience, qualifications, and skill level.

Regarding visa sponsorship: Due to recent changes in U.S. immigration policy, we’re currently unable to sponsor new H-1B visas for candidates outside the United States. We’re happy to consider candidates who need an H-1B transfer or extension, as well as candidates in the U.S. on F-1 status (including CPT or OPT) who would need to change to H-1B status. Candidates with other types of valid work authorization are also welcome to apply.

As an equal opportunity employer, Yugabyte is committed to a diverse workforce. Employment decisions regarding recruitment and selection will be made without discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, genetic information or characteristic, gender identity and expression, veteran status, or other non-job related characteristics or other prohibited grounds specified in applicable federal, state and local laws.
