raw.title: Director, Cloud Infrastructure
raw.excerpt: Who We Are Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.

Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.

Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.

At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!

Summary/Objective

The Senior Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Technical Operations is the senior technical authority for the reliability, scalability, performance, and security of API's cloud-based platform and infrastructure. This is a hands-on, player-coach role: an expert AWS architect and network engineer who also leads people. Operating globally, the Senior Director will set and review AWS architecture, including multi-account design, hybrid and multi-region networking, and security controls, while developing distributed cloud, network, SRE, and DevOps teams. The role owns AWS governance, system reliability, and service continuity, and serves as the primary bridge between technology operations and the business. The ideal candidate combines deep, current AWS and cloud networking expertise with strong people leadership, financial acumen, and executive partnership skills.

Essential Functions:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop globally distributed technical operations teams, building a collaborative, high-performance culture across time zones and cultures
  • Define team structure, roles, and career paths for cloud engineers, network engineers, SREs, and DevOps practitioners across both locations
  • Serve as the technical escalation point and mentor for cloud and network engineers; take part directly in architecture reviews, major incident response, and root-cause analysis
  • Set goals, KPIs, and performance expectations for the organization; conduct regular reviews and provide ongoing coaching
  • Partner with HR and talent acquisition to recruit and retain top technical talent across our global locations
  • Collaborate with product engineering, security, data, and business teams to integrate operational requirements into the software development lifecycle

Cloud Infrastructure & AWS

  • Serve as the senior technical authority for API's global AWS environment and own its governance and operations, including multi-account strategy (Organizations, Control Tower), security controls, compliance posture, and cost management
  • Drive cloud cost optimization, including Reserved Instance and Savings Plans management, rightsizing, tagging governance, and FinOps practices
  • Establish and enforce AWS security best practices including IAM least-privilege access, SCPs, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, and CloudTrail audit logging across all environments
  • Oversee multi-region and multi-AZ strategies that meet disaster recovery objectives, minimize RTO/RPO, and maintain continuous availability for global customers
  • Evaluate new AWS services and infrastructure technologies and present adoption recommendations to senior leadership
  • Define infrastructure as code standards (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK), CI/CD-driven change, and Well-Architected reviews

Cloud Network Architecture & Engineering

  • Architect and hold final technical accountability for AWS network design, including multi-account/multi-VPC topologies, CIDR planning, segmentation, Transit Gateway routing, PrivateLink, and centralized egress and inspection
  • Own hybrid connectivity between AWS, API's global offices, and partners, including Direct Connect, Site-to-Site and Client VPN, and BGP routing and failover design
  • Design and operate DNS, edge, and traffic management, including Route 53, CloudFront, Global Accelerator, and Elastic Load Balancing
  • Define network security architecture, including security groups, NACLs, Network Firewall, WAF, Shield, zero-trust access, and segmentation of PCI-scoped workloads
  • Establish network observability and resilience using VPC Flow Logs, Reachability Analyzer, and CloudWatch/Datadog; lead troubleshooting of complex cross-region and hybrid incidents and validate network failover during DR testing

System Reliability & Service Continuity

  • Define and own SLAs and uptime commitments for all production systems; set reliability targets with product engineering and report performance to executive stakeholders
  • Oversee monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent) for proactive detection and rapid response
  • Drive capacity planning so infrastructure scales efficiently with growth without compromising performance or cost targets
  • Own the IT disaster recovery and business continuity plan; lead tabletop exercises and failover testing to validate recovery

Strategy, Governance & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Develop and execute the multi-year technical operations roadmap aligned with product strategy and growth objectives
  • Provide regular reporting to the SVP of Infrastructure Engineering and Technical Operations and executive leadership, including infrastructure health, cost, and initiative progress
  • Lead vendor relationships for cloud, infrastructure tooling, and managed services, including contract negotiations, SLA management, and performance reviews
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and data privacy requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001) as they apply to infrastructure; partner with security on audit readiness
  • Manage the technical operations budget, including headcount, tooling, and cloud spend, with accurate forecasting and variance analysis

Competencies

  • Proven ability to build, scale, and retain high-performing technical teams across multiple geographies and time zones
  • Executive presence; able to translate complex infrastructure concepts into clear narratives for C-suite and board audiences
  • Strategic mindset balanced with operational discipline, from multi-year vision to day-to-day excellence
  • Expert-level, current, hands-on command of AWS architecture, cloud networking, and security, sufficient to design and critique solutions and lead deep-dive troubleshooting in major incidents; not a people-management-only role
  • Strong financial acumen managing multi-million-dollar cloud budgets and driving cost optimization without compromising reliability
  • Skilled at leading globally distributed teams across multiple time zones
  • Data-driven; uses metrics, SLOs, and KPIs to prioritize investments and communicate operational health
  • Commitment to engineering excellence, blameless culture, and continuous learning
  • Experience with AI based automation capabilities for system self-healing, stability and security.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position (exempt where applicable) based in the United States or Canada. This position can be remote or hybrid. Standard hours are Monday through Friday during core business hours. Given the global nature of this role, flexibility in scheduling is expected to accommodate regular collaboration with the Pune, India team across significant time zone differences. Occasional evening availability for major deployments and scheduled maintenance windows may be required.

Travel

This position may require occasional travel within the United States and Canada, and possibly to India, to support vendor meetings, industry conferences, cross-functional leadership engagements, and business unit initiatives.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; Master's or MBA preferred; equivalent experience considered
  • 15+ years in technology operations, infrastructure engineering, or cloud operations, including 8+ years of hands-on production AWS design and operations and 5+ years leading technical teams in a director, senior director, head-of, or equivalent senior leadership role, regardless of title
  • Experience managing distributed teams across multiple countries; experience overseeing staff in India strongly preferred
  • Expert knowledge of AWS services including compute (EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda), storage (S3, EFS, EBS), databases (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache), and security (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, WAF, Shield, Network Firewall)
  • Deep expertise in cloud and enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, IPsec VPN, load balancing, and TLS, with experience designing hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, VPN) and multi-VPC/multi-account architectures at scale (VPC, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, Route 53, CloudFront)
  • Hands-on proficiency with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK), CI/CD, and scripting (Python, Bash, or equivalent)
  • Proven track record overseeing highly available, multi-region production systems with aggressive uptime and performance SLAs
  • Experience managing cloud budgets, implementing FinOps, and presenting forecasts to executive leadership
  • Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, or PCI-DSS
  • Experience owning observability platforms (Datadog, CloudWatch, Grafana, or equivalent) and driving a metrics-driven approach to operational health
  • Experience owning disaster recovery and business continuity programs for cloud infrastructure, including regular testing and executive reporting
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (or equivalent) required; Advanced Networking – Specialty and Security – Specialty strongly preferred

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading technical operations at a SaaS or cloud-native company supporting enterprise customers with high availability and data security requirements
  • Database reliability engineering experience, including RDS/Aurora tuning, failover testing, and backup/recovery validation
  • Experience with enterprise network architecture beyond AWS, including SD-WAN, MPLS, next-gen firewalls, and ZTNA
  • Familiarity with change management; ServiceNow or Jira Service Management a plus
  • Experience in travel technology, hospitality, or other high-volume, customer-facing SaaS
  • Exposure to ML/AI infrastructure, including data pipeline reliability and model serving on AWS

Compensation

The good faith compensation for this position is

United States: $160,000 - $180,000 USD

Compensation is determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set, geographic location, as well as internal alignment and external benchmarks.

Other Duties

Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time according to business needs.

The performance of additional responsibilities if you are designated as a Data Protection Champion (DPC), Senior Information Risk Owner (SIRO) or Information Assurance Accounting Officer (IAAO).

Work Environment

This position operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.

raw.title: Tracking and Attribution Specialist, Direct Response
raw.excerpt: ABOUT BAD MARKETING:We're a team of 130+ passionate leaders and creatives who have worked diligently to make BAD Marketing one of the largest and most robust Growth Marketing Agencies in the world.
raw.description:
ABOUT BAD MARKETING:

We're a team of 130+ passionate leaders and creatives who have worked diligently to make BAD Marketing one of the largest and most robust Growth Marketing Agencies in the world. At the core of our philosophy is the belief that excellence stems from a united team working toward a common objective: to not only help our clients grow profitably but also to provide them with an experience they can’t find anywhere else.

We specialize in local lead generation, e-commerce, and information marketing, catering to clients that span from auto and local shop owners to online consumer product brand owners, online gurus selling courses or coaching, and more.

Our approach to success involves more than just Bold And Disruptive strategies. We invest in our team through extensive training, continuous support for growth and learning, and the cultivation of a happy and confident company culture. For us, finding fulfillment in your career is just as crucial as excelling in it.

ABOUT THIS POSITION:

We're looking for a Tracking and Attribution Specialist - someone who can own the measurement layer across our info/coaching division and make sure every number our media buyers optimize against and our strategists report to clients is actually true.

You'll serve all pods across 20-30 clients, each with a different setup, across mostly paid platform (some email) traffic. We run on Meta, Google/YouTube, and TikTok, and on whatever platform a client needs next. Client reporting runs through our custom dashboards/system, and our clients use a mix of third-party attribution tools (Hyros primarily, but some other similar platforms). You report to the Director of Operations, who owns the overall systems architecture. You own the tracking and attribution domain within it.

This is a specialist role within our martech function. You'll work alongside our MarTech team, who also handle tracking work, but tracking and attribution is your specialty and your domain. You're the person the division comes to when something about tracking is unclear, broken, or new. When we launch a client on a paid platform nobody here has used, you're the one who investigates it, learns it, and comes back with how we should set up the tracking. When Meta, Hyros, and Stripe all show different purchase counts, you're the one who can explain why and which number to trust.

Tracking breaks quietly. An event stops firing after a page edit, deduplication fails, a UTM gets mistyped on an email. You're not waiting for a media buyer to notice two weeks later - you've built the monitoring that catches it first. And because you're working across 20-30 clients, every setup, fix, and change you make gets documented so anyone on the team can pick it up.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • Media buyers and strategists trust the data because you've verified it - not because they assumed it was right
  • Broken events get caught by your monitoring, not by someone wondering why performance dropped
  • New launches go live with verified tracking, and you keep verifying it after launch as pages, platforms, and integrations change
  • Every client has a current tracking record in their funnel bible - what's installed, how it's configured, what changed, and why - clear enough that someone else could troubleshoot from it
  • UTMs are consistent across paid and organic, so organic traffic is actually attributable
  • When platform and attribution numbers don't line up, you explain the gap in plain language a strategist can repeat to a client
  • When we move onto a new platform, you've already figured out how to track it
  • You fix the same problem once. The second time, it becomes a checklist, a template, or an automated check

A DAY IN THIS ROLE:

Morning: Review what your automated event health checks flagged overnight across clients - broken events, deduplication issues, Event Match Quality drops, unexpected volume changes. Triage by business impact. Check the ClickUp queue and Slack for anything urgent from media buyers or strategists.

Throughout the day:

  • Implement and fix tracking - GTM tags and triggers, Meta CAPI (including the CRM-side setup an integration needs), Google enhanced conversions, GA4, TikTok and YouTube conversion tracking, attribution platform connections
  • Run tracking checks on new launches before they go live, and on live funnels when something changes
  • Work through your audit rotation - take a client's full setup and come back with what's broken, what's at risk, and what to fix first
  • Explain discrepancies to strategists and media buyers, and push back when a requested setup is going to produce bad data
  • Update each client's tracking record as you make changes - not at the end of the week

Weekly rhythm: Cross-client event health review, UTM hygiene checks on new campaigns and emails, and a watch on platform tracking changes that could affect our setups. Monthly, you reconcile platform, attribution, and source data for each active client.

End of day: You can answer: Did I act on every monitoring exception? Is every change I made today documented? Does anyone need a status update from me?

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2+ years in a marketing technology, marketing operations, or technical marketing role, with tracking and attribution as your core strength - ideally at an agency or across multiple accounts
  • Deep Meta tracking knowledge - Pixel vs. Conversions API, standard vs. custom events, deduplication, Event Match Quality, Events Manager diagnostics
  • Google Tag Manager - you build and debug containers, data layers, and triggers yourself
  • GA4 and Google Ads conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions
  • Tracking experience on at least one platform beyond Meta and Google (TikTok, YouTube, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Hyros and at least one other third-party attribution platform (Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar)
  • UTM strategy, click IDs, and cross-domain tracking - you understand how parameters pass from click to CRM to report
  • Reporting literacy - you understand how tracking data becomes a report and can spec what a report needs
  • Comfortable reading documentation and figuring out unfamiliar platforms independently
  • Clear written communication. You operate in Slack and ClickUp, not meetings, and you need to explain technical issues so non-technical people can act on them

Strongly preferred:

  • Experience in direct response, info/coaching, or performance marketing environments
  • SQL and BigQuery familiarity/working knowledge
  • CRM integrations for server-side events (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, or similar)
  • GoHighLevel or ClickFunnels experience

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF:

  • You want to own a domain/specialty
  • You document by default - you'd rather write it down once than explain it three times
  • You build systems, not one-offs. Solving the same problem twice bothers you
  • You understand how a broken event affects campaign optimization and the numbers clients see, not just the tag itself
  • You're energized by figuring out platforms you've never used
  • You use AI heavily for audits, documentation, debugging, and monitoring; you're open about how, and you know where it gets tracking wrong

THIS MAY NOT BE FOR YOU IF:

  • You think this role is mainly CRM implementation, email automation, or workflow building - those are part of martech, but in this role they're the exception, not the job
  • Your tracking experience is mostly installing pixels and tags someone else configured - you haven't set up or debugged Conversions API, GTM, or server-side events yourself
  • You haven't had to reconcile numbers across ad platforms and attribution tools, or you're not interested in why they disagree
  • You'd rather fix things as they're reported than build monitoring that catches them first
  • Documentation feels like extra work
  • You need training or detailed instructions before you can work in an unfamiliar platform
  • You'd rather keep your AI use quiet than show us your workflow
  • Written async communication isn't your strength

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Lex Bellator, APLC is a consumer law firm based in California. We handle a high volume of client matters, and our clients expect to hear from us.

This is primarily an administrative and customer service role. You will be on the phone all day. It's a fast-paced environment with a lot of clients and a lot of moving pieces, and we're looking for someone who genuinely wants to work, take ownership, and earn.

What you'll do

You'll be the main point of contact for our clients. Day to day that means:

  • Answering incoming calls and returning messages the same day
  • Giving clients clear, honest updates on where their case stands
  • Checking in with the paralegal team to find out what's needed on each file, then going and getting it
  • Proactively reaching out when we're missing documents, signatures, or information, and following up until it's in hand
  • Walking clients through questionnaires and paperwork over the phone, step by step, when they get stuck
  • Keeping accurate notes of every contact in our case management system
  • Making sure no client goes quiet without someone noticing

This job is not for you if

We'd rather tell you now than find out in month two.

  • If you don't speak Spanish fluently. Not "conversational." Most of your calls will be in Spanish, with people who are upset, elderly, or both.
  • If you don't have patience. You'll explain the same thing three times to the same person, and the third time has to sound as kind as the first.
  • If you haven't done customer service before. This is not an entry-level phone job. You need to already know how to de-escalate, how to set expectations, and how to say "I don't know yet, but I'll find out" without losing someone's trust.
  • If you need someone to hand you a to-do list. The outstanding items are yours to track. If a client owes us a document, you're the one who notices and the one who chases it.
  • If you'd rather be in a role where the hard conversations go to someone else. Here, they come to you.

How to apply

Send your resume and a short cover note. The note should be in Spanish, and it should tell us about the hardest customer you've handled and what you did. We read every one.


Requirements

What we're looking for

  • Fluent, professional English and Spanish, spoken and written
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing role (customer service, client relations, account management, or similar)
  • Strong follow-up habits and the organization to manage many open items at once
  • Administrative experience and comfort with standard office software and web-based systems
  • Calm under pressure, professional, and good at solving problems without escalating everything

Nice to have

  • Some sales or retention experience. This is not a sales role, but the skills transfer: listening, building trust quickly, and keeping someone engaged when they want to walk away.
  • Experience in a law office, insurance, financial services, or another regulated, document-heavy environment

Benefits

The details

  • Full-time, fully remote
  • Open to candidates based in Latin America (Mexico, Colombia, Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras preferred; other countries in the region considered)
  • Working hours aligned to U.S. Pacific Time
  • Reports to the firm's Legal Administrator, with the Managing Attorney
  • Compensation: USD $7/hour to start, with room to grow based on experience and performance. Competitive, based on experience. Potential bonuses available.

raw.description:
About Us

Trase is the operating system for high-stakes environments, providing end-to-end solutions for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI within industries where security, governance, and data sovereignty are non-negotiable.

Our HIPAA- and SOC 2-compliant platform bridges the “last mile” of AI adoption, empowering sectors like healthcare and national security to run trustworthy, predictable AI agents across any model or environment—whether in the cloud, on-prem, or at the edge—with unified policy enforcement, continuous monitoring, and fully immutable audit trails.

Trase’s suite of products includes Origin, its agentic operating system; Leagues, its marketplace for specialized, configurable, ready-to-deploy agents; and Arena, where developers build, evaluate, and package the agents that run on Origin. The company has repeatedly topped Hugging Face’s GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, placing it firmly at the forefront of AI-agent innovation.

About the Role

As a Staff/Senior Staff Technical Program Manager at Trase, you will own technical program execution dedicated to Red Cell Federal (RCF) and Red Cell Partners (RCP) incubations and portfolio companies. You will join Trase's dedicated RCF/RCP support team, with a strong focus on federal, government, and national security programs.

Red Cell Partners is an investment and incubation firm that builds and supports technology companies, including Trase. Red Cell Federal is our federal-focused partner within that ecosystem. This role helps RCF and other RCP partner companies adopt and operate Trase OS in their own environments. You will turn partner requirements into secure, reliable deployments and sustained operational support, with a strong focus on federal, government, and national security programs.

You will work with a dedicated team of full-stack software engineers and DevOps/SRE engineers, partnering closely with Trase Platform Engineering, Product, GRC, and RCF/RCP technical leaders. Your scope spans partner onboarding, integrations, environment readiness, releases, and ongoing support for RCF and RCP portfolio companies.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will drive decisions, resolve dependencies, and hold delivery commitments accountable from initial request through validated customer acceptance.

Scope of Responsibilities

  • Own RCF/RCP program delivery: translate ambiguous requests into scoped user stories, acceptance criteria, owners, dependencies, and small, testable milestones. Confirm feasibility with engineers before committing dates.
  • Establish a single intake and prioritized backlog with Product and RCF/RCP counterparts. Distinguish production blockers, security obligations, and committed customer needs from exploratory requests; keep partner-facing plans aligned with engineering execution.
  • Drive secure deployment readiness across customer-managed cloud, private-network, and on-premises environments. Track infrastructure prerequisites, access, networking, secrets, model-provider integrations, and end-to-end workflow validation.
  • Partner with GRC and security owners to incorporate applicable RMF/ATO, STIG, and impact-level requirements into delivery plans. Drive engineering remediation, evidence readiness, and approval dependencies while maintaining clear Trase/RCF/RCP responsibility boundaries.
  • Coordinate release and image handoffs, including versioning, compatibility, vulnerability scan results, software bills of materials, release manifests, deployment guides, and rollback readiness. Verify readiness before partner delivery.
  • Drive ongoing support for federal deployments, including Second Front where applicable: track patching, hardening, upgrades, security findings, and sustainment commitments with named engineering and GRC owners.
  • Coordinate partner issue triage and technical escalations across the dedicated team and shared platform teams. Drive closure of integration, performance, reliability, and observability gaps against agreed acceptance criteria.
  • Build repeatable onboarding and operational handoffs through runbooks, architecture and data-flow documentation, training, and knowledge transfer so partner teams can operate and repeat deployments.
  • Run planning, grooming, delivery reviews, and risk escalation. Give technical and executive stakeholders clear visibility into commitments, capacity, dependencies, tradeoffs, and decisions; surface reusable partner needs for the core platform roadmap.

Staff / Sr. Staff Expectations

  • Staff: independently lead complex RCF/RCP programs across engineering, security, operations, and partner teams; resolve ambiguity and drive measurable delivery and operational outcomes.
  • Senior Staff: lead a portfolio of interdependent RCF/RCP programs; shape the engagement and delivery model, influence roadmap and investment tradeoffs with senior leaders, and establish practices that scale across partner deployments.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship is required. Ability and willingness to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance, as required by assigned programs.
  • 8–10+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering, or related technical delivery roles, with demonstrated Staff-level scope; broader multi-program leadership and organizational influence for Sr. Staff.
  • Track record of delivering complex software, infrastructure, or platform programs to external customers, including secure or regulated environments.
  • Strong technical judgment and experience leading cross-team execution, prioritization, risk management, and customer-facing escalations under ambiguity.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, security specialists, partner teams, and executives, including the ability to challenge unclear requirements and negotiate realistic commitments.

Technical Depth

  • Understand distributed systems, APIs, agent workflows, and integration boundaries well enough to inspect technical plans, challenge assumptions, and lead tradeoff discussions.

Overview

Join ENERCON’s Nuclear Services Group and Help Ensure Excellence in Nuclear Instrument Performance. We are seeking an experienced Uncertainty & Drift Analysis Subject Matter Expert (SME) to provide technical leadership in the evaluation, development, and implementation of instrument uncertainty, setpoint, and drift analysis programs supporting the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of nuclear generating facilities. This is a unique opportunity to apply your expertise to complex engineering challenges, influence plant performance, and support critical modernization and regulatory initiatives across the nuclear fleet.

This position is available in the following locations:

  • Kennesaw, GA (Suburb of Atlanta)
  • Chicago, IL
  • Naperville, IL (Suburb of Chicago)
  • Chattanooga, TN
  • Charlotte, NC
  • Baton Rouge, LA
  • Birmingham, AL
  • Palm Beach Gardens, FL
  • King of Prussia, PA
  • Overland Park, KS
  • Huntsville, AL
  • Kennewick, WA
  • Morristown, NJ
  • Ft Worth, TX
  • Aiken, SC
  • Remote (if not close to an office)

Responsibilities

As a recognized technical authority, you will work with multidisciplinary engineering teams, plant personnel, and industry experts to develop and review engineering calculations, resolve challenging technical issues, and ensure compliance with licensing, regulatory, and industry requirements. Your work will directly impact plant safety, equipment reliability, and long-term operational excellence.

  • Technical Leadership & Calculations: Serve as the technical lead for instrument uncertainty calculations, setpoint methodologies, and drift analyses. Develop, review, and approve engineering calculations supporting nuclear plant instrumentation and control systems
  • Technical Analysis & Performance Evaluation: Perform technical analyses including instrument uncertainty calculations, response time evaluations, setpoint determinations, and performance assessments. Evaluate instrument performance, calibration data, and historical trends to establish drift characteristics and optimize maintenance strategies
  • Project & Plant Support: Support engineering change packages, digital modernization projects, and plant modifications by providing uncertainty and setpoint evaluations. Provide technical support for troubleshooting, corrective action investigations, operability evaluations, and root cause analyses
  • Cross-Functional & Regulatory Collaboration: Interface with engineering, operations, maintenance, licensing, and training organizations to resolve complex technical issues. Support regulatory audits, inspections, licensing activities, and industry benchmarking initiatives
  • Mentorship & Standards: Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers and other technical personnel. Contribute to the development and improvement of engineering standards, procedures, and best practices

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline
  • Minimum of 10 years of Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) engineering experience, preferably within the commercial nuclear power industry
  • Demonstrated expertise in:
    • Instrument uncertainty calculations
    • Setpoint methodology development
    • Instrument drift analysis
    • Instrument performance monitoring and trending
  • Strong understanding of nuclear regulatory requirements, industry standards, and engineering methodologies applicable to instrument uncertainty and setpoint calculations
  • Experience supporting plant modifications, engineering change packages, design basis calculations, and technical evaluations
  • Knowledge of process instrumentation including pressure, temperature, flow, level, radiation monitoring, and analytical instrumentation systems
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, technical writing, and communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and provide technical leadership on complex projects
  • Previous experience supporting commercial nuclear power plants, engineering consulting organizations, or architect-engineer firms
  • Experience with digital I&C modernization and Distributed Control System (DCS) upgrades
  • Familiarity with NRC regulations, ISA standards, ANSI/ANS standards, and industry guidance related to uncertainty and setpoint methodologies
  • Recognized industry expertise in uncertainty analysis, drift monitoring, or instrumentation performance programs
  • Required to travel between 15-25% of the time; duration of travel length may vary depending on project and client needs
  • Due to Federal Contracts, US Citizenship is required

Compensation Range

USD $107,200.00 - USD $187,000.00 /Yr.

Additional Information

ENERCON Services, Inc. (ENERCON) is powered by people who make a difference. We offer rewarding careers in a culture built on excellence, innovation, and growth.

Please CLICK HERE to learn more about the potential Benefits you may be eligible to receive with this role and working here at ENERCON.

The compensation range listed is a good-faith estimate of the compensation expected for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, geographic location, and internal equity.

Some positions may be performed remotely in one or more U.S. states. Compensation is aligned with applicable pay transparency requirements and reflects expected compensation at the time of posting.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer sponsorship. We ask all candidates this question to better understand work authorization and any potential sponsorship needs.
